66269.recognize_zh: 視野中兩個延長、兩端圓鈍的香蕉／臘腸形寄生蟲，胞體內佈滿紫紅色染色質與散在的暗色瘧色素，被感染的紅血球輪廓幾乎看不到、且不比周圍紅血球大；這種新月形配子體（gametocyte）是惡性瘧（P. falciparum）的特徵。
features: Two elongated, banana- to sausage-shaped gametocytes with rounded ends, longer than the diameter of a normal red cell
Granular purple-magenta chromatin distributed through the parasite with scattered dark malarial pigment
Host red cell membrane barely discernible and not enlarged; no Schüffner stippling
Possible small marginal (accolé) parasite at the edge of a red cell at left; asexual forms otherwise inconspicuous
Background red cells normocytic with numerous crenated forms (echinocytes, likely artifact); no white cells in field
66269.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear (Field stain, oil immersion) shows two elongated, crescent/sausage-shaped intraerythrocytic parasites with rounded ends, granular chromatin and dispersed dark pigment, which distort and exceed the length of the host red cell without enlarging it. No Schüffner dots or enlarged infected cells are present. The background red cells are normocytic with numerous echinocytes, likely a preparation artifact. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes; a parasitemia count and search for ring forms should accompany the report.

ddx.vs: Non-falciparum gametocytes are round to oval, fill an enlarged red cell and are accompanied by Schüffner stippling, not banana-shaped.
Band forms stretch across a normal-sized red cell as a narrow bar within the cell outline, whereas falciparum gametocytes exceed and distort the red cell length.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings and tetrads (Maltese cross) without pigment or gametocytes.

ddx.dx: Platelet overlying a red cell or stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Platelets and stain debris lack the defined elongated parasite outline, organized chromatin and pigment, and lie in a different focal plane.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes — banana/crescent-shaped parasites with pigment exceeding the length of non-enlarged red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指香蕉形寄生蟲問 species 與 stage；答 P. falciparum gametocyte，是 thin smear 上唯一可單獨確認 falciparum 的形態。
Falciparum 周邊血通常只見 ring 與 gametocyte；trophozoite/schizont 在微血管中 sequestration，故周邊少見。
Gametocyte 不引起症狀但具傳染性；artemisinin 類藥物對成熟 gametocyte 效果有限，WHO 建議在特定地區加單劑低劑量 primaquine 阻斷傳播。
Gametocyte 在治療後可持續存在數週，不代表治療失敗；追蹤療效要看 asexual ring 寄生率。
Thick smear 篩檢、thin smear 判 species 與寄生率；RDT 以 HRP2 偵測 falciparum（注意 hrp2 缺失株可偽陰）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 P. malariae band form 混淆；band form 橫跨正常大小紅血球且在細胞輪廓內，falciparum gametocyte 為新月形、長度超過並撐變形紅血球。

quiz.q: 圖中香蕉形寄生蟲是哪一種瘧原蟲的哪一期？治療後仍存在是否代表治療失敗？
quiz.a: P. falciparum gametocyte；不代表，療效看 asexual ring 寄生率。

65949.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆與紅血球大小相當的巨大血小板，中央顆粒區（granulomere）呈紫紅色、周邊為淡藍透明區（hyalomere）並有不規則偽足突起；周圍散布許多正常大小的小血小板可做比對，一眼看出其體積異常。
features: Giant platelet in the center, roughly equal in diameter to adjacent red cells
Central purple azurophilic granulomere with a pale blue peripheral hyalomere and irregular pseudopod-like projections
Numerous normal-sized small platelets scattered around, providing size comparison
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; no platelet clumps or leukocytes in field
65949.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a giant platelet approximately the size of a red blood cell, with a central granular granulomere and an irregular pale hyalomere with pseudopod-like projections. Multiple normal-sized platelets are present in the background, and red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. An isolated giant platelet is nonspecific; if giant platelets are frequent or accompanied by thrombocytopenia, an inherited macrothrombocytopenia or a myeloproliferative/myelodysplastic process should be considered, and a manual platelet estimate is recommended because analyzers may undercount giant platelets.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a dense round nucleus with a thin rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas the giant platelet lacks a nucleus and shows only granular purple cytoplasm.
Clumps contain multiple individual platelet outlines, while this is a single platelet with one continuous hyalomere.
Micromegakaryocytes contain a nucleus and megakaryocyte fragments are larger and irregular with nuclear material, unlike this anucleate platelet.
Large platelets from increased turnover are generally smaller than red cells and occur with a clinical setting of consumption; morphology alone cannot fully separate them.

exam.answer_en: Giant platelet — anucleate platelet about the size of a red cell with central granulomere and pale hyalomere, amid normal-sized platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央結構問「是淋巴球還是血小板」；無核、中央紫色 granulomere、周邊淡藍 hyalomere，答 giant platelet。
單一巨大血小板無特異性；若頻繁出現，鑑別包括 inherited macrothrombocytopenia（Bernard-Soulier、MYH9-related）、MPN、MDS、ITP。
自動分析儀會把巨大血小板計為紅血球，造成血小板偽低與 MPV 不準；需手工估計（每油鏡視野血小板數 ×約 15–20×10⁹/L 估算）。
MYH9-related disorder 要同時找中性球 Döhle-like 包涵體，並問腎病、聽力喪失與白內障家族史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 巨大血小板易被當成小淋巴球；淋巴球有深染圓形細胞核與藍色胞質邊，巨大血小板無核只見顆粒。

quiz.q: 中央的結構是什麼？為什麼自動血球計數可能低估此病人的血小板數？
quiz.a: Giant platelet；體積接近紅血球，被分析儀歸為紅血球而未計入血小板。

66013.recognize_zh: 視野下方中央一顆紅血球內布滿大量粗大、深藍色的點狀顆粒且分布於整個細胞，即粗大嗜鹼性點彩（coarse basophilic stippling）；背景紅血球大小不一、低色素並有標靶細胞，符合重型乙型地中海貧血。
features: Single red cell containing numerous coarse, dark blue punctate granules distributed throughout the cell
Granules are uniform in color and scattered diffusely rather than clustered at the periphery
Background red cells show anisocytosis, poikilocytosis and hypochromia
Target cells and irregularly shaped red cells are present
Occasional small platelets; no nucleated red cells in this field
66013.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic red cells, target cells, and irregular forms. In the lower center of the field, a red cell contains numerous coarse, dark blue granules distributed throughout the cytoplasm, representing coarse basophilic stippling (aggregated ribosomal RNA). No malarial parasites or Pappenheimer body clusters are evident. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling in the setting of dyserythropoiesis, such as beta-thalassemia major; lead poisoning and pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency should be considered if clinically appropriate.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are fewer, small clustered granules at the cell periphery that stain with Prussian blue, whereas basophilic stippling is diffuse and iron-negative.
Lead poisoning produces morphologically identical coarse stippling, so blood lead level and clinical history are needed to separate it.
Parasites show ring forms with chromatin dots and cytoplasm or Maltese crosses rather than numerous uniform punctate granules.
Howell-Jolly bodies are usually a single larger round dense nuclear remnant rather than many fine to coarse dots.

exam.answer_en: Coarse basophilic stippling — diffuse dark blue punctate RNA granules in a red cell, in a hypochromic thalassemic background
pearls_zh: 考法：指布滿藍點的紅血球問名稱與三大病因：lead poisoning、thalassemia、pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency。
機轉：核糖體 RNA 未正常降解而聚集；lead 會抑制 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase、ALA dehydratase 與 ferrochelatase。
鉛中毒另見 zinc protoporphyrin 上升，骨髓可見 ring sideroblasts；需驗血中鉛濃度並詢問職業暴露。
Prussian blue 染色：basophilic stippling 陰性、Pappenheimer bodies 陽性，是必考的鑑別染色。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆；Pappenheimer 顆粒少、成小群靠近紅血球邊緣且含鐵（Prussian blue 陽性），basophilic stippling 則是均勻散布全細胞的藍點、鐵染色陰性。

quiz.q: 圖下方中央紅血球內的藍色點狀物稱為什麼？可用哪種染色與 Pappenheimer bodies 區分？
quiz.a: Coarse basophilic stippling；Prussian blue（鐵染色，stippling 為陰性）。

65501.recognize_zh: GMS 銀染色下，大量黑綠色的圓形到卵圓形酵母菌體，大小差異明顯，許多呈窄基底出芽、形成淚滴狀或雪人狀的子細胞，也有碎裂變形的菌體。菌體大小不一加上窄基出芽，是 Cryptococcus 在 GMS 上的樣子。
features: Numerous silver-positive (black to dark green-black) round to oval yeasts
Striking variation in yeast size
Narrow-based budding producing teardrop or snowman-shaped pairs
Some collapsed, crescentic or fragmented yeast forms
No hyphae or pseudohyphae; background tissue pale with little counterstain in this field
65501.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy stained with Grocott methenamine silver shows innumerable silver-positive yeast forms. The organisms are round to oval and markedly variable in size, with frequent narrow-based budding and some collapsed or crescentic forms; hyphae and pseudohyphae are absent. Findings are consistent with cryptococcal infection; the capsule is not demonstrated by GMS and is best confirmed with mucicarmine or Alcian blue.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma on GMS shows small, uniform 2–4 µm yeasts clustered in histiocytes, not large variably sized yeasts.
Blastomyces yeasts are more uniformly large with broad-based budding.

ddx.dx: Candida glabrata or other Candida species
ddx.vs: Candida yeasts are smaller and more uniform, and most species form pseudohyphae.
Pneumocystis cysts are uniform 5–7 µm, cup- or crescent-shaped with central dot-like thickenings and do not bud.

65437.recognize_zh: 成熟外觀的淋巴球（核圓、染色質塊狀、細胞質淡藍）在細胞質中出現細長的粉紅針狀包涵體（箭頭），外觀像 Auer rod，但出現在淋巴球而非芽細胞，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的假 Auer rod。
features: Small to medium atypical lymphocytes with round to oval nuclei and moderately condensed, clumped chromatin
Occasional small indistinct nucleoli; no blast-type fine chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, focally with irregular or slightly shaggy borders
Thin, pink-red, needle-like cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods (arrows and inset)
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact
65437.describe_en: Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate smears show an infiltrate of small to medium atypical lymphocytes with round to oval nuclei, clumped chromatin, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with focally irregular borders. Several cells contain thin, pink needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions that resemble Auer rods. The cells lack the fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli of myeloblasts, and no granulated blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with a mature B-cell lymphoma with Auer rod-like (pseudo-Auer rod) inclusions, in keeping with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in this case.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods lie in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, whereas these inclusions are in mature-appearing lymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof and are CD138-positive, while these cells lack a hof and are CD20-positive B cells.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections and ribosome-lamella complexes, and are CD25/CD103/annexin A1-positive.
LGL cells show discrete azurophilic granules rather than rod-shaped inclusions and are CD3/CD8/CD57-positive T or NK cells.

65373.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中兩顆中型淋巴樣細胞核圓、染色質均勻，細胞質淡藍灰且周緣有細毛狀突起（hairy projections），是毛細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）的特徵。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, about 1.5 to 2 times a small lymphocyte
Round to oval nuclei with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin; no distinct nucleoli
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Fine, hair-like circumferential cytoplasmic projections
Thick-area background with closely packed red cells; low magnification limits nuclear detail
65373.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, examined at moderate magnification in a relatively thick area, shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, homogeneous chromatin and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. Nucleoli are not conspicuous. Nuclear detail is limited by magnification. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry for CD11c, CD25, CD103 and CD123 and BRAF V600E testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Cells have a prominent nucleolus, often with leukocytosis and no monocytopenia, and are CD25 and ANXA1 negative and BRAF V600E wild type.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and more condensed chromatin, and lack the CD103/CD25/CD123 hairy cell phenotype.
Artifactual cytoplasmic projections occur in thick areas and on normal lymphocytes, so confirmation in thin areas and by flow cytometry is needed.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — medium lymphoid cells with round nuclei and circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections
pearls_zh: 考法：指有毛狀突起的淋巴樣細胞問身分，下一題通常是流式：CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 皆陽性，CD20 強表現。
分子：典型 HCL 幾乎都有 BRAF V600E 突變，既是診斷依據也是標靶。
典型血象：pancytopenia 合併明顯 monocytopenia，脾腫大而淋巴結通常不大。
exam.pitfall_zh: 厚區乾燥假象可讓正常淋巴球出現毛狀突起；需在薄區確認形態，並以流式 CD103/CD25/CD11c 表型證實。

quiz.q: 流式確認 hairy cell 最常用的四個標記？
quiz.a: CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123

65181.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以甲苯胺藍（toluidine blue）染色時，大量圓形至卵圓形細胞的細胞質被紫紅色異染性（metachromatic）顆粒塞滿（箭頭），與周圍藍綠色的其他細胞對比明顯，代表肥大細胞顯著增加；MRI 見 C3 椎體病灶。
features: Cervical MRI: expansile lesion at C3 with spinal cord compression (arrow)
Low-power toluidine blue aspirate: cellular particle with diffuse purple metachromatic staining
High power: numerous round to oval cells whose cytoplasm is packed with coarse metachromatic purple-magenta granules (arrows), many obscuring the nucleus
Some granulated cells appear loosely clustered and slightly spindled
Non-metachromatic background hematopoietic cells stain blue-green
65181.describe_en: Cervical MRI demonstrates a C3 vertebral lesion with cord compression. Toluidine blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smears show markedly increased mast cells with abundant coarse metachromatic cytoplasmic granules, present both singly and in loose clusters, against a background of non-metachromatic hematopoietic cells. Although detailed nuclear morphology is obscured by the granules on this stain, the density of mast cells is well above that seen in reactive marrow. In conjunction with CD2/CD25 co-expression, KIT D816V and elevated tryptase, findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis, here coexisting with a plasma cell neoplasm and MDS with SF3B1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered, round and not aggregated, and lack CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V.
Basophils are also metachromatic with toluidine blue but have lobulated nuclei and water-soluble granules, are tryptase-low, and occur with a myeloproliferative background.
Plasma cells show basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof but no metachromatic granules on toluidine blue; the C3 lesion ultimately proved to be chordoma.
Mast cell leukemia requires ≥20% mast cells on aspirate smears, often atypical immature forms, and warrants a careful differential count on Romanowsky-stained smears.

65117.recognize_zh: 視野中是一群中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻，周圍有淡藍灰色細胞質並向四周伸出細長毛狀突起，是典型的毛細胞（hairy cells）；圖中並未見標題所稱吞噬紅血球的巨噬細胞。
features: Numerous medium-sized mononuclear cells, roughly 1.5-2 times red cell diameter, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei with finely stippled, ground-glass chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine, irregular hair-like projections around the entire circumference
No granules; one irregular purple cell/aggregate at the bottom without engulfed red cells
Background red cells with some echinocytes; no macrophage containing phagocytosed red cells is identified
65117.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. An irregular purple cell or aggregate is present at the bottom of the field, but no macrophage with phagocytosed red cells is seen, so the image is discordant with its title. The morphology of the lymphoid cells is consistent with circulating hairy cells, supporting the clinical diagnosis of hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing are confirmatory.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus, higher WBC, and are CD25-negative, CD123-negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi with more condensed chromatin and are typically CD103- and CD25-.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, gray vacuolated cytoplasm and lack uniform circumferential hairy projections.

ddx.dx: Artifactual cytoplasmic projections in lymphocytes (slow drying)
ddx.vs: Drying artifact affects scattered cells irregularly, whereas hairy cells show consistent fine circumferential projections with ground-glass chromatin and a distinct immunophenotype.

64477.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個大型巨噬細胞的細胞質內（箭頭）聚集多顆約 2–4 µm、卵圓形、周圍有透明暈的小酵母菌體，同一細胞內還吞噬了一個紅血球系細胞，符合播散性組織胞漿菌症（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm containing clusters of small (about 2-4 µm) oval intracellular yeast forms
Yeasts show a central basophilic dot with a clear halo/pseudocapsule (retraction artifact)
Engulfed nucleated erythroid cell/erythrocyte within macrophage cytoplasm (hemophagocytosis)
Organisms are uniform in size without visible budding on a broad base or kinetoplasts
Cellular marrow background with myeloid precursors, an eosinophil and erythrocytes
64477.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing a large macrophage whose cytoplasm harbors numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeast-like organisms with a central stained dot and surrounding clear halo (arrows). The same macrophage also contains a phagocytosed erythroid cell, indicating accompanying hemophagocytosis. Kinetoplasts are not identified. Although only one panel of the original composite is shown, the findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation by GMS stain, culture, and urine/serum Histoplasma antigen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo, and do not stain with GMS.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by fission and show a central transverse septum, whereas Histoplasma shows narrow-based budding without septa.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic, lack a halo and are GMS-negative.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable (4-10 µm) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis in bone marrow — macrophage packed with small uniform 2–4 µm intracellular yeasts with clear halos
pearls_zh: 考法：指著巨噬細胞內含透明暈的小圓體問「是什麼病原」；需與 Leishmania 區分，關鍵是有無 kinetoplast。
確認：GMS 或 PAS 染出酵母（Leishmania 為陰性）；尿液/血清 Histoplasma antigen 敏感度高，培養需時數週。
播散性組織胞漿菌症常見於 HIV（CD4 低）、使用 TNF inhibitor 或移植病人；可合併全血球減少與次發性 HLH（此圖也有吞噬血球）。
中重度播散性感染首選 liposomal amphotericin B，之後改 itraconazole 維持治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Leishmania amastigote 混淆：Leishmania 有核加桿狀 kinetoplast、無透明暈、GMS 陰性；Talaromyces marneffei 則以分裂增殖、有中央橫隔。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞內這些帶透明暈的小酵母最可能是什麼菌？哪個特殊染色可與 Leishmania 區分？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum；GMS（或 PAS）陽性，Leishmania 為陰性。

64733.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨大的多核細胞，四個大小一致、彼此分離的圓形核聚在一起，每個核都有細緻染色質，周圍是大量顆粒狀、邊緣不規則的淡紫藍色細胞質，這種「多個分開的相同核」正是破骨細胞（osteoclast）而非巨核細胞。
features: Very large cell with abundant irregular, finely to coarsely granular lilac-blue cytoplasm and ragged borders
Multiple (four) separate, discrete, round to oval nuclei of uniform size clustered centrally
Each nucleus with fine to moderately condensed chromatin and a single inconspicuous nucleolus
Nuclei are not interconnected or lobulated (unlike megakaryocyte)
Background of erythrocytes, lymphocytes and myeloid cells
64733.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large multinucleated cell with abundant granular, irregularly outlined cytoplasm containing four discrete, uniform, round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli. The nuclei are separate rather than joined or lobulated. Surrounding hematopoietic cells and red cells are unremarkable in this field. The morphology is characteristic of an osteoclast, a normal marrow constituent more frequently aspirated in children and in conditions with increased bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated, interconnected nucleus with fine azurophilic platelet granules, whereas osteoclasts have multiple separate uniform nuclei.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes
ddx.vs: Separated-lobe megakaryocytes show unequal lobes with dense chromatin and platelet-type cytoplasm, rather than equal-sized round nuclei with open chromatin and coarse granules.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor giant cell or cluster of tumor cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are pleomorphic with prominent nucleoli and separate cell membranes, while an osteoclast has one shared cytoplasm with bland identical nuclei.
Histiocytic giant cells have vacuolated foamy cytoplasm with phagocytosed material and often peripherally arranged (Langhans) or haphazard nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Osteoclast — giant multinucleated cell with multiple separate uniform round nuclei and granular cytoplasm (normal marrow constituent)
pearls_zh: 考法：與 megakaryocyte 成對考；「多個分離、大小一致的圓核」→ osteoclast，「單一多分葉相連核」→ megakaryocyte。
來源：osteoclast 由 monocyte/macrophage 系融合而成，TRAP 陽性、CD68 陽性、CD61 也可陽性（integrin αvβ3），因此不能單靠 CD61 判定為巨核細胞。
抽吸常見於兒童、骨骼重塑增加的情況（副甲狀腺功能亢進、骨折癒合、Paget disease、骨轉移周圍）。
其成對細胞 osteoblast：偏心核、核旁 hof、呈群聚，形似漿細胞但較大；兒童骨髓也常見。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 megakaryocyte（或 separated-nuclei 發育不良巨核細胞）：巨核細胞核葉彼此相連、胞質為細顆粒血小板型；dysplastic 分離核巨核細胞各核大小不一、染色質緻密。

quiz.q: 圖中含四個分開且大小一致圓核的巨大細胞是什麼？它由哪一系細胞融合而來？
quiz.a: Osteoclast；monocyte/macrophage 系。

64349.recognize_zh: 兩格中都可見大量細小（約 2–4 µm）的圓至卵形紫色小體，成群分布在破裂的巨噬細胞細胞質內或周圍，許多小體可見一個核加一個棒狀動基體（kinetoplast），這是利什曼原蟲的無鞭毛體（Leishman-Donovan bodies）。
features: Numerous small (about 2-4 um) round to oval amastigotes clustered around a macrophage nucleus (top) and in a free aggregate (bottom)
Individual organisms with a purple nucleus and a smaller dot/bar-like kinetoplast (double-dot appearance)
Parasites within pale cytoplasm of disrupted macrophages; host nucleus visible in the top panel
Background marrow hematopoietic cells (myeloid precursors, lymphocytes) and red cells
Composite of two panels; kinetoplast detail only partially resolved at this magnification
64349.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, shown as a two-panel composite, contains macrophages packed with and surrounded by numerous small round to oval intracellular organisms. Each organism measures approximately 2-4 um and shows a purple nucleus with a smaller rod-like kinetoplast, although the kinetoplast is not resolved in every organism at this magnification. The surrounding marrow shows myeloid precursors and lymphocytes without other specific findings in these fields. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo, show narrow-based budding, lack a kinetoplast and are GMS/PAS positive.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent or banana shaped and lack a kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and have no kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying macrophages or phagocytosed debris
ddx.vs: Platelets and debris vary in size without the regular nucleus-plus-kinetoplast double-dot structure of amastigotes.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis — Leishman-Donovan bodies (amastigotes with nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast) in marrow macrophages
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨噬細胞內外成群的 2–4 µm 小體，問病原與關鍵辨識構造；答 Leishmania amastigote，重點是 nucleus + 棒狀 kinetoplast。
臨床表現：發燒、明顯脾腫大、pancytopenia、多株性高 γ 球蛋白血症；visceral leishmaniasis（kala-azar）可引發 secondary HLH。
確診工具：骨髓或脾臟抽吸找 amastigote、PCR、rK39 抗體檢測；免疫低下（如 HIV）病人血清學敏感度較低。
治療：liposomal amphotericin B 是常用首選之一；台灣少見，多為境外移入或免疫低下者，需問旅遊史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Histoplasma capsulatum：Histoplasma 酵母周圍有透明光暈（pseudocapsule）且無 kinetoplast；Talaromyces marneffei 以橫隔分裂，Toxoplasma 也沒有 kinetoplast。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內小體除了核之外，還有哪個構造可與 Histoplasma 區分？
quiz.a: 棒狀的 kinetoplast（Leishman-Donovan body）。

64221.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中紅血球在薄區仍普遍疊成錢串狀（rouleaux），並帶淡藍灰色背景，只見少數小型淋巴球，提示血中有大量單株免疫球蛋白（本例 IgM 型淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤）。
features: Extensive rouleaux formation with red cells stacked in short and long chains across the field
Faint bluish-gray background staining suggestive of increased plasma protein
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
Only two small mature lymphocytes present; no circulating plasmacytoid cells or blasts seen in this field
Low-power field; leukocyte and platelet assessment limited
64221.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows prominent rouleaux formation, with red cells stacked in coin-like chains throughout the field, and a faintly bluish proteinaceous background. Red cells are otherwise normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. Two small mature lymphocytes are present, and no plasmacytoid lymphocytes or blasts are identified in this field, although leukocyte evaluation is limited at this magnification. Findings suggest a hypergammaglobulinemic state such as a monoclonal paraprotein and are compatible with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the clinical context.

ddx.vs: Agglutination forms irregular three-dimensional grape-like clumps rather than linear stacked chains and disperses on warming, whereas rouleaux disperses with saline replacement.
Artifactual overlap occurs only in the thick part of the film, whereas true rouleaux persists in the thin monolayer area as here.
Myeloma produces identical rouleaux; distinguishing requires immunofixation (IgG/IgA versus IgM) and marrow examination for a pure plasma cell versus lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia or high fibrinogen (inflammation, pregnancy)
ddx.vs: Rouleaux is typically milder, and SPEP shows a broad polyclonal increase or acute-phase pattern without an M spike.

exam.answer_en: Paraproteinemia (IgM LPL) — prominent rouleaux extending into the thin area with a bluish proteinaceous background
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍血片問紅血球排列異常名稱與代表意義；答 rouleaux，表示血漿蛋白（M 蛋白、fibrinogen 或多株 Ig）增加。
判讀要在抹片薄區（monolayer）評估：厚區紅血球本來就會重疊；薄區仍成串且背景淡藍，才有意義。
Rouleaux 使 ESR 明顯上升，並可干擾交叉試驗與自動血球計數；後續需 SPEP、immunofixation 及 serum free light chains。
本例脈絡為 IgM 型 LPL/Waldenström：注意 hyperviscosity 症狀，必要時緊急 plasmapheresis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 red cell agglutination（cold agglutinin disease）：rouleaux 是線性疊錢狀長串，agglutination 為不規則立體團塊，且加溫可散開；也要排除抹片厚區假象。

quiz.q: 此血片紅血球疊錢狀排列稱為什麼？應安排哪項檢查找原因？
quiz.a: Rouleaux formation；SPEP 加 immunofixation（找 M 蛋白）。

64157.recognize_zh: 胸部電腦斷層軸切面（縱膈窗）顯示前縱膈有一大片均質軟組織密度腫塊，位於胸骨後方、包覆升主動脈與肺動脈前方，並向兩側推擠肺葉；年輕人前縱膈大腫塊合併白血病，需想到 T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤／白血病（T-ALL/LBL）。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT in mediastinal window
Large, homogeneous soft-tissue density mass in the anterior (prevascular) mediastinum
Mass abuts and drapes anterior to the ascending aorta and main pulmonary artery
No obvious calcification or fat density within the mass on this single slice
Lungs clear on this slice; no large pleural effusion evident
64157.describe_en: This is a single axial contrast-enhanced chest CT image, not a morphologic specimen. It shows a large, relatively homogeneous soft-tissue attenuation mass occupying the anterior mediastinum, extending in front of and around the great vessels, without evident calcification or macroscopic fat on this slice. The lungs are clear and no large pleural effusion is seen at this level. In a patient with circulating lymphoblasts, a bulky anterior mediastinal mass is consistent with the thymic mass of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma; airway and superior vena cava compression should be assessed before sedation or biopsy.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma is also an anterior mediastinal mass in young patients but typically lacks leukemic blasts in blood and is diagnosed by Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells on biopsy.
PMBL appears similar radiologically but lacks TdT-positive circulating blasts and shows CD20+/CD23+/PD-L1+ large B cells on biopsy.
Teratomas contain fat, fluid, or calcification, and germ cell tumors elevate AFP/beta-hCG, unlike the homogeneous lymphoblastic mass.
Thymoma occurs in older adults, often with myasthenia gravis, and lacks circulating blasts; histology shows keratin-positive epithelial cells.

64029.recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓的單核球/巨噬細胞胞質內擠滿許多小而一致的卵圓形酵母菌，每顆周圍有透明暈（像莢膜），GMS（F）染成黑色的小型出芽酵母，在 HIV 病人中指向播散性組織漿菌症（disseminated histoplasmosis）。
features: Peripheral blood monocytes (A, B) containing numerous small intracytoplasmic oval yeast forms with an eccentric dark-staining body and a clear halo
Heavily parasitized cell in B with foamy/vacuolated cytoplasm packed with organisms
Bone marrow aspirate (C) and biopsy (D, H&E) show macrophages filled with similar uniform small yeasts
Giemsa (E) highlights intracellular organisms in marrow macrophages
GMS stain (F) shows clusters of black, uniform, small oval yeasts with occasional narrow-based budding
64029.describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood smears show monocytes containing numerous small, uniform, oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms, each with an eccentric chromatin-like body and a surrounding clear halo. The bone marrow aspirate and trephine biopsy show macrophages packed with similar organisms, which are highlighted by Giemsa and stain black with Gomori methenamine silver, including narrow-based budding forms. No extracellular hyphae are identified. Findings are consistent with disseminated Histoplasma capsulatum infection in an immunocompromised host.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast, lack a halo, and are GMS-negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are GMS-positive without a kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts are more elongated and sausage-shaped, divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding, and occur mainly in Southeast Asia.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size (4-10 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and is usually extracellular.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic and GMS-negative, and Pneumocystis cysts are cup-shaped without budding and rarely intracellular in blood.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis — small uniform intracellular yeasts with clear halo in monocytes/macrophages, GMS-positive budding forms
pearls_zh: 考法：周邊血單核球內的小顆粒「是什麼」；答 Histoplasma capsulatum 酵母菌（約 2–4 μm），並說出 GMS/PAS 陽性、窄基出芽。
與 Leishmania 區分是必考：Leishmania amastigote 有核與棒狀 kinetoplast，GMS 陰性；Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、GMS 染黑。
與 Talaromyces marneffei 區分：後者以分裂（fission）繁殖，可見橫隔（transverse septum），不出芽；流行於東南亞，HIV 病人需鑑別。
診斷與治療：尿液/血清 Histoplasma antigen、培養；重症播散性感染以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，後續 itraconazole；可繼發 HLH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 周邊白血球內的顆粒易被當成中毒性顆粒或血小板重疊；酵母菌大小一致、有清楚透明暈與偏心染色點，GMS 染色即可確認為真菌。

quiz.q: 圖中單核球/巨噬細胞內的病原體為何？哪個特殊染色可將其染成黑色？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum 酵母菌（播散性組織漿菌症）；GMS（Gomori methenamine silver）

63773.recognize_zh: 這是影像學圖片而非形態學：左為矢狀面 CT、右為融合 PET-CT，脊椎多個椎體內出現局部高代謝（黃亮）病灶，代表多發性骨髓病灶，需再以骨髓切片確認病因。
features: Sagittal CT (left) and fused PET-CT MPR (right) of the head, neck and trunk
Multiple discrete foci of increased FDG uptake within thoracic and lumbar vertebral bodies on the fused image
Additional hypermetabolic foci anterior to the lumbar spine in the abdomen, of uncertain site at this resolution
Corresponding CT shows no obvious destructive or sclerotic vertebral lesion at this resolution
Physiologic brain uptake at the top of the fused image
63773.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic radiology image showing paired sagittal CT and fused FDG PET-CT reconstructions. The fused image demonstrates multiple discrete hypermetabolic foci within the thoracic and lumbar vertebral bodies, with additional hypermetabolic foci in the abdomen anterior to the spine, while the CT window shows no obvious corresponding lytic or sclerotic change at this resolution. Multifocal FDG-avid marrow lesions are nonspecific and may reflect granulomatous infection, lymphoma, myeloma or metastatic disease; tissue sampling is required. In this case context, the findings are consistent with multifocal marrow involvement by a granulomatous (tubercular) process.

ddx.vs: PET pattern can be identical, so bone marrow or nodal biopsy showing lymphoma rather than necrotizing granulomas with acid-fast bacilli is required.
Metastases are often associated with a known primary and lytic or sclerotic CT changes, and biopsy shows cohesive keratin-positive epithelial clusters.
Myeloma typically shows punched-out lytic lesions on CT with a serum/urine M-protein and clonal plasma cells on marrow biopsy.

ddx.dx: Reactive diffuse marrow hyperplasia (e.g. G-CSF effect)
ddx.vs: Growth-factor or reactive uptake is diffuse and homogeneous throughout the axial marrow rather than discrete focal lesions.

63965.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片而非顯微鏡圖：左手背、腕部到前臂有大片藍黑色出血性壞死與張力性血泡，邊緣呈暗紫色，同時胸腹與上臂布滿紅紫色瘀點瘀斑；在嚴重再生不良性貧血合併敗血症的背景下，符合猛爆性紫斑（purpura fulminans）。
features: Large confluent blue-black hemorrhagic necrosis over the dorsum of the left hand, wrist and forearm
Tense hemorrhagic bullae and blisters overlying the necrotic area
Irregular dusky violaceous border extending onto the forearm and a finger
Widespread petechial and small purpuric macules over the chest, abdomen and upper arm
Hospitalized patient with intravenous lines and monitoring leads
63965.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic clinical photograph of an adult inpatient. The dorsum of the left hand, wrist and forearm shows extensive, sharply demarcated blue-black hemorrhagic necrosis with overlying tense hemorrhagic bullae and a dusky violaceous margin, while the trunk and upper arm show widespread petechiae and small purpuric macules. In a severely neutropenic and thrombocytopenic patient with sepsis, the appearance is consistent with purpura fulminans, and evaluation for disseminated intravascular coagulation, protein C deficiency and invasive infection is warranted.

ddx.vs: Ecthyma gangrenosum forms discrete necrotic ulcers with a black eschar and erythematous halo, whereas purpura fulminans produces confluent retiform hemorrhagic necrosis with DIC and low protein C.

ddx.dx: Necrotizing soft tissue infection (e.g. mucormycosis or necrotizing fasciitis)
ddx.vs: Deep infection shows crepitus or rapidly spreading pain with tissue culture or biopsy revealing invading organisms rather than dermal vessel microthrombi.
Drug-induced necrosis follows recent warfarin initiation or heparin exposure with a positive platelet factor 4 antibody test, typically over fatty areas.
Isolated severe thrombocytopenia produces petechiae and ecchymoses but not hemorrhagic bullae with full-thickness skin necrosis.

63837.recognize_zh: 右上方的超大細胞有大量淡粉紅、細顆粒狀細胞質與多分葉的核，是成熟巨核細胞；左下方細胞較小、核大而圓、細胞質深藍且邊緣有泡狀突起，是未成熟（嗜鹼性）巨核細胞；兩者並列正好示範巨核細胞的成熟階段。
features: Very large mature megakaryocyte with abundant pale pink, finely granular cytoplasm and a compact multilobulated nucleus (upper right)
Immature megakaryocyte with a large round, dense nucleus, high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with peripheral blebs (lower left)
Faint granules and budding at the periphery of the immature cell
Background mixed hematopoietic cells including erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and a band neutrophil
Scattered platelets and red cells in a thick aspirate background
63837.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows megakaryocytes at different stages of maturation. A mature megakaryocyte has abundant pale eosinophilic, finely granular cytoplasm and a lobulated nucleus, while an immature megakaryocyte has a large round nucleus with dense chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with surface blebs. The background contains trilineage hematopoietic elements without increased blasts in this field. Findings illustrate normal megakaryocytic maturation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, evenly sized round nuclei with visible nucleoli and coarser cytoplasmic granules, whereas the megakaryocyte nucleus is a single connected lobulated mass.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes (MDS)
ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes show widely separated, discrete round nuclear lobes or micromegakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei, rather than a compact contiguous lobulated nucleus.

Megakaryoblasts are smaller with finer chromatin and nucleoli and occur in excess, and metastatic cells form cohesive clusters, whereas this immature megakaryocyte is an isolated large cell with platelet-type budding confirmed by CD61/CD42b if needed.

exam.answer_en: Normal megakaryocyte maturation — mature lobulated megakaryocyte beside an immature basophilic megakaryocyte
pearls_zh: 考官會分別指兩顆大細胞問成熟度：右上為成熟巨核細胞，左下為未成熟（basophilic）巨核細胞。
巨核細胞經 endomitosis 成為多倍體，核不分離而呈相連多葉；看到分開的圓核要想到 osteoclast 或 MDS 異形巨核細胞。
骨髓巨核細胞數量是鑑別 ITP（數量正常或增加）與生成不良性血小板低下的重點。
系列確認可用 CD61、CD41、CD42b；megakaryoblast 在 flow 上同樣表現這些抗原。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 osteoclast：osteoclast 有多個分開、大小一致的圓核，巨核細胞是單一相連的分葉核。

quiz.q: 左下方核圓、胞質深藍且有泡狀突起的大細胞是什麼？
quiz.a: Immature (basophilic) megakaryocyte

63709.recognize_zh: 四格免疫染色：CD4 在低倍下瀰漫陽性、CD56 呈膜狀陽性、CD163 有散在強陽性細胞，最關鍵的是 NPM1 紅色染色同時出現在細胞核與細胞質（異位的細胞質 NPM1），提示 NPM1 突變的骨髓性肉瘤。
features: Panel A: diffuse moderate CD4 positivity of the dermal infiltrate at low power
Panel B: membranous CD56 staining in many neoplastic cells
Panel C: CD163 highlights numerous cells with strong cytoplasmic staining, patchy with admixed negative cells
Panel D: NPM1 immunostain (red chromogen) with both nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in tumor cells
Adjacent stromal/endothelial nuclei show nuclear-restricted or negative NPM1 staining for comparison
63709.describe_en: Additional immunohistochemical stains on the skin biopsy show that the neoplastic infiltrate is diffusely positive for CD4 and shows membranous CD56 expression. CD163 highlights numerous cells in a patchy pattern, and a portion of the staining may reflect admixed reactive macrophages. The NPM1 immunostain demonstrates aberrant cytoplasmic as well as nuclear staining in tumor cells, a pattern that is a surrogate for NPM1 exon 12 mutation. Together with reported negativity for MPO, CD34, CD117, CD123, TCL1 and lymphoid markers (not shown), findings support myeloid sarcoma with monocytic differentiation and probable NPM1 mutation.

ddx.vs: BPDCN shares CD4 and CD56 positivity but is CD123 and TCL1 positive and lacks cytoplasmic NPM1, as well as monocytic markers such as CD163 and lysozyme.
Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56 positive but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and cytotoxic granules and is EBER positive, with nuclear-only NPM1.
Wild-type cases show nucleus-restricted NPM1 staining, and sequencing is needed to confirm the mutation suggested by cytoplasmic staining.

63645.recognize_zh: 上方箭頭指的紅血球邊緣有一個透明泡狀區（blister cell），左下箭頭指的紅血球內有一顆小而圓的深紫色點（Howell-Jolly body，提示脾功能低下），右下角還有有核紅血球（nucleated RBC）。
features: Blister cell with a clear, hemoglobin-free peripheral vacuole (arrow)
Red cell containing a single small, round, dense purple inclusion consistent with a Howell-Jolly body (arrow)
Nucleated red blood cells (lower right and upper right)
Anisocytosis with polychromatic macrocytes and small dense irregularly contracted cells
Occasional neutrophils and a smudged degenerated cell (top center)
63645.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with polychromatic macrocytes and small dense irregularly contracted red cells. A blister cell with a clear peripheral hemoglobin-free vacuole and a red cell containing a Howell-Jolly body are indicated by arrows, and nucleated red blood cells are present. A smudged degenerated cell and occasional neutrophils are also seen. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis with marrow response in a patient with a hemoglobin disorder, with Howell-Jolly bodies indicating hyposplenism (autosplenectomy in sickle cell disease).

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple small peripheral clustered granules that stain with Prussian blue, whereas a Howell-Jolly body is a single larger round DNA remnant.
An overlying platelet shows granular texture with a pale halo and lies in a different focal plane, unlike the uniformly dense round Howell-Jolly body.
Keratocytes are formed when a blister ruptures, leaving two horn-like projections, and occur with schistocytes and thrombocytopenia.
Basophilic stippling consists of numerous fine or coarse blue granules distributed throughout the cell rather than a single discrete dot.

63517.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片的紅血球大多正常，只有少數未增大的紅血球內可見細小環狀滋養體（ring forms）與小染色質點，無色素、無配子體，符合低寄生蟲量的巴貝西蟲感染（low-level babesiosis）。
features: Low parasite burden: only occasional red cells contain small intraerythrocytic parasites
Tiny ring-like trophozoites and dot forms with minimal cytoplasm
Infected red cells are normal in size without stippling
No hemozoin pigment, gametocytes, schizonts, or tetrad forms in this field
Background normocytic red cells with occasional polychromatophilic cells and a few platelets
63517.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows largely normocytic normochromic red cells with occasional polychromatophilic cells. A small number of red cells contain tiny ring-like trophozoites and dot forms without red cell enlargement, stippling, or pigment. Gametocytes, schizonts, and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms are not identified in this field, and the overall parasitemia is low. In the appropriate clinical and epidemiologic context, findings are consistent with low-level babesiosis; a formal parasitemia count and PCR confirmation are recommended, with close follow-up because burden can rise rapidly in high-risk hosts.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum rings are uniform with accolé and double-chromatin forms and may show crescent gametocytes, whereas species separation at low parasitemia relies on travel history, antigen testing, or PCR.
Superimposed platelets are granular and often surrounded by a halo, lying in a different focal plane rather than forming a ring within the cell.
These are solid basophilic dots without a surrounding ring of parasite cytoplasm.
Artifacts are refractile or scattered across cells and background rather than consistently intracellular ring structures.

63325.recognize_zh: 四格抹片中以箭頭標出：綠箭頭為胞質一側呈空泡狀的水泡細胞（blister cells），粉紅箭頭為小而無中央淡染的微球形細胞（microspherocytes），紫箭頭為碎片細胞（schistocyte），藍箭頭為多染性紅血球，紅箭頭為有核紅血球；合併起來是 COVID-19 相關 DIC 的紅血球變化。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis
Numerous blister cells: red cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a clear membrane vesicle (green arrows)
Microspherocytes: small dense red cells lacking central pallor (pink arrows)
Occasional schistocytes/fragmented red cells (purple arrow)
Polychromatophilic macrocytes (blue arrows) and a nucleated red blood cell (red arrow)
Leukocytes including neutrophils and a monocyte; platelets present but not markedly clumped
63325.describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear (panels A-D) shows marked anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous blister cells with eccentric hemoglobin retraction and clear membrane vesicles, together with microspherocytes, occasional schistocytes, polychromatophilic red cells and a nucleated red blood cell. Neutrophils and a monocyte are present. The combination of fragmented red cells and microspherocytes is consistent with microangiopathic/consumptive hemolysis in COVID-19-associated disseminated intravascular coagulation; the prominence of blister cells should prompt exclusion of oxidant injury such as G6PD deficiency.

ddx.vs: Oxidant hemolysis shows blister and bite cells with Heinz bodies on supravital stain and few true schistocytes, with low G6PD activity.
TTP shows schistocytes with severe thrombocytopenia but normal PT/aPTT and ADAMTS13 activity below 10%.
These show spherocytes without schistocytes or blister cells and have normal coagulation studies.
Keratocytes have paired horn-like projections from a ruptured vesicle, whereas blister cells retain an intact clear vesicle.

exam.answer_en: COVID-19-associated DIC/consumptive hemolysis — schistocytes, microspherocytes and blister cells with polychromasia and a nucleated RBC
pearls_zh: 考法：多格箭頭圖逐一問名稱：blister cell、microspherocyte、schistocyte、polychromatophilic cell、NRBC；再問整體機轉（微血管病變性/消耗性溶血）。
DIC 檢查：PT/aPTT 延長、fibrinogen 下降、D-dimer 上升、血小板下降；ISTH overt DIC score ≥5 支持診斷。
COVID-19 凝血病變以 D-dimer 顯著升高、血栓風險增加為特色，fibrinogen 常偏高；典型 overt DIC 較少見，多出現在重症晚期，D-dimer 升高與不良預後相關。
看到 blister/bite cells 需排除 G6PD deficiency 或氧化藥物；schistocytes 伴血小板低而凝血功能正常時要想到 TTP（ADAMTS13 <10%）。
ICSH 建議在單層區計數 schistocytes，>1% 支持 thrombotic microangiopathy。
exam.pitfall_zh: blister cell 易被誤認為 keratocyte 或 schistocyte：blister cell 保留完整的透明膜泡，keratocyte 是膜泡破裂後留下一對角狀突起。

quiz.q: 綠箭頭所指、一側呈透明空泡的紅血球稱為什麼？看到大量此類細胞應排除哪種酵素缺乏？
quiz.a: Blister cell；G6PD deficiency

63261.recognize_zh: 油鏡下一個大型淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍色，其中含有數顆明顯粗大、圓形的紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（大小接近紅血球的五分之一），類似 pseudo-Chediak-Higashi 顆粒；這種帶粗大顆粒的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）是 T-LGL 白血病的形態線索。
features: Large lymphoid cell, roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of an adjacent red cell
Moderate N:C ratio with an oval, slightly indented nucleus and moderately condensed, clumped chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with an angular, slightly irregular outline
Few coarse, round, deep red-purple azurophilic granules (giant granules) in the cytoplasm, mimicking pseudo-Chediak-Higashi inclusions
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis (occasional teardrop/irregular forms) and scattered platelets
63261.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a large granular lymphocyte with a moderately condensed, oval to slightly indented nucleus and abundant pale blue cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains a few coarse, round, red-purple azurophilic granules that are strikingly larger than typical LGL granules, resembling pseudo-Chediak-Higashi inclusions. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis, and platelets are present. In the context of a persistent clonal T-cell population, the findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Chediak-Higashi syndrome shows giant granules in all granulocytes and most lymphocytes in a child with oculocutaneous albinism and infections, whereas here the giant granules are confined to an expanded clonal LGL population in an adult.
Reactive LGLs (viral infection, post-splenectomy) have fine small azurophilic granules, are transient and polyclonal, lacking the persistent clonal TCR rearrangement of T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGLs are morphologically identical but are surface CD3-negative and CD16/CD56-positive on flow cytometry.
In myeloid neoplasms giant granules occur in blasts or granulocytic precursors that are MPO-positive, not in mature lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia — large granular lymphocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm and coarse azurophilic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：指胞質淡藍、含紅紫色粗顆粒的大淋巴球問名稱（LGL），再問下一步：flow cytometry 與 TCR 克隆性確認。
Flow：CD3+、CD8+、CD57+，CD16 常陽性、CD56 多陰性，CD5/CD7 常弱表現；以 TCR gene rearrangement 或 TCR Vβ/TRBC1 flow 證明克隆性。
分子：約三到四成帶 STAT3 SH2 domain 突變（STAT5B 較少），STAT3 突變與中性球減少相關。
臨床：中性球減少與反覆感染、純紅血球再生不良（PRCA）、合併 rheumatoid arthritis；治療以 methotrexate、cyclophosphamide 或 cyclosporine 為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性 LGL 或 NK 細胞增生：反應性 LGL 顆粒細小、多株且短暫；NK-LGL 為 surface CD3−、CD16/CD56+，需靠 flow 與 TCR 克隆性區分。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞的名稱為何？要證明為 T-LGL 白血病需哪兩類檢查？
quiz.a: Large granular lymphocyte；flow cytometry（CD3+CD8+CD57+）與 TCR gene rearrangement 克隆性分析

63197.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中幾乎所有紅血球都是寬卵圓形，很多細胞中央有裂隙狀口形，黑箭頭指 V 形、藍箭頭指 Y 形的口形，部分細胞不只一個 stoma；這種卵圓形口形紅血球是東南亞卵圓形紅血球症（SAO）的表現。
features: Nearly uniform population of broad oval red cells (macro-ovalocytes)
Stomatocytic slits within many ovalocytes, including V-shaped (black arrows) and Y-shaped (blue arrow) stomas
Some cells with two or more stomas
No spherocytes, schistocytes or significant polychromasia
Small lymphocyte at upper left and scattered platelets
63197.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at medium power shows a nearly uniform population of broad oval red cells (macro-ovalocytes), many containing slit-like stomas. Several stomas are V-shaped (black arrows) or Y-shaped (blue arrow), and some cells have more than one stoma. Spherocytes, schistocytes and significant polychromasia are not seen; a small lymphocyte and scattered platelets are present. Findings are consistent with Southeast Asian ovalocytosis, which can be confirmed by SLC4A1 27-bp deletion testing.

ddx.vs: Cells are elongated elliptocytes with parallel sides and no stomatocytic slits.
Stomatocytes are round with a single central slit rather than oval cells with multiple, V- or Y-shaped stomas.
Artifactual slits appear only in thick areas and in round cells, not in uniformly oval cells in the monolayer.

exam.answer_en: Southeast Asian ovalocytosis — near-uniform macro-ovalocytes with V- and Y-shaped and multiple stomas
pearls_zh: 考法：中倍視野整片均一寬卵圓細胞，要同時講出「ovalocyte＋V/Y 形或多重 stoma」；只說 elliptocytosis 會被扣分。
形態與臨床不成比例是考點：幾乎全部紅血球變形，但網狀紅血球、LDH、膽紅素常接近正常，多數成人無需治療。
新生兒期可出現較明顯溶血與高膽紅素血症，之後多逐漸緩解，家族史與父母抹片有助診斷。
band 3 同時是腎臟 α-intercalated cell 的 AE1；SAO 與其他 SLC4A1 突變的複合異型合子可合併遠端腎小管酸中毒（dRTA）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易當成厚片區乾燥假影的 stomatocyte；假影只出現在厚區且為圓形細胞，此處是單層區均一卵圓形細胞帶多種形狀 stoma。

quiz.q: 藍箭頭所指 stoma 的形狀為何？這種細胞與 hereditary elliptocytosis 的 elliptocyte 如何區分？
quiz.a: Y 形 stoma；SAO 為寬卵圓且有裂隙，HE 為細長、兩側平行且無 stoma

63069.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片（cytospin）乾淨背景中，出現數顆中等大小、核質比高、染色質細緻且核有凹陷的單一型態母細胞，而不是成熟小淋巴球或單核球。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cells, roughly 1.5-2x the diameter of adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round to indented/cleaved nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous to small; no cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Monotonous population on a clean, acellular background with a few crenated red cells
63069.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a paucicellular, clean background containing a monotonous population of medium-sized blasts. The cells have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Mature small lymphocytes, monocytes and neutrophils are not seen in this field. In a patient with known B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with CNS involvement by B-lymphoblastic leukemia, confirmed by flow cytometry (CD19+, CD10+, CD22+).

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF lymphocytes are a mixed population with mature condensed chromatin and variable cytoplasm, not uniform fine-chromatin blasts.
Monocytoid cells have more abundant grey vacuolated cytoplasm and folded nuclei with lower N:C ratio.

ddx.dx: Traumatic tap with peripheral blood contamination
ddx.vs: A bloody tap shows numerous red cells with blood-proportional leukocytes, whereas this sample is clean with a predominant blast population.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by AML or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology alone cannot reliably separate lineage; flow cytometry showing CD19/CD10/CD22 without myeloid markers establishes B-lymphoblasts.

exam.answer_en: CNS relapse of B-lymphoblastic leukemia — CSF cytospin with monotonous blasts (high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, indented nuclei) on a clean background
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 CSF 中的單一型態細胞問「是母細胞還是反應性淋巴球／單核球」，並接著問 CNS 分級。
CNS status：CNS1 無母細胞；CNS2 WBC <5/µL 但有母細胞；CNS3 WBC ≥5/µL 且有母細胞（或腦神經麻痺等臨床表現），影響鞘內與全身治療強度。
CSF flow cytometry（CD19+、CD10+、CD22+）比 cytospin 形態更敏感，細胞少時仍可偵測；檢體需儘速處理，細胞在 CSF 中易退化。
Ph+ B-ALL 須用 TKI；CNS 復發時 CNS 穿透性與鞘內治療的選擇是臨床重點，無症狀 CSF 復發亦需治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為反應性淋巴球或創傷性穿刺帶入的血液細胞；反應性為混合族群、染色質成熟，創傷性穿刺會有大量紅血球，此片乾淨背景中是單一型態母細胞。

quiz.q: CSF 中 WBC 為 3/µL 但 cytospin 見到這些母細胞，屬於 CNS 幾級？
quiz.a: CNS2（WBC <5/µL 且有 blasts）

63133.recognize_zh: Kappa 輕鏈原位雜交中，大量藍黑色陽性漿細胞呈帶狀、群聚分布，與 lambda 染色對照後比值仍屬多株性，排除輕鏈限制性的漿細胞腫瘤或 MALT 淋巴瘤。
features: In situ hybridization for kappa light chain mRNA (blue chromogen), low power
Numerous positive plasma cells in bands, clusters, and scattered single cells
Density moderately greater than lambda-positive cells on the paired stain
Adipose tissue at right edge and fibrous stroma are negative
No sheet-like monotypic population
63133.describe_en: In situ hybridization for kappa light chain highlights numerous plasma cells arranged in bands, clusters, and scattered single cells throughout a fibrotic stroma, with adjacent adipose tissue at the edge. Kappa-positive cells are moderately more numerous than lambda-positive cells on the paired stain, a ratio within the polytypic range and not indicative of light-chain restriction. Findings support a reactive polytypic plasma cell infiltrate, consistent with the plasmacytic component of extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows light-chain restricted plasma cells (kappa:lambda markedly skewed) with a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate, unlike the polytypic plasma cells of RDD.
Plasmacytoma consists of sheets of monotypic plasma cells, without the S100+ emperipolesis-rich histiocytes of RDD.
IgG4-RD also has polytypic plasma cells but shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis, and lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.

63005.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見中至大型母細胞樣細胞，核不規則或呈腎形、染色質細緻，胞質灰藍色且無顆粒，部分有類似偽足的突出；組織中為單調的母細胞樣浸潤，TCL1 與 TCF4 強陽性，皮膚切片則為真皮至皮下的密集浸潤而表皮不受累，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）的白血病型表現。
features: Medium to large blastoid cells with irregular, reniform or indented nuclei and fine chromatin (A)
Moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, occasionally with tail-like or pseudopod projections (A)
Diffuse monomorphous infiltrate of blastoid cells in tissue (B)
Strong diffuse TCL1 (cytoplasmic/nuclear) and nuclear TCF4 immunostaining (C)
Skin biopsy: dense dermal and subcutaneous infiltrate with sparing of the epidermis; inset shows blastoid cells (D)
63005.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear contains medium to large blastoid cells with irregular to reniform nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic projections (A). A tissue section shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of similar blastoid cells (B), which are strongly positive for TCL1 and TCF4 (C). A skin biopsy shows a dense infiltrate filling the dermis and extending into subcutaneous fat, with sparing of the epidermis (D). Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm presenting in a leukemic phase; confirmation of CD123, CD4 and CD56 expression with absence of lineage-specific myeloid, T- and B-cell markers is required.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (leukemia cutis)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML may involve skin with folded nuclei but is usually lysozyme/CD14/CD11c-positive and lacks coexpression of TCF4 and TCL1 with bright CD123.

ddx.dx: AML with mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation
ddx.vs: In this entity the pDC are mature-appearing and accompany a separate myeloid blast population, usually with RUNX1 mutation, rather than forming the neoplastic blast population.
T-lymphoblasts express cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT with scant cytoplasm, whereas BPDCN cells lack CD3 and have more abundant gray cytoplasm.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56-positive but EBER-positive with angiocentric necrosis and cytotoxic granules, and is CD123- and TCF4-negative.

62941.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片細胞量偏高，可見數個顏色較淡、界線不清的間質性淋巴組織球結節，散布在骨小樑之間，其餘骨髓仍有正常三系造血（含巨核細胞）；低倍只能提示「淋巴組織球性病灶」，需要高倍與免疫染色才能定性。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with multiple ill-defined interstitial nodules
Nodules are paler than surrounding marrow, suggestive of histiocyte-rich composition
Nodules are non-paratrabecular, located between bony trabeculae
Intervening marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes
Preserved bony trabeculae without obvious fibrosis at this magnification
62941.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow containing multiple ill-defined, pale interstitial lymphohistiocytic nodules that are not paratrabecular. The intervening marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes, and bony trabeculae are unremarkable. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Such lymphohistiocytic nodules warrant high-power evaluation and immunohistochemistry; in this case they represent involvement by T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, few, well-circumscribed, and non-paratrabecular without histiocyte-rich pale nodules or atypical large cells.
Granulomas are compact epithelioid clusters, may contain giant cells or necrosis, and lack large atypical B cells on IHC.
FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates of small cleaved cells rather than interstitial histiocyte-rich nodules.
Mast cell lesions are paratrabecular or perivascular spindle-cell aggregates with eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.

62877.recognize_zh: CD56 與 Granzyme B 在浸潤淋巴球中幾乎陰性，TIA-1 呈瀰漫顆粒狀陽性、TCR-BF1（βF1）陽性，表示為 αβ 型、非活化型細胞毒性 T 細胞，符合惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的免疫表型。
features: CD56: infiltrate negative, only scattered weak staining in stromal elements
Granzyme B: essentially negative in the lamina propria infiltrate
TIA-1: diffuse granular cytoplasmic positivity in the lamina propria lymphocytes
TCR-BF1 (beta F1): positive in the majority of infiltrating lymphocytes, indicating alpha-beta T-cell lineage
Crypt epithelium negative in all panels
62877.describe_en: Immunohistochemical panel of colonic mucosa shows that the lamina propria lymphoid infiltrate is negative for CD56 and granzyme B, while TIA-1 shows diffuse granular cytoplasmic staining and TCR-BF1 (beta F1) is expressed by most lymphocytes. This profile indicates an alpha-beta T-cell population with a non-activated cytotoxic phenotype (TIA-1 positive, granzyme B negative). The panel labeled Gr-B corresponds to the title's Gr-8. Findings are consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: MEITL is typically CD56-positive and often TCR gamma-delta or TCR-silent, unlike this CD56-negative, beta F1-positive infiltrate.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56-positive with granzyme B expression (activated cytotoxic phenotype) and EBER positivity.
Gamma-delta lymphomas are beta F1-negative and TCR-delta positive with activated cytotoxic markers.

62877.stain: IHC: CD56, granzyme B, TIA-1, TCR-BF1

62749.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片漿細胞，cyclin D1 強陽性；kappa 與 lambda 免疫染色竟然都呈強陽性，流式也顯示同一群 CD38/CD138 漿細胞同時表現胞質 kappa 與 lambda，這種雙輕鏈表現就是雙表型（biphenotypic）漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with interstitial sheets of plasma cells replacing hematopoiesis (H&E)
Neoplastic plasma cells show strong nuclear cyclin D1 expression
Both kappa and lambda immunostains strongly label the same diffuse plasma cell infiltrate
Flow: CD38/CD138-positive population co-expresses cytoplasmic kappa and cytoplasmic lambda
No discrete polytypic admixture pattern; staining is diffuse rather than mixed scattered cells
62749.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with extensive interstitial and sheet-like infiltration by plasma cells. The plasma cells are diffusely positive for cyclin D1. In situ light chain stains show strong, diffuse labeling of the infiltrate for both kappa and lambda, and flow cytometry demonstrates that the CD38/CD138-positive plasma cell population co-expresses cytoplasmic kappa and lambda light chains. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with a biphenotypic (dual light chain) expression pattern; CCND1 rearrangement (t(11;14)) testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered, cyclin D1-negative, and show separate kappa-positive and lambda-positive cells at roughly 2:1, not co-expression in a single population on flow.
Biclonal myeloma contains two distinct plasma cell populations, one kappa and one lambda, which separate on flow cytometry rather than co-expressing both light chains.
Serum immunoglobulin uptake gives weak diffuse interstitial background, whereas true dual expression is confirmed here by cytoplasmic flow cytometry in the same gated cells.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MCL is also cyclin D1-positive but shows CD5-positive, CD20-positive small lymphoid cells rather than a CD38/CD138-bright plasma cell population.

62749.stain: H&E; IHC: cyclin D1, kappa, lambda; flow cytometry

62621.recognize_zh: 積液細胞塊中可見數團及散在的大型不典型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、核仁明顯，細胞互不黏著，背景是淡粉紅色蛋白質與纖維蛋白碎屑，沒有腺體結構，符合原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL）。
features: Multiple loose clusters and single large atypical lymphoid cells
Round to oval nuclei with prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Discohesive arrangement without true cell junctions, glands or papillae
Admixed red blood cells within clusters
Pale eosinophilic proteinaceous and fibrinous background
62621.describe_en: Cell block of effusion fluid shows several loose aggregates and scattered single large atypical lymphoid cells within a pale proteinaceous and fibrinous background. The cells have round to oval nuclei with prominent nucleoli and a moderate amount of amphophilic cytoplasm, and they lack cohesive epithelial architecture. Mesothelial sheets and gland formation are not identified. Findings are consistent with involvement of the effusion by a large cell lymphoma, and in the context of HHV8 LANA-1 positivity and a null or plasmablastic immunophenotype, with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin positive and CD45 negative.
It expresses CD20/CD79a and is negative for HHV8 LANA-1, whereas PEL typically lacks B-cell antigens and is LANA-1 positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple small nucleoli and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, and are CD10+/BCL2- with MYC rearrangement.

62557.recognize_zh: 高倍下腫瘤細胞中到大型、核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻並有小核仁，胞質少；到處可見核分裂、凋亡小體與帶透明暈的吞噬性巨噬細胞，細胞大小比典型 Burkitt 稍不均一，是雙打擊淋巴瘤常見的「介於中間」形態。
features: Medium to large cells, somewhat variable in size, with round to oval nuclei
Finely granular to vesicular chromatin with one or more small nucleoli
Scant amphophilic cytoplasm with molded, closely packed nuclei
Numerous mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies with tingible-body macrophages in clear halos
Thin fibrovascular septa and a small vessel with erythrocytes
62557.describe_en: High-power H&E shows diffuse sheets of medium to large lymphoid cells with round to oval, closely packed nuclei, finely granular to vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and scant amphophilic cytoplasm. Cell size is mildly variable, and there is brisk mitotic activity with abundant apoptotic bodies and tingible-body macrophages surrounded by clear halos. Thin fibrovascular septa traverse the infiltrate. The cytology is intermediate between Burkitt lymphoma and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and, with the FISH findings in this case, is consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are more uniform, medium-sized with multiple small nucleoli, BCL2-negative and lack BCL2 rearrangement.
DLBCL cells are usually larger with more open chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and lack double rearrangement.
HGBL-NOS shares blastoid or intermediate morphology but lacks MYC with BCL2 rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1- and SOX11-positive.

exam.answer_en: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements — intermediate-sized cells with numerous mitoses and starry-sky tingible-body macrophages
pearls_zh: 考法：看到 starry-sky、分裂像多的中大型 B 細胞，考官會問「Burkitt 還是 double-hit？」並要求說出要做的 IHC（BCL2、Ki-67）與 FISH。
形態只能提示不能確診：double-hit 可呈 DLBCL 樣、Burkitt 樣或介於中間（blastoid）形態，診斷需 FISH 證明 MYC 與 BCL2 同時重排。
免疫表型：多為 GCB 型（CD10+、BCL6+），BCL2 常陽性；Burkitt lymphoma 則 BCL2 陰性或弱、Ki-67 接近 100%。
WHO 5th 已取消以形態定義的「HGBL with MYC and BCL6」，只有 MYC + BCL2 重排構成獨立類別；無雙重重排的中間型形態稱 HGBL, NOS。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 Burkitt lymphoma：Burkitt 細胞大小極一致、BCL2 陰性、MYC 與 IG 易位且無 BCL2 重排；本例細胞大小較不均、BCL2 常強陽性。

quiz.q: 這種 starry-sky 形態的 B 細胞淋巴瘤若 BCL2 強陽性，下一步應做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: MYC、BCL2（及 BCL6）FISH 以排除 double-hit

62493.recognize_zh: 高度細胞化骨髓中有大量體積小、細胞核低分葉（hypolobated）的「侏儒型」巨核細胞（dwarf megakaryocytes），成群聚集，並伴顆粒球增生，是 CML 骨髓切片的經典樣貌。
features: Numerous small megakaryocytes with hypolobated, round to oval nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm (dwarf megakaryocytes)
Megakaryocytes loosely clustered in the center of the field
Hypercellular marrow with marked granulocytic proliferation
Reduced fat; no sheets of blasts in this field
62493.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic hyperplasia and a marked increase in megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are predominantly small with hypolobated nuclei and form loose clusters. Blasts are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are characteristic of CML; prominent sheets or clusters of small, dysplastic megakaryocytes accompanied by marked fibrosis were an accelerated-phase feature in WHO 2016.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with large, hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei rather than small and hypolobated, and the disease is BCR::ABL1 negative.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, and granulocytic proliferation is minimal.
Del(5q) MDS shows small monolobated megakaryocytes but with a normocellular to hypocellular marrow, anemia and no granulocytic hyperplasia.

exam.answer_en: CML bone marrow — hypercellular marrow with granulocytic hyperplasia and clusters of small hypolobated (dwarf) megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指著小而核分葉少的巨核細胞，問名稱（dwarf megakaryocyte）與代表的 MPN；這種巨核細胞是 CML 與其他 BCR::ABL1 陰性 MPN 鑑別的重點。
MPN 巨核細胞比較：CML 小而低分葉；PMF 大小不一、核濃染呈雲朵狀且成簇；ET 巨大、核高度分葉（staghorn）。
進展評估：骨髓切片要找 CD34 陽性 blasts 群集與網狀纖維化，並用 reticulin 染色分級；成片 blasts 提示 blast phase。
確診仍需分子：BCR::ABL1（FISH 或 RT-PCR）；形態像 CML 但 BCR::ABL1 陰性時，要考慮 aCML（SETBP1、ASXL1）或 CNL（CSF3R）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 dwarf megakaryocytes 誤認為 MDS 的 micromegakaryocytes：MDS 背景多為發育不良、細胞量不一定高；CML 背景為高度細胞化、顆粒球增生且 BCR::ABL1 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中聚集的小型低分葉巨核細胞稱為什麼？最典型見於哪個 MPN？
quiz.a: Dwarf megakaryocytes；CML（BCR::ABL1 陽性）

62429.recognize_zh: CD10 免疫染色中整片單形性腫瘤細胞完全呈藍色陰性，只有少數血管/基質呈淡棕色可作為內部對照；典型伯奇氏淋巴瘤（Burkitt lymphoma）應為 CD10 陽性，所以這張 CD10 陰性的結果屬於少見情況，需重新審視診斷並依靠 MYC 檢測與其他標記。
features: Diffuse monotonous sheet of tumor cells negative for CD10
Faint staining limited to scattered vessels/stromal elements (internal positive control)
Medium-sized round nuclei on hematoxylin counterstain
No membranous staining of tumor cells
No germinal center-like CD10-positive clusters in this field
62429.describe_en: CD10 immunostain shows a diffuse, monotonous population of medium-sized tumor cells that are negative for CD10. Only faint staining of scattered vascular/stromal elements is present, serving as an internal control. Of note, classic Burkitt lymphoma is characteristically CD10-positive; CD10 negativity is uncommon and should prompt careful exclusion of other high-grade B-cell lymphomas. The stain is interpreted as negative, which is partially concordant with the stated diagnosis and requires correlation with BCL6, BCL2, TdT, Ki-67 and MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, non-germinal center type
ddx.vs: Non-GCB DLBCL is CD10-negative and MUM1-positive with larger pleomorphic cells and a lower Ki-67 than Burkitt lymphoma.
Cases with Burkitt-like morphology but discordant phenotype (e.g., CD10-negative or BCL2-positive) without double-hit rearrangements fall here.
Blastoid MCL is CD10-negative but expresses cyclin D1, SOX11 and usually CD5.
B-LBL can be CD10-variable but expresses TdT and CD34 and lacks surface immunoglobulin.

62365.recognize_zh: Cyclin D1 免疫染色中，兩個淡染、陰性的生發中心（germinal center）被一圈寬厚、細胞核強陽性的外套區（mantle zone）包圍，這種只在外套區陽性的分布就是外套區型（mantle zone pattern）外套細胞淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Strong nuclear cyclin D1 positivity in a markedly expanded, cuff-like mantle zone surrounding follicles
Residual germinal centers are cyclin D1-negative, sharply demarcated from the positive rim
Positive cells are small to medium lymphocytes with uniform round nuclei
Cyclin D1-positive cells also spill into the interfollicular areas, beyond a normal-width mantle
Scattered negative stromal/endothelial cells; adipose tissue at lower left
62365.describe_en: Cyclin D1 immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows lymphoid follicles with preserved, cyclin D1-negative germinal centers. The surrounding mantle zones are markedly widened and composed of small to medium lymphoid cells with strong, diffuse nuclear cyclin D1 expression, with extension of positive cells into the interfollicular region. Germinal center cells and stromal elements are negative. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone growth pattern.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with prominent mantle zones
ddx.vs: Normal mantle zone B cells are cyclin D1-negative (only weak staining of endothelial/histiocytic cells), whereas here the expanded mantle is strongly and uniformly nuclear positive.
In situ mantle cell neoplasm shows cyclin D1-positive cells confined to the inner mantle of normal-width mantle zones, not the broad expanded cuffs with interfollicular spread seen here.
Marginal zone lymphoma can surround reactive follicles but is cyclin D1-negative and CD5-negative, with paler monocytoid cytoplasm.
Castleman disease shows onion-skin mantle zones around atretic, hyalinized germinal centers, and the mantle lymphocytes are cyclin D1-negative.

exam.answer_en: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern — strong nuclear cyclin D1 in widened mantle cuffs around cyclin D1-negative germinal centers
pearls_zh: 考法：問 cyclin D1 陽性細胞位置：擴大的 mantle zone 並延伸至濾泡間，生發中心陰性；cyclin D1 為核染，內皮與組織球弱陽可作內部對照。
Cyclin D1 過度表現源自 t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH，FISH 可確認；少數 cyclin D1 陰性 MCL 帶 CCND2 或 CCND3 重排，以 SOX11 協助。
Cyclin D1 陽性也見於 hairy cell leukemia（通常弱）、plasma cell myeloma with t(11;14)，以及部分 CLL proliferation centers，需結合形態與表型。
治療：年輕適合者多以含 cytarabine 的誘導加 rituximab 為基礎；BTK inhibitor 在復發 MCL 效果良好。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 in situ mantle cell neoplasia 混淆：ISMCN 的 cyclin D1+ 細胞只位於未擴大的內層 mantle zone；本圖外套層明顯變寬並擴散到濾泡間，屬真正 MCL。

quiz.q: 此 cyclin D1 染色中哪一區陽性、哪一區陰性？對應的染色體轉位為何？
quiz.a: 擴大的 mantle zone 陽性、生發中心陰性；t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH

62301.recognize_zh: EDTA 周邊血抹片中可見數團（箭頭處）聚集在一起的血小板，其中不少血小板體積偏大，而紅血球形態正常，說明儀器計數偏低是血小板凝集造成的假性血小板減少症（pseudothrombocytopenia）。
features: Multiple discrete platelet aggregates (arrows) scattered across the smear
Aggregated platelets include several large platelets approaching red cell size
Individual free platelets are relatively sparse between clumps
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without schistocytes
No leukocytes or platelet satellitism around neutrophils in this field
62301.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear prepared from an EDTA-anticoagulated sample shows several discrete platelet aggregates, indicated by arrows, composed of platelets of variable size including several large forms. Free platelets between the clumps are relatively few, and red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes. No platelet satellitism is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet clumping causing pseudothrombocytopenia, supported by a normal platelet count on a citrated sample.

ddx.vs: ITP shows genuinely few, often large, platelets evenly distributed without clumps, and the low count persists in citrate.
Inherited macrothrombocytopenia shows evenly dispersed giant platelets without clumps (and Döhle-like inclusions in MYH9 disease), with a low count in citrate.
Satellitism is also EDTA-dependent but shows platelets rosetting around neutrophils rather than free-standing aggregates.
A partially clotted specimen shows fibrin strands with platelet clumps and requires recollection, rather than a reproducible EDTA-specific phenomenon corrected by citrate.

exam.answer_en: EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia — multiple platelet aggregates (clumps) on smear causing a falsely low analyzer platelet count
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指的團塊是什麼、為何血小板數偏低：platelet clumps，儀器把團塊當成白血球或不計入，導致假性血小板低下。
機轉：EDTA 使 GPIIb/IIIa 構形改變，暴露抗原被自然存在的抗體（多為冷反應型）結合而凝集；病人無出血風險。
處理：以 sodium citrate（需校正稀釋）或 heparin 管重抽、或指尖血立即計數與抹片確認；避免不必要的輸血小板、骨髓檢查或類固醇。
類似假象：platelet satellitism（血小板圍繞中性球）亦為 EDTA 相關；GPIIb/IIIa 拮抗劑（如 abciximab）也可引起假性血小板低下。
血小板團塊可使儀器白血球數假性升高，判讀時需看儀器警示與抹片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 ITP 或 inherited macrothrombocytopenia：真 ITP 抹片上血小板稀少且無團塊；本例有多處血小板團塊，換用 citrate 管後計數正常。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭所指的團塊是什麼？要確認假性血小板低下應如何重新採檢？
quiz.a: Platelet clumps（aggregates）；改用 sodium citrate（或 heparin）抗凝管重抽並看抹片

62173.recognize_zh: 視野中可見染色質細緻、核仁明顯的母細胞（blast），同時紅系前驅細胞出現雙核與巨母紅血球樣（megaloblastoid）變化，箭頭所指為深藍細胞質的大型未成熟細胞；母細胞增加加上紅系發育不良，符合伴隨骨髓發育不良相關變化的急性骨髓性白血病（AML-MRC）。
features: Increased large blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm
Arrow marks a large immature cell with round nucleus and rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Dyserythropoiesis: binucleate erythroblast (upper center) and megaloblastoid erythroid precursors with open chromatin
Erythroblasts with condensed chromatin at various stages
Occasional segmented neutrophil and small lymphocytes
62173.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population of mixed immature cells. Numerous blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate agranular cytoplasm are present, and the arrow highlights a large immature cell with a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors show dysplastic features including binucleation and megaloblastoid nuclear maturation. Scattered neutrophils and lymphocytes are present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes, pending blast count, cytogenetic and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: MDS-IB has blasts below 20% in marrow and blood, so the separation from AML depends on the blast count rather than dysplastic morphology.
PEL requires >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, whereas this field contains a mixed population with myeloblasts.
Megaloblastic change affects all lineages with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils without increased blasts, and corrects with vitamin replacement.

62109.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的骨髓腔被淡色、放射狀或扇形排列的針狀結晶團取代，周圍有纖維組織與異物反應細胞包圍，正常造血組織幾乎消失，這是骨髓草酸鹽沉積（oxalosis）的表現。
features: Thick bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces replaced by nodular deposits
Pale, refractile needle-shaped crystals arranged in radiating/rosette (sheaf-like) clusters
Surrounding fibrous stroma with spindle cells and histiocytic/foreign-body giant cell reaction
Near-complete loss of normal hematopoietic tissue and fat in affected spaces
Low-resolution image; crystal birefringence cannot be assessed without polarization
62109.describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy at low power shows broad bony trabeculae with intertrabecular marrow spaces occupied by nodular aggregates of pale, needle-shaped crystals in radiating rosette arrangements. The crystals are encased by fibrous tissue with spindle cells and a histiocytic foreign-body-type reaction, and normal hematopoietic elements are largely effaced in the involved spaces. Findings are consistent with marrow oxalosis; polarization to demonstrate birefringent crystals and correlation with renal function and primary hyperoxaluria testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Metastases show cohesive atypical epithelial cells within the fibrotic stroma rather than acellular radiating crystalline deposits with foreign-body reaction.

Urate crystals are usually dissolved in formalin-processed tissue leaving amorphous pale material, and are negatively birefringent needles, whereas calcium oxalate forms fan/rosette crystals that persist and are strongly birefringent.

ddx.dx: Gaucher disease or other storage histiocytosis
ddx.vs: Storage cells are sheets of histiocytes with wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm, not extracellular crystal rosettes.

62045.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色高倍下，數顆大型細胞呈強烈膜狀與細胞質陽性，其核大、淡染且形狀不規則，而周圍密集的小淋巴球幾乎全為陰性，顯示散在的大型 LP 細胞被該抗體標記。
features: Several scattered large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic red staining
Positive large cells have large pale vesicular, oval to irregular nuclei, three to four times the size of background lymphocytes
Densely packed background small round lymphocytes are negative
Large cells lie singly, without clusters or sheets
Faint granular extracellular red staining in the background; antibody identity not labeled
62045.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at high power shows scattered large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining and large vesicular irregular nuclei. The surrounding dense population of small lymphocytes is negative, and the large cells are dispersed singly without forming sheets. Faint granular background staining is present. Findings are consistent with highlighted lymphocyte predominant (LP) cells in nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, provided the marker is a B-cell or LP-cell antigen; negativity of background small lymphocytes for a B-cell marker would indicate a T-cell-rich milieu, and correlation with the labeled panel is required.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL shows identical scattered positive large B cells, so separation relies on diffuse architecture, CD8+ T-cell background and absence of CD21+ meshworks.
HRS cells show CD30 membrane and Golgi staining with CD15 and weak PAX5, and are negative or variable for CD20 and OCT2/BOB1.
ALCL cells are CD30+ in cohesive sheets or sinuses with horseshoe-shaped nuclei and T-cell/ALK markers, not isolated B-cell-marker-positive cells.

61917.recognize_zh: CD2免疫染色下，固有層內密集浸潤的細胞呈強烈細胞膜陽性（棕色），包圍著陰性的腺體，腺體上皮內陽性細胞很少；CD2陽性支持浸潤細胞為NK或T細胞系，是NK細胞腸病免疫表型的一部分。
features: Dense lamina propria infiltrate with strong membranous CD2 positivity
Positive cells are medium-sized and surround and separate negative glands
Few CD2-positive cells within glandular epithelium (little epitheliotropism)
Gland architecture preserved; interspersed CD2-negative stromal and inflammatory nuclei
61917.describe_en: CD2 immunohistochemistry on gastrointestinal mucosa shows a dense infiltrate of medium-sized cells with strong membranous CD2 staining expanding the lamina propria and surrounding CD2-negative glands. Intraepithelial positive cells are infrequent, and gland architecture is preserved. CD2 is expressed by both T and NK cells and therefore confirms a T/NK lineage but does not separate them. In combination with CD56 positivity, cytoplasmic CD3 expression, CD5 negativity and EBER negativity, the findings support NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is also CD2-positive, so the distinction rests on EBER positivity, angiodestruction and necrosis in ENKTL.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Indolent T-LPD is CD2-positive as well but expresses CD5 and surface CD3 with CD4 or CD8 and lacks CD56.
Reactive infiltrates contain a mixed CD4/CD8 population with CD5 retained and no monotonous CD56-positive cells.

61853.recognize_zh: CD34 免疫染色中，大型、形態不規則的巨核細胞呈強陽性（異常表現），另可見線狀陽性的血管內皮與少數小型陽性細胞；巨核細胞 CD34 異常染色常見於 AML/MDS 的發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Strong cytoplasmic CD34 staining in large megakaryocytes, some small with hypolobated nuclei (dysplastic)
Linear CD34 staining of sinusoidal endothelium serving as internal positive control
Few small CD34-positive cells consistent with persistent blasts
Numerous CD34-negative myeloid and erythroid precursors
Hypocellular background with abundant fat spaces
61853.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD34 shows a background of CD34-negative hematopoietic precursors and fat. Numerous megakaryocytes, including small hypolobated forms, show strong aberrant cytoplasmic CD34 expression, and sinusoidal endothelial cells are linearly positive as an internal control. Scattered small CD34-positive cells are present, although at this magnification they are less conspicuous than the megakaryocytes and should be quantified separately from the megakaryocytic staining. Findings are consistent with persistent acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic, aberrantly CD34-positive megakaryocytes in the post-hypomethylating-agent setting.

ddx.vs: Blasts are small mononuclear cells with CD34 staining, whereas large lobated megakaryocytes should be excluded from the blast estimate despite CD34 positivity.

ddx.dx: Megaloblastic anemia or immune cytopenia with CD34+ megakaryocytes
