ddx.vs: Megakaryocytic CD34 expression is not specific and can occur in megaloblastic and autoimmune conditions, so dysplasia and blast count must be assessed on other preparations.
Endothelial staining is linear along sinusoids and co-expresses CD31/ERG, unlike the round cytoplasmic staining in megakaryocytes.

61789.recognize_zh: 這張不是抹片而是檢驗報告：A 為 CBC，RBC 數正常偏高但 Hb 6.4、MCV 53.1、MCH 14.9 且 RDW 升高；B 為毛細管電泳，Z15 區出現小的 HbH 峰（1.1%）且 HbA2 偏低（1.3%），支持 HbH disease。
features: Panel A CBC: RBC 4.29 x10^6/uL with HGB 6.4 g/dL and HCT 22.8% (anemia with relatively preserved red cell count)
Marked microcytosis and hypochromia: MCV 53.1 fL, MCH 14.9 pg, MCHC 28.1 g/dL
Very high RDW-CV 41.2% and RDW-SD 80.7 fL, reflecting severe anisocytosis; platelets normal (246 x10^3/uL)
Panel B capillary zone electrophoresis: small fast-migrating HbH peak in zone 15 (1.1%)
HbA 97.6% and low HbA2 1.3%, with no HbF or variant peak shown
61789.describe_en: The figure combines a complete blood count and a capillary zone hemoglobin electrophoresis tracing rather than a morphologic image. The CBC shows a severe microcytic, hypochromic anemia (Hb 6.4 g/dL, MCV 53.1 fL, MCH 14.9 pg) with a relatively preserved red cell count and a markedly elevated RDW. Electrophoresis demonstrates a small fast-migrating HbH fraction (1.1%) in the most anodal zone, HbA 97.6% and a reduced HbA2 of 1.3%. A low HbA2 with an HbH band is characteristic of alpha-thalassemia, and the findings are consistent with HbH disease; because HbH is unstable and often underestimated, supravital staining for inclusions and alpha-globin gene analysis are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Also causes low MCV and low HbA2 but with a low red cell count, low ferritin and no HbH fraction on electrophoresis.
Shows raised HbA2 (>3.5%) and often increased HbF rather than the low HbA2 and HbH band seen here.
Produces milder microcytosis with near-normal hemoglobin and no detectable HbH in adults.

ddx.dx: Hb Bart's or fast-migrating unstable variant
ddx.vs: Hb Bart's (gamma-4) is mainly seen in neonates, and other fast variants require HPLC retention times or DNA sequencing to separate from HbH.

exam.answer_en: HbH disease (alpha-thalassemia) — severe microcytic hypochromic anemia with preserved RBC count, small fast HbH peak and low HbA2 on capillary electrophoresis
pearls_zh: 看法：這是 CBC＋毛細管電泳報告，考你讀數據：Hb 低但 RBC 數相對保留、MCV 53/MCH 15 極低、RDW 高；Mentzer index（MCV/RBC）約 12.4，<13 偏向 thalassemia。
電泳判讀：最陽極端（zone 15）的快速移動峰為 HbH（β4），HbA2 降低支持 α-thalassemia；β-thal trait 則 HbA2 升高。HbH 不穩定，比例常被低估。
確認：brilliant cresyl blue supravital 染色可見 HbH 包涵體呈「golf ball」樣；α-globin 基因分析（gap-PCR 查 --SEA 等缺失、定序查 Hb Constant Spring）。
HbH disease 為三個 α 基因失功能（如 --SEA/-α3.7）；台灣與東南亞常見 --SEA，非缺失型（如 Hb Constant Spring）臨床通常較嚴重。
臨床：慢性溶血、脾腫大，感染或氧化性藥物可誘發溶血危象；需遺傳諮詢，雙方帶因可能生下 Hb Bart's hydrops fetalis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤判為缺鐵性貧血：缺鐵時 RBC 數下降、Mentzer >13、ferritin 低；本例 RBC 相對保留且電泳有 HbH 峰。另勿因 HbA2 低就排除，缺鐵也會降低 HbA2。

quiz.q: 電泳 zone 15 出現 1.1% 的快速移動峰、HbA2 1.3%，最可能是哪種血紅素與疾病？用哪種染色可看到其包涵體？
quiz.a: HbH（β4），HbH disease；brilliant cresyl blue supravital stain（golf-ball inclusions）。

61725.recognize_zh: 這是 blast gate 的 CD15 對 CD10 流式圖：綠色異常芽細胞群 CD15 完全陰性，CD10 大多為陰性至部分弱陽性，呈垂直條狀分布；缺乏 CD15（成熟髓系）與明確 CD10 表現，有助排除粒細胞分化與 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Dot plot: CD15-PB (x-axis) versus CD10-APC700 (y-axis), gated on blasts
Abnormal population (green) CD15-negative
Green population shows a vertical smear of CD10 from negative to dim/partial, without a discrete bright CD10+ cluster
Red residual events also CD15-negative to dim and CD10-negative
No mature granulocytic (CD15-bright) contamination within the blast gate
61725.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD15 versus CD10 gated on blasts shows the abnormal population (green) to be CD15-negative with CD10 ranging from negative to dim partial expression, without a discrete CD10-bright cluster. Residual events (red) are also largely negative. Absence of CD15 argues against granulocytic or monocytic maturation, and the lack of bright CD10 argues against B-lymphoblastic or Burkitt leukemia. This pertinent-negative profile is compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm when combined with CD4, CD56 and bright CD123 expression.

ddx.vs: B-ALL usually shows uniform CD10 with CD19/CD22/TdT, rather than a CD10-negative to dim smear without B markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation or monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: These express CD15 on a subset of maturing cells, which is absent in this population.

61661.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加、脂肪減少，三系造血細胞都增生，巨核細胞數量多、大小不一並呈鬆散群聚，部分核分葉多，這種全骨髓增生（panmyelosis）加上多形性巨核細胞是真性紅血球增多症（PV）增生期的典型切片表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with reduced fat spaces
Trilineage hyperplasia (panmyelosis) with prominent erythroid and granulocytic proliferation
Increased megakaryocytes that are pleomorphic in size, including large forms with hyperlobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes scattered and in loose clusters, often near sinusoids
Bony trabecula at lower right without osteosclerosis; no obvious fibrosis at this power
61661.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at low power is markedly hypercellular with reduced adipocytes. There is trilineage hyperplasia with prominent erythroid and granulocytic proliferation and increased, pleomorphic megakaryocytes ranging from small to large with hyperlobated nuclei, arranged singly and in loose clusters. The bony trabecula is unremarkable and there is no obvious fibrosis or increase in blasts at this magnification, although a reticulin stain is required to grade fibrosis. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera, proliferative phase.

ddx.vs: ET marrow is normocellular or mildly hypercellular with proliferation of large to giant mature megakaryocytes with staghorn nuclei, lacking erythroid and granulocytic panmyelosis.
Prefibrotic PMF shows granulocytic predominance with decreased erythropoiesis and tight clusters of bizarre megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei.
Reactive erythrocytosis shows erythroid hyperplasia without megakaryocytic proliferation or pleomorphism and lacks JAK2 mutation.
CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and paratrabecular expansion of immature myeloid cells and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

exam.answer_en: Polycythemia vera, proliferative phase — hypercellular marrow with panmyelosis and increased pleomorphic megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看細胞量與脂肪比例，問「幾系增生？」答三系全髓增生（panmyelosis）加大小多形的巨核細胞，最符合 PV。
WHO 5th PV 主要條件：Hb >16.5（男）/>16.0 g/dL（女）或 Hct >49%/>48%；骨髓依年齡過度增生、三系增生伴多形成熟巨核細胞；JAK2 V617F 或 exon 12 突變。次要條件：血清 EPO 低於正常。
JAK2 V617F 見於絕大多數 PV，其餘多為 JAK2 exon 12；三系增生加 EPO 低有助排除繼發性紅血球增多症（EPO 正常或升高）。
治療：所有病人以放血維持 Hct <45% 並給低劑量 aspirin；高風險（年齡 ≥60 或血栓史）加 cytoreduction，如 hydroxyurea 或 interferon（ropeginterferon alfa-2b）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 ET 或 prefibrotic PMF 混淆：ET 主要是巨核細胞單系增生、紅系不增加；PMF 巨核細胞核雲朵狀深染、密集成團並伴紅系減少；PV 三系皆增生。

quiz.q: 這張骨髓切片高度增生且三系皆增加、巨核細胞大小多形，稱為什麼型態？最常見的致病突變是？
quiz.a: Panmyelosis（polycythemia vera）；JAK2 V617F。

61597.recognize_zh: 低倍下密集的腫瘤細胞片狀排列，CD20 染色幾乎全部陰性（只有藍色核），僅零星一兩個小細胞為棕色陽性（殘存的正常 B 細胞可當內部陽性對照）；大 B 細胞淋巴瘤卻缺乏 CD20，是漿母細胞淋巴瘤的典型特徵。
features: Dense diffuse sheets of tumor cells with hematoxylin-only nuclei
Tumor cells completely negative for CD20
Rare scattered small CD20-positive cells serving as internal positive control
No nodular or follicular B-cell architecture
Fibrous stroma at the upper left edge
61597.describe_en: CD20 immunostain at low to medium power shows diffuse sheets of neoplastic cells that are entirely negative for CD20. Only rare scattered small cells show membranous staining, confirming adequate staining as an internal control. Loss of CD20 in a large B-cell neoplasm is characteristic of plasmablastic differentiation. Together with MUM1/CD138 expression and EBER positivity, the findings support EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Post-rituximab DLBCL may lose CD20 but typically retains PAX5/CD79a and lacks CD138 expression and EBER positivity.
Also CD20 negative; distinguished by clinical CRAB features, M-protein, marrow-based disease and usually EBER negativity.
Also CD20 negative with a plasmablastic phenotype but shows granular cytoplasmic ALK staining and is EBV negative.
CD20 negativity alone does not prove lymphoma; keratin, S100/SOX10 and CD138 caution (carcinomas can be CD138 positive) must be considered.

exam.answer_en: Plasmablastic lymphoma — CD20-negative tumor sheets with rare internal-control CD20+ small B cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著大片陰性的腫瘤細胞問「CD20 陰性代表什麼」，並要你指出零星陽性小細胞作為內部陽性對照，證明染色有效。
CD20 陰性的大細胞淋巴瘤鑑別清單：plasmablastic lymphoma、ALK-positive LBCL、primary effusion lymphoma、plasmablastic myeloma，以及 rituximab 治療後 CD20 流失的 DLBCL。
下一步 IHC：CD138、MUM1、CD38（漿細胞分化）、EBER ISH、HHV-8、ALK、Ki-67；也要問是否曾用 rituximab。
治療意義：CD20 陰性代表 rituximab 無效靶點；PBL 常用強化化療，部分方案加入 bortezomib，HIV 病人需同時控制 HIV。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為染色失敗或非淋巴腫瘤（如癌、黑色素瘤）；零星 CD20+ 小 B 細胞證明染色有效，配合 CD45、CD138/MUM1 確定為漿母細胞分化的淋巴瘤。

quiz.q: 這張 CD20 染色中，零星的棕色小細胞有什麼作用？腫瘤細胞 CD20 陰性提示哪一類淋巴瘤？
quiz.a: 內部陽性對照（殘存正常 B 細胞）；漿母細胞分化的大 B 細胞淋巴瘤，如 plasmablastic lymphoma

61533.recognize_zh: 低倍十二指腸切片，黏膜內有大型、界線清楚的淋巴濾泡樣結節把黏膜撐開，結節內細胞單調、缺乏明顯的生發中心極性，上方仍保有絨毛；此分布型態是十二指腸型濾泡性淋巴瘤的典型表現。
features: Large, well-circumscribed follicle-like lymphoid nodules expanding the mucosa
Nodules composed of a monotonous population without obvious zonation or starry-sky pattern
Thin compressed rim of darker small lymphocytes at the periphery of the nodules
Overlying duodenal villi preserved, some with lymphocytes extending into villous cores
No ulceration or destructive mass effect in this field
61533.describe_en: Low-power view of a duodenal biopsy shows mucosa expanded by large, well-circumscribed follicle-like lymphoid nodules. The nodules are composed of a relatively monotonous population lacking obvious polarization and tingible body macrophages, with an attenuated rim of darker small lymphocytes. The overlying villi are preserved, with lymphoid cells extending into some villous cores. With CD10, BCL6, and BCL2 co-expression in the nodules, findings are consistent with duodenal-type follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles show well-defined mantle zones, germinal center polarization, and tingible body macrophages, and are BCL2 negative.
MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone expansion beyond follicles with lymphoepithelial lesions and a CD10-/BCL6- phenotype.
Mantle cell lymphoma forms vaguely nodular or mantle-zone patterns of cyclin D1+/CD5+ cells.

ddx.dx: Systemic nodal follicular lymphoma with GI involvement
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, so separation relies on staging, as duodenal-type FL is typically localized to the mucosa/submucosa with an indolent course.

61469.recognize_zh: 抹片邊緣聚集許多嗜中性球，其中數顆胞質內含棕黑色顆粒狀瘧色素（hemozoin）；左下角紅血球內可見細小環狀體，兩者合看支持惡性瘧（P. falciparum）。
features: Cluster of segmented and band neutrophils at the feathered edge of the smear
Several neutrophils contain coarse brown-black hemozoin pigment granules within the cytoplasm
Pigment-laden neutrophils also show phagocytosed purple parasite remnants
Adjacent erythrocytes (lower left) contain small ring-form parasites, some with double chromatin dots
RBCs are normocytic without Schüffner stippling
61469.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, feathered edge, shows a cluster of mature neutrophils, several of which contain phagocytosed brown-black malarial pigment and parasite debris. Nearby erythrocytes harbor small ring-form parasites without red cell enlargement or stippling. Pigment within circulating leukocytes indicates phagocytosis of mature parasitized cells and has been associated with more severe falciparum malaria. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with pigment-laden neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are dark purple-blue azurophilic granules spread through the cytoplasm, not refractile brown-black pigment clumps.
Hemosiderin is golden-brown and Prussian blue positive, and parasitized RBCs would not be seen alongside.
Babesia does not produce hemozoin, so pigment in leukocytes argues against it.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria — pigment (hemozoin)-laden neutrophils with ring forms in adjacent RBCs
pearls_zh: 考法：指著 neutrophil 內棕黑色顆粒問「這是什麼」→ phagocytosed hemozoin（malarial pigment），旁邊紅血球的 ring 是蟲種線索。
含色素白血球（pigment-containing neutrophils/monocytes）比例升高與重症 falciparum malaria 及較差預後相關。
色素在血片偏厚區或羽狀邊緣（feathered edge）較易看到；羽狀邊也要檢查是否有 schizont 或 gametocyte。
瘧疾色素（hemozoin）在偏光下具雙折射性，可與鐵質（hemosiderin，Prussian blue 陽性）區分。
治療後寄生蟲清除時，含色素白血球可殘留數天，可作為近期感染的回溯線索。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 toxic granulation 或 hemosiderin；toxic granules 為細小深藍紫色，hemosiderin 為 Prussian blue 陽性，hemozoin 則為棕黑色粗顆粒且 iron stain 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中 neutrophil 胞質內的棕黑色色素是什麼？與 hemosiderin 如何區分？
quiz.a: Hemozoin；Prussian blue 鐵染色陰性（hemosiderin 陽性）

61341.recognize_zh: 切片中為一片中等大小、形態單一的細胞，核呈卵圓形或帶凹痕、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，細胞質中等量淡嗜酸性，符合漿細胞樣樹突細胞（PDC）群聚的外觀；但單憑 H&E 無法確認，需 CD123、TCF4 等免疫染色。
features: Dense, monotonous population of intermediate-sized cells
Oval to indented or elongated nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Delicate collagen strands and a few small vessels; no mitotic activity prominent in this field
61341.describe_en: Section shows a dense, cohesive-appearing aggregate of monotonous intermediate-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Normal hematopoietic elements and fat are not appreciated in this field. The morphology is compatible with a cluster of plasmacytoid dendritic cells, but H&E alone cannot establish lineage; confirmation with CD123, TCF4, and CD303 and assessment of CD56 expression is required to distinguish reactive/clonal PDC nodules from blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: BPDCN cells are more blastic with frequent mitoses and are CD56-positive, whereas non-neoplastic PDC nodules are CD56-negative.
Myeloid blasts are MPO and/or lysozyme positive and lack strong CD123/TCF4 co-expression.
Mast cells are spindled with clear to granular cytoplasm and are tryptase and CD117 positive.
B-cell lymphomas express CD20/PAX5 and lineage-specific markers such as cyclin D1 rather than CD123.

61213.recognize_zh: A、B 格中嗜中性球細胞質空泡內有多個卵圓至香腸狀的小酵母體，D、E 格的嗜中性球核分葉異常（核葉分離、未分節），F 格為分枝菌絲，組合起來指向 HIV 患者血液中的馬爾尼菲籃狀菌（Talaromyces marneffei）感染合併發育不良嗜中性球。
features: Panels A-B: neutrophils with cytoplasmic vacuoles containing multiple small oval to elongated yeast-like organisms with clear halos
Panel C: large mononuclear phagocyte with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and an adjacent cluster of organisms
Panel D: neutrophil with abnormally separated, rounded nuclear lobes (nuclear fragmentation/abnormal segmentation)
Panel E: neutrophil with a non-segmented, elongated dumbbell-shaped nucleus and a small detached nuclear fragment (dysplastic/pseudo-Pelger-like)
Panel F: dense tangle of dark branching septate hyphae on a red background, representing the mould phase
Transverse septa of individual yeasts are suggested but not clearly resolved at this resolution
61213.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils containing intracytoplasmic vacuoles filled with small oval to elongated yeast-like organisms, as well as a mononuclear phagocyte associated with a cluster of similar organisms. Several neutrophils display dysplastic nuclear features, including abnormally separated lobes and a hyposegmented dumbbell-shaped nucleus. A separate panel shows branching hyphae of the mould phase. In a patient with newly diagnosed HIV infection, findings are consistent with disseminated Talaromyces marneffei infection with dysplastic neutrophils; culture confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller, uniformly oval and reproduce by narrow-based budding, whereas T. marneffei forms include elongated sausage shapes dividing by a central transverse septum; culture at 25 C showing red diffusible pigment identifies Talaromyces.
Candida yeasts are larger, show budding and pseudohyphae in blood smears, and lack the septate fission forms.
Leishmania shows a nucleus plus a rod-like kinetoplast and is mainly seen in macrophages rather than neutrophils.
Dysplastic neutrophils in HIV and sepsis can mimic MDS, but MDS requires persistent cytopenias, multilineage dysplasia in the marrow and exclusion of infection or drugs.

61213.stain: Wright-Giemsa; panel F culture prep (stain NS)

exam.answer_en: Disseminated Talaromyces marneffei infection in HIV — intraneutrophilic oval/sausage-shaped yeasts with dysplastic neutrophils; mould phase hyphae
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指嗜中性球空泡內卵圓到香腸狀的小酵母，問病原 → Talaromyces（Penicillium）marneffei；形態關鍵是以中央橫隔分裂（binary fission, transverse septum），而非出芽。
雙相性真菌：37°C 為酵母型，25°C 培養為菌絲型並產生擴散至培養基的紅色色素（F 圖為菌絲）；流行於東南亞、中國南方，台灣亦有病例。
臨床：多見於 CD4 <100 cells/µL 的晚期 HIV，表現發燒、體重減輕、肝脾腫大、貧血與中心凹陷的臍狀皮膚丘疹；周邊血可直接看到病原代表高菌量。
治療：liposomal amphotericin B 誘導後以 itraconazole 維持，並開始 ART；D、E 圖的發育不良嗜中性球屬感染／HIV 相關變化，不應直接診斷 MDS。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 Histoplasma capsulatum：Histoplasma 大小一致、卵圓並以窄基出芽；Talaromyces 形態較不一，含長形香腸狀並以中央橫隔分裂，25°C 培養產紅色色素。

quiz.q: A、B 圖嗜中性球內的酵母是以什麼方式繁殖？這一特點可與哪種真菌區分？
quiz.a: 中央橫隔分裂（binary fission），非出芽；可與以出芽繁殖的 Histoplasma capsulatum 區分

61149.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中布滿中至大型細胞，核為卵圓、腎形或分葉扭曲，胞質豐富呈淡灰紫色細顆粒狀、界限清楚，間夾數顆大型巨核細胞與空泡；這些形態多樣的非典型大細胞即為成片的腫瘤性肥大細胞。
features: Sheets of medium to large cells with abundant pale grey-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Nuclei round, oval, reniform or bilobed/folded, some eccentric, with moderately condensed chromatin
Scattered large megakaryocytes and multinucleated forms among the infiltrate
Residual erythroid precursors and occasional granulocytes between the atypical cells
Extravasated red cells and a fat vacuole in a hypercellular background
61149.describe_en: High-power view of a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse replacement by medium to large atypical cells with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and well-defined borders. Nuclei are round, oval, reniform or bilobed, sometimes eccentric, with moderately condensed chromatin. Scattered megakaryocytes and residual erythroid and granulocytic elements are present. The morphology is consistent with sheets of atypical mast cells, compatible with mast cell leukemia; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells show eccentric round nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof and are CD138/light chain-restricted, not tryptase-positive.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have delicate folded nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli and express lysozyme/CD163 rather than tryptase.
Langerhans cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophilic cytoplasm and are CD1a/langerin/S100-positive.

61021.recognize_zh: 以右側小淋巴球的核為尺度，大多數紅血球比它小（小球性），且中央淡染區擴大、只剩一圈細薄的血紅素邊（低色素性），並有少數變形紅血球，符合缺鐵性貧血的血片。
features: Red cells smaller than the nucleus of the adjacent small lymphocyte (microcytosis)
Markedly enlarged central pallor exceeding one-third of the cell, with a thin hemoglobin rim (hypochromia)
Mild poikilocytosis with a few irregular, elongated and crenated forms
Small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm at right
Scattered platelets; no target cells or basophilic stippling prominent
61021.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of microcytic, hypochromic red cells with markedly widened central pallor and thin hemoglobin rims, together with mild anisopoikilocytosis including a few elongated and irregular forms. A small mature lymphocyte serves as a size reference. Target cells and basophilic stippling are not prominent. Findings are consistent with a microcytic hypochromic anemia, most suggestive of iron deficiency; confirmation requires ferritin and iron studies.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait has a disproportionately low MCV with a normal/high RBC count, prominent target cells and basophilic stippling, and normal ferritin.
Usually normocytic or only mildly microcytic with less hypochromia, and ferritin is normal or increased.
Often shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain.
Features coarse basophilic stippling with mild microcytosis and elevated blood lead.

exam.answer_en: Iron deficiency anemia — microcytic hypochromic red cells smaller than a small lymphocyte nucleus with widened central pallor
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指旁邊的小淋巴球核作為尺度，問紅血球大小與色素 → 小於淋巴球核為 microcytic，中央淡染區超過細胞 1/3 為 hypochromic。
最關鍵的檢查是 serum ferritin，低值對缺鐵特異；但 ferritin 是急性期反應物，發炎時可假性正常，需搭配 transferrin saturation 判讀。
與 thalassemia trait 區分：IDA 的 RDW 上升、RBC 數下降；thal trait RBC 數正常或偏高、MCV 不成比例地低（Mentzer index 可做初篩但非確診）。台灣兩者常並存。
成年男性與停經後女性的缺鐵應找腸胃道出血來源（內視鏡），並考慮 H. pylori、celiac 等吸收不良原因；缺鐵可伴隨反應性血小板增多。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤判為 thalassemia trait：thal trait 常見明顯 target cells 與 basophilic stippling、ferritin 正常；本圖以淡染擴大為主、target cell 不明顯，較支持缺鐵，仍需 ferritin 確認。

quiz.q: 以圖中小淋巴球的核為參考，這些紅血球的大小與色素如何描述？確認診斷最重要的一項抽血檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: Microcytic、hypochromic；serum ferritin（搭配 transferrin saturation）

60893.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，以大量核圓而深染、周圍帶透亮暈及粉紅細胞質的幼紅血球為主（紅血球系增生），其中可見數個雙核的晚期幼紅血球；紅系增生合併雙核為 CDA type II 的表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with marked erythroid hyperplasia
Numerous late erythroblasts with small round, dense hyperchromatic nuclei and perinuclear clearing
Scattered binucleated erythroblasts with paired round nuclei
Early erythroid precursors with open chromatin and nucleoli admixed
Relatively few granulocytic precursors; red cells present in sinusoids
60893.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with marked erythroid hyperplasia, composed predominantly of erythroblasts with round hyperchromatic nuclei and perinuclear halos, together with earlier forms showing open chromatin. Scattered binucleated late erythroblasts are identified. Granulocytic elements are relatively diminished and no infiltrative process is seen. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II; binuclearity is better appreciated on the aspirate smear.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic anemia with reactive erythroid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia lacks conspicuous binucleated late erythroblasts.
Pure erythroid leukemia consists of sheets of immature proerythroblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas here maturing late erythroblasts predominate.
Megaloblastic marrow shows large erythroblasts with open sieve-like chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, not small dense binucleated late normoblasts.
CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts with internuclear chromatin bridges, requiring aspirate or EM to distinguish.

60829.recognize_zh: 周邊血中多顆嗜中性白血球胞質內吞入完整紅血球（紅血球吞噬，erythrophagocytosis），核被推擠成新月形，並伴隨空泡與毒性顆粒；D 圖見紅血球凝集，背景有棘狀紅血球，提示 Donath-Landsteiner 抗體所致的陣發性冷血紅素尿症（PCH）。
features: Neutrophils containing one or more intact ingested red cells within phagocytic vacuoles (panels A-C, E)
Neutrophil nuclei compressed and displaced into crescentic or C-shaped contours around the engulfed red cells
Cytoplasmic vacuolation and coarse toxic granulation in phagocytic neutrophils
Small cluster of agglutinated red cells (panel D)
Background red cells with crenated/echinocytic forms and occasional spherocyte-like dense cells
60829.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous neutrophils with erythrophagocytosis, containing one or more intact red cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles that displace and compress the nucleus into a crescent, accompanied by additional vacuoles and toxic granulation. A small red cell agglutinate is present, and background red cells include crenated forms and occasional dense spherocyte-like cells. No organisms are identified. In a patient with acute hemolysis, florid neutrophil erythrophagocytosis is suggestive of paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria; a direct antiglobulin test (C3 positive) and Donath-Landsteiner test are recommended.

ddx.vs: Warm AIHA shows prominent spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT and erythrophagocytosis by neutrophils is rare, whereas PCH is C3-only DAT-positive with a biphasic Donath-Landsteiner antibody.
Cold agglutinin disease shows large red cell agglutinates on the smear with a high-titer IgM cold agglutinin, and neutrophil erythrophagocytosis is not a typical feature.
HLH erythrophagocytosis is performed by macrophages in marrow or tissue, not by circulating neutrophils, and is accompanied by cytopenias, hyperferritinemia and fever.

ddx.dx: In vitro artifact from delayed processing/EDTA storage
ddx.vs: Storage-related phagocytosis is sparse, and the florid, widespread engulfment with hemolytic clinical findings favors an in vivo process.

captions: A: neutrophil with an engulfed red cell and crescentic compressed nucleus
B: two neutrophils, one containing an ingested red cell with vacuoles
C: neutrophils with phagocytosed red cells and vacuoles

exam.answer_en: Paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria — florid erythrophagocytosis by peripheral blood neutrophils with red cell agglutinate
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質內吞入紅血球、核被擠成新月形的嗜中性球，問「這是什麼現象？聯想哪種溶血性貧血？」→ neutrophil erythrophagocytosis，高度提示 PCH。
機轉：Donath-Landsteiner 抗體為 IgG、抗 P 抗原的雙相性（biphasic）溶血素：低溫時結合並固定補體，回溫後補體活化造成血管內溶血。
檢查：DAT 通常只有 C3 陽性（IgG 陰性，因抗體在體溫下解離）；確診為 Donath-Landsteiner test。
臨床：最常見於病毒感染後的兒童，急性血管內溶血伴血紅素尿；多為自限性，以保暖與支持治療為主，必要時輸血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 warm AIHA：warm AIHA 以球形紅血球及 IgG 陽性 DAT 為主，嗜中性球吞噬紅血球少見；PCH 則 DAT 僅 C3 陽性並常見明顯嗜中性球吞噬紅血球。

quiz.q: 兒童急性溶血，周邊血見圖中嗜中性球吞噬紅血球，DAT 預期結果與確診試驗為何？
quiz.a: DAT 僅 C3 陽性（IgG 陰性）；Donath-Landsteiner test（PCH，抗 P 抗原 IgG）

60765.recognize_zh: 兩顆中型淋巴細胞具豐富淡藍灰色細胞質、邊緣呈不規則毛狀突起，核卵圓、染色質均勻細緻且無明顯核仁，這是周邊血中毛細胞（hairy cells）的典型樣貌。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm and irregular, fine hair-like cytoplasmic projections
Oval to slightly indented nuclei with homogeneous, finely stippled (ground-glass) chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Low N:C ratio compared with normal small lymphocytes
A third lymphoid cell (upper right) with a bilobed/indented nucleus and less abundant cytoplasm
Background red cells with echinocytic crenation, suggesting an older or stored sample
60765.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating medium-sized lymphoid cells with abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm bearing irregular, fine circumferential hair-like projections. Their nuclei are oval to slightly indented with homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin and no prominent nucleoli. An additional lymphoid cell with an indented nucleus is present, and many red cells show crenation consistent with storage artifact. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells in relapsed hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) or BRAF V600E testing would confirm.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Cells have a distinct central nucleolus and higher WBC counts, and are CD25 and annexin A1 negative without BRAF V600E.
Villous lymphocytes have shorter, polar (bipolar) projections, more condensed chromatin and often plasmacytoid features, and lack CD103/CD25/annexin A1.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cells have broad-based villi with more clumped chromatin and are usually CD25 and CD123 negative, BRAF wild type.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles rather than hair-like projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — circulating medium-sized cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, circumferential hair-like projections and nucleoli-free oval nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指周邊血中胞質豐富、邊緣毛狀的淋巴細胞，問「這是什麼細胞？要做哪些 flow 標記？」→ hairy cell；CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 皆陽性。
分子與 IHC：BRAF V600E 見於絕大多數典型 HCL；annexin A1 為最特異 B 細胞標記（但 T 細胞也陽性），TRAP 陽性。
臨床：脾腫大、全血球低下且特徵性單核球低下；骨髓網狀纖維增加常造成 dry tap，需靠切片。
治療：cladribine 或 pentostatin 為一線，可合併 rituximab；復發或難治可用 BRAF 抑制劑（如 vemurafenib），也要注意感染風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 splenic marginal zone lymphoma：SMZL 的絨毛短且偏向一極、染色質較粗、常有漿細胞樣特徵，並 CD103−、CD25 常陰性、annexin A1−；HCL 絨毛細長環繞全周。

quiz.q: 圖中毛狀突起的淋巴細胞，最具代表性的分子變異是什麼？病人典型會缺少哪一種白血球？
quiz.a: BRAF V600E；單核球（monocytopenia）

60573.recognize_zh: 低倍下整張抹片的紅血球聚成大小不一、不規則的團塊（凝集，agglutination），而不是錢串狀排列；高倍可見大型反應性淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍、邊緣深藍並貼附紅血球，符合傳染性單核球增多症合併冷凝集素。
features: Low power: diffuse, irregular clumps of red cells of varying size throughout the smear (agglutination)
High power: red cells aggregated in amorphous three-dimensional clusters, not linear rouleaux stacks
Large reactive (atypical) lymphocytes with moderate-to-abundant cytoplasm and basophilic peripheral rim
Reactive lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei, relatively condensed chromatin and cytoplasmic hugging of adjacent red cells
60573.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows prominent irregular clumps of red cells distributed throughout the film, with scattered leukocytes. At high power the red cells form amorphous agglutinates rather than rouleaux, and there are large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm showing basophilic rims and scalloping around adjacent erythrocytes. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination due to cold agglutinins (typically anti-i) in the setting of infectious mononucleosis; a warmed sample should be used for accurate red cell indices.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear stacks of red cells resembling coins, whereas agglutination forms irregular grape-like clumps that disperse on warming.
Morphology of agglutination is identical (anti-I rather than anti-i); discrimination relies on serology and absence of reactive EBV lymphocytosis.
Occurs in older adults with a monoclonal IgM kappa and a small clonal B-cell population rather than polyclonal reactive lymphocytes.
Overlapping red cells in thick areas are evenly crowded, not discrete clumps separated by clear spaces in the thin feathered edge.

exam.answer_en: Infectious mononucleosis with cold agglutinin — irregular red cell agglutinates (not rouleaux) plus large reactive lymphocytes hugging red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍圖考「這是 agglutination 還是 rouleaux」；高倍圖考反應性淋巴球（Downey cell）胞質邊緣深藍、包夾紅血球的特徵，合起來答 IM 合併冷凝集。
抗體特異性：EBV/IM 的冷凝集素多為 anti-i；Mycoplasma pneumoniae 則為 anti-I。多為暫時性，嚴重溶血少見。
血液分析儀假象：凝集造成 RBC count 假性下降、MCV 與 MCHC 假性升高；將檢體加溫至 37°C 後重測可校正。
EBV 關聯檢查：heterophile antibody（Monospot）、EBV VCA IgM；周邊血反應性淋巴球主要是 CD8+ T 細胞。臨床注意脾腫大避免接觸性運動（脾破裂），使用 amoxicillin 易出疹。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 rouleaux：rouleaux 是紅血球像硬幣般線狀堆疊（見於 paraprotein、發炎），加生理食鹽水可分散；agglutination 是不規則葡萄串狀團塊，加溫後分散，提示冷凝集素。

quiz.q: 此抹片的紅血球團塊會讓自動血球分析儀的 MCV 與 MCHC 出現什麼假象？如何校正？
quiz.a: MCV、MCHC 假性升高（RBC 假性下降）；將檢體加溫至 37°C 後重測。

60637.recognize_zh: A 列為 CML 典型的小型、低分葉「矮小」巨核細胞，散在於高度細胞化的顆粒球背景中；B 列則為伊馬替尼治療後出現的大型、核高度分葉呈鹿角狀（staghorn）且成群的巨核細胞，屬 ET 型態。
features: Panel A: small megakaryocytes with hypolobated, round to monolobated nuclei ('dwarf' megakaryocytes), singly dispersed
Panel A: hypercellular marrow dominated by granulocytic precursors (elevated M:E ratio)
Panel B: large to giant megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply hyperlobulated 'staghorn' nuclei
Panel B: megakaryocytes lie adjacent to fat spaces and sinusoids, some forming loose clusters
Panel B: background marrow with normal-appearing cellularity and maturation
60637.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine sections are shown before and after therapy. The pretreatment biopsy (A) is hypercellular with granulocytic predominance and contains small, hypolobated megakaryocytes typical of chronic myeloid leukemia. After imatinib (B), the marrow contains large megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, arranged singly and in loose clusters, without significant granulocytic expansion. Findings are consistent with coexistent BCR::ABL1-positive CML and JAK2 V617F-positive essential thrombocythemia, with ET morphology unmasked after imatinib therapy.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei, high N:C ratio and tight clusters with granulocytic hypercellularity, rather than mature staghorn forms.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying sizes and erythroid expansion, not isolated large staghorn megakaryocytes.
CML megakaryocytes remain small and hypolobated (dwarf forms), in contrast to the large hyperlobated forms in panel B.
5q- syndrome shows small monolobated or hypolobated megakaryocytes with thrombocytosis, resembling panel A rather than panel B.

exam.answer_en: Coexistent CML and JAK2 V617F ET — small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes pre-imatinib, replaced by large hyperlobulated 'staghorn' megakaryocytes after imatinib
pearls_zh: 考法：考官並排兩張切片，指巨核細胞問「哪張是 CML、哪張是 ET」：CML 為小型低分葉 dwarf megakaryocytes；ET 為大型、核高度分葉的 staghorn megakaryocytes，散在或鬆散成群。
機轉：兩個獨立克隆共存；imatinib 抑制 BCR::ABL1 克隆後，原本被掩蓋的 JAK2 V617F 克隆表型浮現（血小板持續升高、巨核細胞型態改變）。
診斷門檻連結：WHO 的 ET 診斷需排除 BCR::ABL1 陽性 CML；因此在 CML 治療中若出現與分子反應不符的血小板增多，應檢測 JAK2/CALR/MPL。
巨核細胞型態是 MPN 分型核心：ET 為成熟大型 staghorn；PMF 為異型、雲霧狀深染核、緊密成群；PV 為大小多形並伴三系增生。
exam.pitfall_zh: 治療後血小板增多易被當作 CML 抗藥或反應不佳：先看 BCR::ABL1 分子反應，若已達良好反應而巨核細胞轉為大型 staghorn 形態，應懷疑共存的 JAK2 突變 MPN，而非 CML 進展。

quiz.q: A 圖小型低分葉巨核細胞與 B 圖大型高度分葉巨核細胞，分別對應哪一種 MPN？
quiz.a: A：CML（dwarf megakaryocytes）；B：essential thrombocythemia（staghorn megakaryocytes）。

60509.recognize_zh: 小圓細胞大小約與旁邊紅血球相當，核幾乎佔滿整個細胞、染色質濃縮成塊，只剩一圈極薄的淡藍色細胞質，即正常的靜止小淋巴球（resting lymphocyte）。
features: Small round cell approximately the size of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of cytoplasm
Round nucleus with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin
No visible nucleolus
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm without granules; normal background red cells
60509.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small round lymphocyte approximately the size of an adjacent red cell. The nucleus is round with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus, and is surrounded by a thin rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm without granules. Background red cells are normocytic with central pallor. Findings are consistent with a normal resting (small) lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: Normoblasts have a smaller, pyknotic, very dark nucleus and pink-orange hemoglobinized cytoplasm rather than blue cytoplasm.
CLL cells are morphologically similar small lymphocytes with block-like soap-bubble chromatin, recognized by an absolute lymphocytosis with smudge cells and a CD5/CD23+ monoclonal B-cell phenotype.
Small lymphoblasts have finer, more homogeneous chromatin, may show nucleoli and are TdT positive, unlike the coarse clumped chromatin here.

exam.answer_en: Normal small (resting) lymphocyte — red-cell-sized round cell with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasmic rim
pearls_zh: 考法：基礎辨識題，常作為與 nRBC、CLL 細胞、淋巴芽細胞比較的參考點；需說出高 N:C、染色質塊狀、無核仁。
正常小淋巴球直徑約 7–10 μm，大小約等於紅血球，是判斷抹片其他細胞大小的內建尺規。
周邊血淋巴球約 80% 為 T 細胞（CD4 多於 CD8）、B 細胞約 10–15%、NK 細胞約 10%；抹片形態無法區分亞群，需靠 flow。
形態上 CLL 細胞與正常小淋巴球極相似（染色質呈塊狀「足球樣」），常伴 smudge cells；鑑別靠 flow CD5+/CD23+/弱表面 Ig。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 orthochromic normoblast（有核紅血球）：nRBC 核更小更黑近乎固縮、細胞質粉紅色（含血紅素），淋巴球細胞質為淡藍色。

quiz.q: 這顆與紅血球大小相近、細胞質為一圈淡藍色的小圓細胞是什麼？與有核紅血球的最大差別在哪？
quiz.a: 正常小淋巴球；淋巴球細胞質淡藍，nRBC 細胞質帶血紅素呈粉紅/橘色

60445.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑間以脂肪為主，僅見散在造血細胞並夾雜金棕色含鐵血黃素沉積，對 15 歲而言屬低細胞量；此倍率無法清楚評估巨核細胞形態，GATA2 缺乏症須靠臨床、染色體（單倍體 7）與基因檢測確認。
features: Hypocellular marrow for age with predominance of adipocytes between trabeculae
Patchy, loosely distributed residual hematopoietic cells, erythroid and myeloid elements
Scattered golden-brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Megakaryocytes not clearly identifiable at this magnification
Unremarkable bony trabeculae; no fibrosis, lymphoid aggregates, or blast sheets
60445.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypocellular marrow for age, with intertrabecular spaces composed predominantly of adipocytes and patchy residual trilineage hematopoietic cells. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present, and no fibrosis, granulomas, or sheets of immature cells are seen. Megakaryocytic dysplasia cannot be adequately evaluated at this magnification. In the clinical context of monocytopenia, B- and NK-lymphopenia, disseminated MAC infection, monosomy 7, and a germline GATA2 mutation, findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, GATA2 deficiency related.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia lacks megakaryocytic dysplasia, monosomy 7, and the profound monocytopenia with B/NK lymphopenia characteristic of GATA2 deficiency.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular marrow due to disseminated mycobacterial infection
ddx.vs: Infection may show granulomas or AFB-positive organisms, but it does not explain monosomy 7 or a germline GATA2 mutation.
It requires at least 2% blood or 5% marrow blasts, which are not seen here and should be confirmed by CD34 staining.
It can also present with monosomy 7 and hypocellularity but lacks mycobacterial infection and monocyte/B/NK deficiency and needs germline sequencing to distinguish.

60125.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央的嗜中性球核分成兩個左右對稱的圓形葉，中間以細細的染色質絲相連，呈典型「夾鼻眼鏡」（pince-nez）外觀，染色質粗塊、細胞質顆粒正常，為 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Neutrophil with two symmetric round nuclear lobes joined by a thin chromatin bridge (pince-nez)
Coarsely clumped, dense mature chromatin
Normal neutrophilic granulation of the cytoplasm
Normal cell size for a segmented neutrophil
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
60125.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a classic bilobed pince-nez nucleus, consisting of two symmetric round lobes connected by a thin chromatin strand, with coarsely clumped chromatin. The cytoplasm shows normal granulation. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët anomaly, provided most neutrophils are similarly affected and there is no evidence of an acquired myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are frequently hypogranular, affect only a proportion of neutrophils and occur with cytopenias or other dysplasia.
Agents such as mycophenolate, valproate or colchicine cause reversible hypolobation identified by medication history.
Eosinophils are bilobed but have coarse orange-red granules rather than fine lilac neutrophilic granules.

exam.answer_en: Pelger–Huët anomaly — neutrophil with two symmetric round lobes joined by a thin chromatin strand (pince-nez), coarse chromatin, normal granules
pearls_zh: 考法：典型「夾鼻眼鏡」核，考官問細胞名稱，並追問如何區分遺傳性與後天 pseudo-Pelger：看顆粒是否正常、受影響比例、是否有血球減少與其他系發育不良。
遺傳性 Pelger-Huët 為 LBR 基因突變（體染色體顯性），嗜中性球殺菌與趨化功能正常，不需治療；家族成員抹片有相同表現可佐證。
後天 pseudo-Pelger：MDS/AML 等骨髓腫瘤（常合併 hypogranulation）、藥物如 mycophenolate、valproate、colchicine；停藥後可恢復。
MDS 形態判讀：單一系發育不良需達該系細胞 10% 以上才算有意義；只看到零星 pseudo-Pelger 不足以診斷 MDS。
exam.pitfall_zh: 容易被當成 eosinophil（也是雙葉核）或 band：eosinophil 有粗大橘紅色顆粒；band 核為連續彎曲、寬度一致。此細胞為細小淡紫嗜中性顆粒加上兩個以細絲相連的緻密圓葉。

quiz.q: 看到這種雙葉核嗜中性球且伴隨明顯顆粒減少與全血球減少時，應優先考慮什麼診斷？
quiz.a: 後天性 pseudo-Pelger-Huët change，需排除 MDS/AML（骨髓檢查與細胞遺傳）。

60061.recognize_zh: 三天連續的周邊血液流式圖並排比較：CD45 對 SSC 圖中紅色「母細胞」族群（CD45 弱/陰性、低 SSC）從第 1 天約 5%、第 2 天約 21% 增加到第 3 天約 44%，下方 CD10 對 CD34 圖中同一群 CD10 強陽性、CD34 陽性細胞也同步擴大；這呈現 B-ALL 母細胞在短時間內快速增加。
features: Top row CD45 vs SSC: red blast gate (CD45 dim/negative, low SSC) rising from 5.36% (Day 1) to 20.79% (Day 2) to 44.04% (Day 3)
Reciprocal relative decrease of granulocytes (40% to 21%) and lymphocytes (51% to 32%)
Bottom row CD10 vs CD34: expanding red population in the CD10 bright/CD34 positive quadrant (about 4%, 19%, 43%)
Blast immunophenotype remains stable across the three time points
Day 3 blast cluster smears toward more negative CD45, consistent with a larger, more homogeneous leukemic population
60061.describe_en: Serial flow cytometric analyses of peripheral blood obtained over 72 hours are displayed as CD45 versus side-scatter plots (top) and CD10 versus CD34 plots of gated events (bottom). A population of CD45-dim to negative, low side-scatter blasts (red) increases from approximately 5% on Day 1 to 21% on Day 2 and 44% on Day 3, with a proportional relative decline of granulocytes and lymphocytes. The expanding population is uniformly CD10 bright and CD34 positive, and its immunophenotype is stable over time. These findings document a rapidly rising circulating B-lymphoblast population consistent with progressive peripheral blood involvement by B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Hematogones rarely circulate in such numbers and show a continuous maturation spectrum with loss of CD34 and acquisition of CD20, rather than a discrete, expanding CD34+/CD10 bright cluster.
Would populate the same CD45-dim blast gate but lack bright CD10 and B-lineage antigens, expressing CD13/CD33/CD117 instead.
Also rapidly proliferative and CD10 positive, but CD34 negative with bright CD45 and surface light chain restriction.

20381.recognize_zh: 血片中大量中大型原始細胞（blasts），染色質細緻、可見核仁、胞質嗜鹼性，部分聚集成團；紅血球呈小球性且大小不均並有標靶細胞，細胞化學染色部分原始細胞呈深色陽性。血紅素 E（Hgb E）無法單靠形態確認，需電泳或 HPLC。
features: Numerous medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine open chromatin and visible nucleoli, some in cohesive clusters
Scant-to-moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Microcytic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis and scattered target cells
Marrow aspirate (panel B) replaced by sheets of blasts
Cytochemical stain (panel C) with dark granular positivity in a subset of blasts, consistent with myeloid lineage
20381.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of medium-to-large blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm, some forming clusters. The background red cells are microcytic with anisopoikilocytosis and occasional target cells. The bone marrow aspirate shows sheets of similar blasts, and a cytochemical stain highlights granular positivity in a subset of blasts, supporting myeloid lineage. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the microcytic target cell picture could reflect hemoglobin E, which must be confirmed by hemoglobin HPLC or electrophoresis.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are MPO/Sudan black negative with scant cytoplasm, so the cytochemical positivity here and flow cytometry favor AML.
Iron deficiency causes microcytosis with pencil cells and low ferritin, whereas Hgb E shows target cells with normal iron studies and an abnormal Hb band on HPLC.
Thal trait gives microcytosis with basophilic stippling and raised Hb A2, whereas Hgb E co-elutes with A2 on HPLC at much higher percentage (25–30% in trait).

12957.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一條遠比周圍細胞長的蛇形線蟲幼體（microfilaria），體內充滿密集排列的深紫色體核柱，一端逐漸變細，周圍有一圈透明空隙可能為鞘膜；鑑定為班氏絲蟲（Wuchereria bancrofti）需依鞘膜、頭間隙與尾端無末端核等細節。
features: Elongated, sinuous microfilaria many times longer than surrounding hematopoietic cells
Body filled with a column of closely packed, darkly staining somatic nuclei
Tapered end with nuclei not clearly extending to the tip
Clear space around the organism, possibly representing a sheath; fine sheath detail not resolved
Background marrow cells including lymphocytes, an eosinophilic granulocyte and erythroid precursors
12957.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a long, sinuous microfilaria with a column of densely packed somatic nuclei and a tapered end, surrounded by a clear space that may represent a sheath. Background marrow elements, including lymphocytes, granulocytes and erythroid precursors, are present without Leishman-Donovan bodies in this field. Species-level features such as the cephalic space and tail nuclei cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with microfilaremia; in this case the organism was identified as Wuchereria bancrofti, and a nocturnal thick blood film is recommended.

ddx.vs: Brugia microfilariae are sheathed but have a sheath staining pink with Giemsa and two separate terminal nuclei at the tail tip.
Loa loa is sheathed with nuclei extending continuously to the tip of the tail and shows diurnal periodicity.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller, unsheathed and have a blunt tail with nuclei extending to the tip.
Fibrin strands lack an organized column of nuclei and defined head and tail ends.

2973.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞豐富，其中可見巨噬細胞淡染的大片細胞質內吞入完整的有核細胞（右側一顆巨噬細胞內含多個深染的紅血球母細胞/淋巴球核）與細胞碎屑，這種組織球吞噬血球的現象即為噬血症（hemophagocytosis），需配合臨床 HLH 診斷標準。
features: Cellular aspirate with mixed maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Histiocyte with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing several engulfed dark nucleated cells (right of center)
Second histiocyte (center) with pale foamy cytoplasm containing phagocytosed debris and granular material
Numerous small dense nucleated cells (orthochromatic normoblasts/lymphocytes) in the background
No blast population or atypical lymphoid infiltrate evident
2973.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and scattered lymphocytes. Several histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm are present, one of which contains multiple engulfed intact nucleated hematopoietic cells, and another contains phagocytosed debris. No increase in blasts or atypical lymphoid cells is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in the appropriate clinical setting (fever, cytopenias, splenomegaly, high ferritin and soluble CD25), this supports hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, although hemophagocytosis alone is neither sensitive nor specific.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion, sepsis or chemotherapy
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; distinction relies on clinical HLH criteria rather than the histiocytes themselves.
Lymphoma-associated HLH shows an atypical lymphoid infiltrate or EBER-positive cells, which are not evident in this field.

ddx.dx: Leishmaniasis or histoplasmosis with macrophage activation
ddx.vs: Infected macrophages contain small organisms (amastigotes with kinetoplasts or haloed yeasts) rather than whole engulfed blood cells.

ddx.dx: Erythroid islands (central macrophage with surrounding normoblasts)
ddx.vs: In erythroid islands the normoblasts surround the macrophage rather than lying within its cytoplasmic vacuoles.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis (supporting HLH) — bone marrow histiocyte engulfing intact nucleated hematopoietic cells and debris
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含完整有核細胞的巨噬細胞，問「這個現象叫什麼、足以診斷 HLH 嗎」；答案：hemophagocytosis 只是 HLH-2004 八項標準之一，非必要也非特異。
HLH-2004：符合分子診斷，或 8 項中 ≥5 項：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高三酸甘油酯和/或低纖維蛋白原、hemophagocytosis、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL。
遺傳性（familial）HLH 相關基因：PRF1、UNC13D、STX11、STXBP2；其他如 X-linked lymphoproliferative disease（SH2D1A、XIAP）。確診遺傳性者需安排 HSCT。
成人繼發性 HLH 常見誘因：EBV 等感染、T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤、自體免疫（MAS）；需積極找潛在淋巴瘤。治療可用 HLH-94 方案（etoposide + dexamethasone）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 erythroblastic island（中央巨噬細胞被紅血球母細胞「包圍」）誤當吞噬；真正的 hemophagocytosis 是細胞完整被包在巨噬細胞細胞質「內」，常伴空泡。

quiz.q: 圖中右側巨噬細胞內含多個完整有核細胞，這個現象稱為什麼？在 HLH-2004 診斷標準中它是否為必要條件？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis（噬血現象）；不是必要條件，只是 8 項標準之一。

12893.recognize_zh: 血液抹片（A）中數顆紅血球內布滿粗大、均勻分布的藍黑色點狀顆粒（粗嗜鹼性點彩，coarse basophilic stippling），加上 X 光/CT（B）顯示大腿軟組織內殘留金屬子彈碎片，指向鉛中毒；與標題分類的苯中毒不符。
features: Red cells containing coarse, evenly distributed dark blue-purple punctate inclusions (coarse basophilic stippling)
Background red cells with target cells, mild anisopoikilocytosis, and scattered hypochromic cells
Mature segmented neutrophil without toxic change
Imaging panel: plain radiograph and CT reconstructions showing a femoral intramedullary rod and retained radiodense metallic fragments in the thigh soft tissue (panel B)
12893.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several red cells with coarse, evenly dispersed basophilic stippling, in a background of target cells, mild anisopoikilocytosis, and occasional hypochromic cells; a mature neutrophil is unremarkable. The accompanying radiograph and CT reconstructions show an intramedullary femoral rod with retained radiodense metallic fragments in the thigh soft tissues, consistent with a retained bullet. In a patient with chronic unexplained abdominal pain, findings are suggestive of lead poisoning from retained bullet fragments; blood lead level and zinc protoporphyrin should be measured. The image does not support the benzene/environmental toxin aplastic anemia category under which it is filed.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia also shows target cells and basophilic stippling but with uniform microcytosis, normal blood lead, and abnormal hemoglobin studies or globin gene testing.
Congenital P5'N deficiency causes lifelong hemolysis with prominent stippling and no lead exposure, and is confirmed by enzyme assay or NT5C3A testing.
Pappenheimer bodies are fewer, peripheral, clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, whereas basophilic stippling is diffuse and Prussian blue negative.
These can show stippling but have macrocytosis, oval macrocytes, hypersegmented or dysplastic neutrophils, and no radiodense foreign bodies.

exam.answer_en: Coarse basophilic stippling suggesting lead poisoning from retained bullet fragments (image does not support benzene toxicity)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅血球內均勻分布的藍黑色粗點，問「叫什麼、合併影像中的金屬碎片想到什麼」；答案 coarse basophilic stippling，鉛中毒。
機轉：鉛抑制 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase，核糖體 RNA 無法降解而聚集成點彩；鉛也抑制 ALA dehydratase 與 ferrochelatase，使 zinc protoporphyrin 升高。
檢查：血中鉛濃度（blood lead level）與 ZPP；體內殘留子彈碎片（尤其接觸關節液或骨骼時）可成為慢性鉛來源。
臨床：腹痛（lead colic）、周邊運動神經病變、貧血；處置為移除鉛來源（手術取出碎片）並視血鉛值考慮螯合治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆：Pappenheimer bodies 較少、聚在細胞一側且 Prussian blue 陽性；basophilic stippling 為 RNA、鐵染色陰性且均勻分布整個紅血球。

quiz.q: 圖 A 紅血球內均勻分布的粗大藍黑色點狀顆粒叫什麼？配合 X 光中殘留的子彈碎片，應驗哪一項檢查？
quiz.a: Coarse basophilic stippling；血中鉛濃度（blood lead level，可加 zinc protoporphyrin）。

17949.recognize_zh: 這是風險分層表格加存活曲線與流程圖，非形態圖：依細胞遺傳分類再加上 FLT3-ITD、NPM1、IDH1/2、CEBPA、TET2、ASXL1、MLL-PTD、DNMT3A 等突變，把 AML 重新分為 favorable、intermediate、unfavorable 三組。
features: Composite table, survival curves and flow diagram; not a morphologic image
Top table: integrated risk classification combining cytogenetic risk with mutation status
Favorable: favorable cytogenetics, or FLT3-ITD-negative with mutant NPM1 plus IDH1/IDH2
Unfavorable: unfavorable cytogenetics, or intermediate cytogenetics with TET2, MLL-PTD, ASXL1, PHF6 (FLT3-ITD-negative) or TET2, MLL-PTD, DNMT3A, trisomy 8 without CEBPA (FLT3-ITD-positive)
Middle: test-cohort Kaplan-Meier curves separating genotype-defined risk groups
Bottom: reassignment of patients from cytogenetic to integrated risk classes with 3-year OS
17949.describe_en: This composite figure (Patel and Levine, Hematology 2012) presents a revised AML risk stratification integrating cytogenetics with mutational profiling. The table assigns patients with normal or intermediate-risk karyotypes to favorable, intermediate or unfavorable groups according to FLT3-ITD status and mutations in NPM1, IDH1/2, CEBPA, TET2, ASXL1, PHF6, MLL-PTD and DNMT3A, and trisomy 8. Kaplan-Meier curves in a test cohort show distinct overall survival among these groups, and the flow diagram shows how mutational analysis redistributes patients so that the favorable and unfavorable groups enlarge while the intermediate group shrinks. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.

16477.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見細胞拉長呈梭形（spindle-shaped）的肥大細胞，細胞質帶有紫色顆粒但分布不均、部分顆粒減少，並伸出細長突起，這種非典型梭形肥大細胞是系統性肥大細胞增多症的次要診斷條件。
features: Panel A: elongated spindle-shaped mast cell with an oval nucleus and cytoplasm containing dark purple metachromatic granules
Granules unevenly distributed with a tapering, granule-poor cytoplasmic extension (hypogranular atypical mast cell)
Panel B: curved, elongated mast cell with coarse purple granules against a pale background of small lymphoid/myeloid cells
Adjacent background of mixed myeloid precursors, eosinophils and lymphocytes
No round, fully granulated typical mast cells in these fields
16477.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show atypical mast cells with spindled, elongated morphology. In panel A the mast cell has an oval nucleus and cytoplasm with coarse purple metachromatic granules that are unevenly distributed, with a tapered granule-poor extension; panel B shows a curved spindled mast cell with coarse granules among small hematopoietic cells. These cells differ from normal round, densely granulated mast cells. Spindle-shaped atypical mast cells (>25% of mast cells) are a minor WHO criterion; findings are suggestive of systemic mastocytosis, pending biopsy for multifocal mast cell aggregates, CD25/CD2 expression, KIT D816V and serum tryptase.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round-oval, fully granulated, scattered singly without aggregates, CD25 negative and lack KIT D816V.
Basophils are smaller with segmented nuclei and water-soluble granules overlying the nucleus, and are tryptase weak/CD25 negative with CD123 positivity.
Stromal spindle cells lack metachromatic cytoplasmic granules and are tryptase and CD117 negative.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: This can show increased spindled CD25+ mast cells but lacks KIT D816V, has FIP1L1::PDGFRA and prominent eosinophilia.

exam.answer_en: Systemic mastocytosis — atypical spindle-shaped, hypogranular mast cells on marrow aspirate (minor diagnostic criterion)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著含紫色顆粒的梭形細胞問「這是什麼細胞、異常在哪？」答：atypical mast cell，梭形、顆粒不均/減少，>25% 為 SM 次要診斷條件。
WHO 5th／ICC 2022 主要條件：骨髓或皮膚外器官多灶性密集 mast cell 聚集（≥15 顆）；次要條件含 >25% 非典型形態、KIT D816V、CD25/CD2/CD30 表現、血清 tryptase >20 ng/mL。
WHO 5th 診斷需 1 主要＋1 次要或 ≥3 次要條件；若合併其他 myeloid neoplasm，tryptase 條件不適用。
KIT D816V 以高敏感度 PCR（ddPCR/ASO-qPCR）檢測；advanced SM 的 KIT 抑制劑包括 midostaurin、avapritinib。
exam.pitfall_zh: 梭形細胞易被誤認為骨髓基質纖維母細胞，或把 mast cell 誤認為 basophil；mast cell 核為圓/卵圓不分葉、顆粒不溶於水且 tryptase/CD117 陽性，basophil 核分葉且較小。

quiz.q: 圖中含紫色顆粒的梭形細胞是什麼？這種形態佔多少比例時可作為 SM 的次要診斷條件？
quiz.a: 非典型（梭形）肥大細胞；>25% 的 mast cells 呈非典型形態

15197.recognize_zh: 死於分化症候群（retinoic acid syndrome）病人的肺部切片：A 圖肺泡腔（L）與薄的肺泡壁，星號處血管內有白血球聚集；B 圖肺泡腔（W）內充滿大量髓系白血球浸潤，並伴隨粉紅色的玻璃樣膜或纖維素沉積（箭頭）。
features: Panel A (lung, H&E, grayscale): open alveolar lumen (L) with thin alveolar septa; asterisk marks a septal vessel containing leukocytes
Panel B: alveolar space (W) filled with numerous round leukocytes with dense nuclei, consistent with infiltrating maturing myeloid cells
Arrows in panel B: eosinophilic homogeneous hyaline membrane/fibrinous material lining alveolar walls
Intra-alveolar edema-like granular proteinaceous background
Black-and-white reproduction limits assessment of cytoplasmic granules and nuclear detail
15197.describe_en: Lung sections from fatal cases (grayscale H&E reproductions) show, in panel A, relatively preserved thin alveolar septa around an alveolar lumen (L), with a septal vessel (asterisk) containing aggregated leukocytes. Panel B shows an alveolar space (W) filled with numerous leukocytes with dense round-to-lobated nuclei, admixed with proteinaceous exudate, and hyaline membrane-like fibrinous deposits along the alveolar walls (arrows). Individual cell lineage and granulation cannot be confirmed in these grayscale images. In APL patients receiving ATRA, findings are consistent with differentiation (retinoic acid) syndrome with leukocyte infiltration of the lung and diffuse alveolar damage.

ddx.vs: Infectious pneumonia shows neutrophilic exudate with organisms on Gram/GMS stains and may form abscesses, whereas differentiation syndrome shows infiltrating maturing leukemic myeloid cells in the setting of ATRA/ATO without organisms.
Leukostasis shows intravascular plugs of blasts or promyelocytes, while differentiation syndrome shows extravasation of differentiating myeloid cells into interstitium and alveoli with edema.
DAH fills alveoli with red cells and hemosiderin-laden macrophages rather than predominantly leukocytes.
Cardiogenic edema shows eosinophilic transudate with few inflammatory cells and no hyaline membranes.

13021.recognize_zh: A 圖膝關節 MRI 的股骨遠端與脛骨近端骨髓出現大片異常低至中等訊號區，B 圖骨髓切片細胞密度極高、以各階段顆粒球為主並有嗜酸性顆粒細胞，對應慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）的骨髓過度增生；診斷需 BCR::ABL1 證實。
features: Radiology (A): sagittal knee MRI with extensive abnormal intermediate-low signal replacing marrow of distal femur and proximal tibia metaphyses; inset shows fibular epiphyseal involvement (arrow)
BM biopsy (B): markedly hypercellular (near 100%) marrow abutting a bony trabecula with no visible fat
BM biopsy (B): sheets of maturing granulocytic precursors with round to indented nuclei
BM biopsy (B): scattered cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm (eosinophil precursors)
Megakaryocyte morphology not well assessable in this field
13021.describe_en: Sagittal MRI of the knee shows extensive intermediate-to-low signal intensity replacing normal fatty marrow in the diametaphyseal regions of the distal femur and proximal tibia, with involvement of the fibular epiphysis on the inset. The bone marrow biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-absent fat, composed of sheets of maturing granulocytic precursors with admixed eosinophilic granulocytes. No sheets of blasts are evident at this magnification. In conjunction with the leukocytosis and left-shifted differential, findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm, and with the demonstrated t(9;22) are diagnostic of chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive.

ddx.vs: Reconversion shows patchy signal that spares epiphyses and a normocellular marrow with normal blood counts, whereas CML involves epiphyses with hypercellular granulocytic marrow.
Reactive hyperplasia lacks basophilia and eosinophilia, has high LAP score and is BCR::ABL1 negative.

ddx.dx: Chronic neutrophilic leukemia or atypical CML
ddx.vs: These are BCR::ABL1 negative, with CSF3R mutation or dysgranulopoiesis respectively.
These also cause diffuse MRI marrow replacement but show sheets of blasts or atypical lymphoid cells rather than full granulocytic maturation.

12509.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液（CSF）細胞離心抹片中出現三顆遠大於正常淋巴球的異型大細胞，核大不規則、有核仁，胞質嗜鹼性並帶小空泡與不規則突起，在已知瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的病人提示腦膜復發。
features: Three large atypical lymphoid cells, many times the size of a normal small lymphocyte
Large round to irregular nuclei with open chromatin and visible nucleoli
Moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm with small clear vacuoles and irregular blebbed borders
Cells lie singly in a sparse, acellular-appearing proteinaceous background
Suboptimal staining and background artifact limit fine chromatin assessment
12509.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows a paucicellular specimen containing scattered large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have high N:C ratios, large irregular nuclei with open chromatin and nucleoli, and basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs. Normal small lymphocytes and monocytes are not prominent in this field, and background staining artifact limits detail. In a patient with known diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with leptomeningeal relapse; CSF flow cytometry for a clonal B-cell population is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF shows a polymorphous mix of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid forms and monocytes, whereas lymphoma shows a monotonous population of large atypical cells with clonal B-cell phenotype by flow.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with molding and are keratin positive/CD45 negative, unlike discohesive CD45/CD20 positive lymphoma cells.
Lining cells occur in cohesive sheets with bland round nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, lacking the high N:C ratio and nucleoli of lymphoma cells.

11293.recognize_zh: 抹片邊緣附近可見約十顆型態正常的分葉嗜中性球緊密擠成一團（neutrophil clumping），而其他區域白血球很少，提示體外聚集造成的假性嗜中性球減少（pseudoneutropenia）。
features: Tight aggregate of about ten mature segmented neutrophils near the feathered edge
Individual neutrophils have normal segmented nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm
No leukocytes dispersed elsewhere in the field
Background red cells with target-like central pallor and scattered platelets
No phagocytosed material or bacteria in the aggregate
11293.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a tight cluster of morphologically normal segmented neutrophils located near the feathered edge, while the rest of the field contains no dispersed leukocytes. Red cells form a monolayer and platelets are present individually without clumping. No toxic changes or organisms are seen in the aggregated neutrophils. Findings are consistent with in vitro neutrophil aggregation, a cause of spuriously low automated white cell and neutrophil counts; a repeat count using citrate or heparin anticoagulant or a fingerstick smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Genuine neutropenia shows sparse neutrophils evenly across the slide without clusters at the feathered edge, and persists with alternate anticoagulants.
Satellitism shows platelets encircling individual neutrophils, rather than neutrophils adhering to one another.

ddx.dx: Leukoagglutination due to storage or infection
ddx.vs: Clumps with engulfed bacteria or fibrin strands suggest bacteremia or delayed processing, whereas these aggregates contain clean normal neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: In vitro neutrophil clumping (pseudoneutropenia) — tight aggregate of morphologically normal segmented neutrophils near the feathered edge
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 feathered edge 的中性球團塊，問「白血球低下可信嗎」；自動計數機無法計入團塊，造成假性白血球/中性球減少。
多為 EDTA 依賴性體外聚集，與抗體介導相關，常見於感染、自體免疫或惡性疾病病人，但病人本身無真正的中性球功能缺陷。
確認方式：檢查抹片邊緣與尾端，改用 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重抽、或指尖血直接抹片計數；部分病例樣本保溫可減少聚集。
報告與臨床：避免因假性嗜中性球減少而延誤化療、進行骨髓檢查或給予不必要的 G-CSF；應與 platelet clumping/satellitism 一併在抹片上篩檢。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把白血球團塊誤認為非造血腫瘤細胞群或巨核細胞；此團塊由核分葉、胞質含細顆粒的正常中性球組成，無核質比異常或黏合性上皮特徵。

quiz.q: 自動計數顯示中性球減少，但抹片邊緣見圖中團塊，應如何處理檢體以取得正確計數？
quiz.a: 改用 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重抽（或指尖血抹片），此為 EDTA 相關假性中性球減少

3613.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒中可見許多巨核細胞，多為圓形、核分葉較少、細胞質豐富，數量明顯增加但未形成異常緊密的群聚，符合 ITP 骨髓中巨核細胞代償性增加。
features: Cellular marrow particle with numerous megakaryocytes in a single medium-power field
Megakaryocytes mostly round, many with less-lobulated or compact nuclei, suggesting a younger population
Moderate to abundant cytoplasm without obvious platelet budding at this magnification
Megakaryocytes loosely scattered rather than in tight atypical clusters
Background granulocytic and erythroid precursors with interspersed fat vacuoles
3613.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate particle is hypercellular and contains numerous megakaryocytes. Many megakaryocytes are round with less lobulated nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, suggesting a shift toward younger forms, and they are loosely scattered without tight clustering. Granulocytic and erythroid precursors are present in the background. Findings are consistent with increased megakaryocytes due to peripheral platelet destruction, as in immune thrombocytopenia, in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and occur with thrombocytosis, not thrombocytopenia.
PMF megakaryocytes are pleomorphic with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and form tight clusters, often with a dry tap and reticulin fibrosis.
MDS shows micromegakaryocytes and separated nuclear lobes with dysplasia in other lineages, which are not a feature of ITP.

3037.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片只看到紅血球變化：散在淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocyte）與少數不規則碎片狀紅血球，血小板數量不少；畫面中並沒有腫瘤細胞，需結合轉移性攝護腺癌侵犯骨髓或慢性 DIC 的臨床背景解讀。
features: Scattered teardrop cells (dacrocytes) among normochromic red cells
Occasional irregular fragmented / helmet-like red cells
Mild anisopoikilocytosis
Platelets appear adequate in number
No nucleated red cells, immature myeloid cells or tumor cells in this field
3037.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including scattered teardrop cells and occasional fragmented, helmet-like forms. Platelets appear adequate. No leukocytes, nucleated red cells or circulating tumor cells are present in this field. These red cell changes are nonspecific; in a patient with metastatic prostatic carcinoma they are suggestive of marrow infiltration (myelophthisis) and/or tumor-associated microangiopathy or chronic DIC, but the carcinoma itself is not demonstrated in this image.

ddx.vs: Also produces dacrocytes, but typically with a leukoerythroblastic picture and a JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation rather than a known carcinoma with marrow metastases.
TMA shows abundant schistocytes with marked thrombocytopenia, whereas here fragments are few and platelets appear adequate.
These show microcytic hypochromic cells and target cells or pencil cells rather than normochromic cells with teardrops and helmet cells.

2909.recognize_zh: 這是一袋血小板輸血製劑的照片：透明塑膠袋內為黃色半透明血漿液體，標籤標示 A 型、Rh 陽性，並貼有另一張產品標籤，外觀符合血小板成分血而非紅血球製劑。
features: Clinical photograph of a transfusion bag containing yellow, translucent fluid
Label indicating blood group A, Rh positive
Additional product label strip on the lower portion of the bag
Fluid color consistent with plasma-suspended platelets rather than red cells
Swirling phenomenon cannot be assessed on a static photograph
2909.describe_en: This is a photograph of a blood component bag, not a microscopic image. The bag contains a yellow, translucent fluid, without visible red cell sediment, and bears a label showing group A, Rh positive, with an additional product label below. The appearance is consistent with a platelet component suspended in plasma. Visual inspection before release should include checking for clots, abnormal color, turbidity or absence of swirling, which may indicate bacterial contamination or platelet activation; swirling cannot be evaluated from a still image.

ddx.vs: Thawed plasma is also yellow but clearer and lacks platelet swirling, and it is labeled as plasma rather than platelets.
Cryoprecipitate is supplied as a small-volume, cloudy concentrate rather than a large bag of yellow fluid.
Contaminated units may show clumps, abnormal color, gas or loss of swirling, which require inspection and culture rather than a photograph alone.

1181.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一顆與紅血球等大、邊緣呈泡狀突起的淡染巨大血小板（或巨核細胞胞質碎片），左側有一小塊深紫色顆粒狀的巨核細胞碎片，背景紅血球大小形狀不一並有淚滴細胞，符合骨髓纖維化的周邊血液表現。
features: Giant, pale, finely granular platelet about the size of a red cell with bubbly, blebbed margins
Small dense, deeply granular megakaryocytic fragment at left
Anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes and occasional stomatocyte-like forms
Platelets of variable size, including large hypogranular forms
No white cells or nucleated red cells in this field
1181.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes. Platelets vary in size and include a giant, pale, finely granular platelet approximately the size of a red cell with blebbed margins, as well as a small dense, darkly granular megakaryocytic fragment. No leukocytes or nucleated red cells are present in this field to assess for a leukoerythroblastic picture. Giant and bizarre platelets with circulating megakaryocytic fragments and dacrocytes are characteristic of myelofibrosis. Findings are consistent with primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and marrow biopsy context.

ddx.vs: ET has giant platelets but lacks teardrop poikilocytosis and circulating megakaryocytic fragments, with normal red cell morphology.
Inherited disorders show uniformly large platelets with thrombocytopenia (and Döhle-like inclusions in MYH9) but normal red cells without dacrocytes.
Marrow infiltration produces the same blood picture; marrow biopsy and driver mutation testing distinguish it from PMF.

1117.recognize_zh: 一群中型、大小一致的淋巴母細胞，細胞質深藍色（強嗜鹼性）並布滿清楚的脂質空泡，染色質細緻，這是Burkitt白血病（FAB L3）的經典外觀。
features: Cluster of monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid blasts
Moderately high N:C ratio with round nuclei and finely stippled chromatin; small nucleoli faintly visible
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
Vacuoles concentrated at the cytoplasmic periphery and some overlying the nucleus
Background with smudged nuclei, vacuolated debris, and scattered red cells
1117.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of monomorphic medium-sized blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains numerous well-defined clear lipid vacuoles. Adjacent disrupted cells and vacuolated background debris are present. Findings are consistent with Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (mature B-cell, CD10+, surface light chain restricted) and MYC rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm with few or no vacuoles and are TdT-positive with absent surface immunoglobulin.
Monoblasts have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles, folded nuclei, and nonspecific esterase positivity, rather than uniform deeply blue cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with MYC rearrangement / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show greater nuclear pleomorphism and larger cells, and genetic studies (MYC plus BCL2 rearrangement, complex karyotype) distinguish them.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt leukemia (FAB L3) — monomorphic medium-sized blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm packed with clear lipid vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著這群細胞問「FAB 分類？flow 應該看到什麼？」答 L3，mature B 表型：CD10+、surface light chain 限制、TdT 陰性。
遺傳：MYC 重組，約 80% 為 t(8;14) MYC::IGH，其餘為 t(2;8) IGK 或 t(8;22) IGL；FISH 以 MYC break-apart probe 篩檢。
組織學連結：切片為 starry-sky pattern，Ki-67 近 100%、BCL2 陰性；這些與形態一起是區分 DLBCL 的重點。
臨床：常見 CNS 與骨髓侵犯，治療需含 CNS 預防；治療初期 tumor lysis syndrome 風險最高，需監測電解質與腎功能。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 acute monoblastic leukemia 的空泡化芽細胞混淆；單核母細胞較大、胞質灰藍較多、核折疊且 NSE 陽性，Burkitt 細胞大小一致、胞質深藍並為 B 細胞表型。

quiz.q: 圖中深藍胞質並布滿空泡的母細胞，flow cytometry 上 TdT 應呈陽性或陰性？表面輕鏈呢？
quiz.a: TdT 陰性；表面免疫球蛋白輕鏈限制（κ 或 λ 單一表現）

1053.recognize_zh: 紅血球聚成不規則、葡萄串狀的大團塊（agglutination），而不是像錢幣疊成一列的 rouleaux；團塊之外的紅血球形態大致正常，視野中還有一顆小淋巴球，符合冷凝集素病。
features: Irregular, three-dimensional clumps of red cells with scalloped, grape-like outlines (true agglutination), rather than linear stacks
Non-agglutinated red cells are mostly normocytic with central pallor; no definite spherocytes or schistocytes in this field
Single small mature lymphocyte with condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Platelets present in normal-appearing numbers in the background
1053.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent red cell agglutination, with red cells forming irregular, branching clumps of variable size scattered throughout the field. The clumps are irregular rather than linear, distinguishing them from rouleaux. Red cells outside the clumps are largely normochromic without obvious spherocytosis in this field. A single small mature lymphocyte is present, and platelets appear adequate. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination due to a cold agglutinin, as seen in cold agglutinin disease; correlation with warming of the sample, DAT (C3d positive) and cold agglutinin titer, and evaluation for an underlying lymphoproliferative disorder is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear, coin-like stacks in thin areas that disperse with saline, whereas agglutination forms irregular grape-like clumps that disperse on warming to 37 C.
Warm AIHA typically shows spherocytes and polychromasia with IgG-positive DAT, and agglutination is usually absent or minimal.
Artifactual clumping is focal and inconsistent, while cold agglutination is diffuse, reproducible, and abolished when blood is kept and smeared at 37 C.

exam.answer_en: Cold agglutinin disease — irregular grape-like red cell agglutinates (not rouleaux)
pearls_zh: 考法：指不規則成團的紅血球，問「是 agglutination 還是 rouleaux？」答 agglutination；將檢體加溫至 37°C 後團塊散開即支持 cold agglutinin。
必考實驗室：DAT 為 C3d 陽性、IgG 通常陰性；抗體多為 IgM anti-I。Mycoplasma pneumoniae 相關多為 anti-I，EBV 相關多為 anti-i。
自動血球計數假象：凝集團被當成單一大細胞，造成 RBC 計數假性下降、MCV 與 MCHC 假性升高；加溫後重測可校正。
治療重點：保暖、避免冷刺激；類固醇效果差；可用 rituximab 為基礎的治療，或 complement C1s inhibitor sutimlimab；需找潛在 B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 rouleaux：rouleaux 為錢幣疊成直線、見於高球蛋白（如 myeloma），加生理食鹽水可散開；cold agglutination 為不規則立體團塊，加溫後散開。

quiz.q: 此抹片紅血球聚集屬於哪一種現象？DAT 典型結果為何？
quiz.a: Agglutination（cold agglutinin）；DAT C3d 陽性、IgG 陰性

3997.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 骨髓中，組織球淡染的細胞質內散佈許多大小一致、約 2–3 µm 的小圓點（中央偏下最明顯），即 LD bodies；因切片保存差與解析度限制，看不清動基體（kinetoplast）。
features: Edematous, poorly preserved marrow with vacuolated background
Histiocytes with pale, finely granular cytoplasm containing numerous uniform tiny round bodies (~2–3 µm), most evident centrally
Scattered plasma cells and lymphocytes with dense round nuclei
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei (histiocytes/precursors)
Refractile brown pigment granule in lower center (hemosiderin/artifact)
Organism internal structure (nucleus and kinetoplast) not resolved
3997.describe_en: High-power H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows edematous, poorly preserved marrow with histiocytes containing numerous small, uniform, round intracytoplasmic bodies measuring approximately 2–3 µm, admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei. A refractile pigment granule is also present. The nucleus and kinetoplast of the organisms cannot be resolved on this section. Findings are suggestive of Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis in this HIV-positive patient; Giemsa staining of the aspirate, culture, or PCR should be used for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo, lack a kinetoplast, and are GMS/PAS-positive.
Talaromyces organisms are GMS-positive and show transverse septa from binary fission, relevant in HIV patients from Southeast Asia.
Cryptococcus has a mucicarmine-positive capsule with variable size, and Pneumocystis appears as extracellular foamy cysts on GMS.
Debris is heterogeneous in size and shape rather than uniform ovoid organisms.

4189.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有數顆異常淋巴球，其中一顆核呈多葉、分葉凹陷狀，類似花瓣（flower cell），另一顆核形不規則、染色質緻密，提示 ATLL；需以 HTLV-1 血清學確認。
features: Atypical medium-sized lymphocytes with scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
One cell with polylobated, clover-leaf nucleus (flower cell)
Other cells with irregular, indented nuclei and condensed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous
Background red cells unremarkable with scattered platelets and a platelet clump
4189.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered atypical lymphoid cells of medium size with condensed chromatin and irregular nuclear contours, including a cell with a polylobated, flower-like nucleus. Nucleoli are not prominent. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable apart from a small platelet clump. Findings are suggestive of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation with flow cytometry (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) and HTLV-1 serology is required.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than deeply polylobated flower shapes, and patients are HTLV-1 negative.
T-PLL cells have round or slightly irregular nuclei with a nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, and are CD7 bright.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and lack clover-leaf nuclear lobation.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — atypical lymphocytes including a polylobated 'flower cell'
pearls_zh: 考法：指著核呈花瓣狀多葉的淋巴球問名稱，答 flower cell，接著問病原：HTLV-1。
Flow：CD4+、CD25 強陽性、CD7 常缺失，多數表現 CCR4（可作為 mogamulizumab 標靶）。
臨床急症：高血鈣、溶骨病變、皮膚病灶與伺機性感染；Shimoyama 分型為 acute、lymphoma、chronic、smoldering，決定治療強度。
HTLV-1 流行於日本西南部、加勒比海等地，經母乳、性行為、輸血傳染；確診需 HTLV-1 抗體陽性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Sézary cell（腦迴狀核但非深分葉花瓣狀）或 reactive lymphocytes；鑑別靠 HTLV-1 serology 與 CD4+CD25+ 單株 T 細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中花瓣狀核的淋巴球最應檢驗哪一種病毒？
quiz.a: HTLV-1

3869.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片的上皮樣組織球，細胞質淡而空泡狀，內含許多帶透明暈的小圓形微生物（箭頭），旁邊為紅血球前驅細胞，是組織漿菌感染引起的組織球/肉芽腫性浸潤。
features: Sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous small round intracytoplasmic organisms with clear halos (arrows), approximately 2–4 µm
Histiocyte nuclei oval to reniform with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
No multinucleated giant cells or necrosis in this field
Adjacent clusters of erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Adipocytes present
3869.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows sheets of histiocytes with oval to reniform vesicular nuclei and abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm, many containing numerous small, uniform, round intracytoplasmic organisms with clear halos (arrows). Well-formed giant cells and necrosis are not seen, and residual erythroid precursors are present at the lower right. Findings are consistent with a histiocytic/poorly formed granulomatous infiltrate containing intracellular yeasts, suggestive of disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation with GMS/PAS stains and culture or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a kinetoplast and are GMS negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are GMS and PAS positive without a kinetoplast.
MAC-laden histiocytes have striated, finely granular cytoplasm with acid-fast bacilli rather than discrete haloed round yeasts.
Gaucher cells have abundant wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without discrete intracellular organisms.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without halos, and Pneumocystis forms extracellular foamy exudate with cup-shaped cysts on GMS.

exam.answer_en: Bone marrow histoplasmosis — sheets of histiocytes filled with small uniform haloed intracellular yeasts, poorly formed granulomatous infiltrate
pearls_zh: 考法：切片指成片組織球內的小圓體，考官問「細胞內 2–4 µm 小病原的鑑別」：Histoplasma、Leishmania、Talaromyces marneffei、Toxoplasma、Pneumocystis。
區分口訣：有 kinetoplast → Leishmania；出芽、GMS/PAS 陽性 → Histoplasma；橫隔分裂 → Talaromyces；GMS 陰性、Giemsa 見核＋動基體者屬原蟲。
成片組織球而缺乏巨細胞與壞死，提示宿主免疫反應差、菌量高，應查 HIV 與免疫抑制狀態。
Histoplasma 是二相性真菌：組織中為酵母、培養室溫為菌絲，培養有實驗室感染風險需通知檢驗室。
治療以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，再以 itraconazole 維持；追蹤 antigen 可評估療效。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把組織球內的透明暈誤當 Cryptococcus 莢膜；Cryptococcus 較大、大小不一並 mucicarmine 陽性，Histoplasma 小而一致、暈為收縮假影。

quiz.q: 圖中組織球內一致的小酵母菌屬於二相性真菌，它在組織內與室溫培養下分別呈什麼形態？
quiz.a: 組織內為酵母（yeast），室溫培養為菌絲（mold）

3741.recognize_zh: 高倍下兩顆淋巴球核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻均勻，淡灰藍色細胞質四周長滿細絲狀毛樣突起，符合毛細胞（hairy cell）。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Oval to round nuclei with finely granular, evenly distributed chromatin; nucleoli small or inconspicuous
Moderate pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine, circumferential, ruffled hair-like projections
Moderate N:C ratio
Background red cells include an occasional teardrop-shaped cell
3741.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate amounts of pale blue-grey cytoplasm with delicate circumferential hair-like projections. Prominent nucleoli are not identified. An occasional teardrop red cell is present in the background. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a distinct central nucleolus and lack CD25/CD123, while these cells show no prominent nucleolus.
SMZL cells have short villi concentrated at one or two poles and more condensed chromatin.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and vacuolated cytoplasm rather than oval nuclei with circumferential hairy projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — lymphoid cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin, no prominent nucleoli and circumferential ruffled hairy projections
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍題會問「有沒有明顯核仁」，因為這是 classic HCL 與 HCL variant 的關鍵形態分界：classic HCL 核仁不明顯，variant 有明顯中央核仁。
HCL variant 表型：CD25 陰性、CD123 多陰性、annexin A1 陰性、BRAF V600E 陰性，常有高白血球且無 monocytopenia，對 cladribine 單藥反應較差。
細胞化學：TRAP（tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase）陽性是傳統考點，現多以 flow（CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123）與 IHC 取代。
復發/難治 classic HCL 可使用 BRAF inhibitor（vemurafenib ± rituximab）；purine analog 後需注意長期 CD4 低下與伺機性感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性單核球；單核球核摺疊、染色質花邊狀且有空泡，毛細胞核卵圓、染色質細緻均勻，細胞質邊緣一整圈細毛狀突起。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞若流式顯示 CD25 陰性、BRAF V600E 陰性，應考慮哪個診斷？
quiz.a: HCL variant（WHO 5th：splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli）

3677.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球內可見單一、圓形、深紫色、偏周邊的小顆粒（Howell-Jolly bodies），分布於不同細胞中，另見少數標靶細胞與棘狀紅血球，符合脾臟切除或功能性無脾的表現。
features: Numerous RBCs each containing a single small, round, dense dark-purple inclusion (Howell-Jolly body), usually eccentric
Inclusions are uniform in size (~1 um) and sharply defined, unlike the fine dispersed granules of basophilic stippling
Scattered target cells and occasional acanthocytes/irregularly contracted cells
