A few RBCs with faint fine cytoplasmic stippling and slight polychromasia
Platelets present; no parasites or ring forms identified
3677.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis. Numerous erythrocytes contain single, small, round, darkly basophilic inclusions consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies. Scattered target cells and occasional acanthocytes are present. No intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies, suggestive of asplenia or hyposplenism.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, smaller, irregular granules clustered at the cell periphery and stain with Prussian blue, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are single, larger, round DNA remnants.
Ring forms show a cytoplasmic ring with a chromatin dot, not a solid round dense body.
An overlying platelet is larger, granular, and often has a clear halo, whereas a Howell-Jolly body is a smooth, homogeneous, sharply defined dot within the cell.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly bodies — single round dense DNA-remnant inclusions in RBCs, indicating asplenia/hyposplenism
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內單顆、圓形、深紫的小點，問名稱、成分（核 DNA 殘餘）與代表的臨床意義（脾臟功能缺失）。
常見原因：脾切除、sickle cell disease 的 autosplenectomy、celiac disease 等造成功能性無脾；megaloblastic anemia 亦可見。
臨床意義：無脾者對莢膜菌（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis）感染風險高，需疫苗接種，發燒應視為急症。
染色：Feulgen 陽性（DNA）、Prussian blue 陰性，可與含鐵的 Pappenheimer bodies 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Pappenheimer bodies 或疊在紅血球上的血小板：HJ body 單顆、圓、均質且邊界清楚；Pappenheimer 為多顆不規則小顆粒成簇、鐵染陽性；血小板較大且有淡色暈。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內的單顆深紫色圓點為何？提示病人處於何種狀態？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body；無脾或脾功能低下（hyposplenism）

3485.recognize_zh: 另一個免疫染色的低倍影像：黏膜下成排擠壓的結節呈中等強度棕色陽性，而緊貼黏膜下方的一帶淋巴組織、結節間與大腸黏膜為陰性，染色勾勒出背靠背的腫瘤性濾泡（標記名稱未標示）。
features: Low-power immunostain showing moderate brown staining within crowded submucosal nodules
Nodules outlined sharply against negative fibrous septa and interfollicular tissue
A band of lymphoid tissue beneath the mucosa and the colonic mucosa are largely negative
Staining within nodules is somewhat heterogeneous/granular
Specific antibody not stated; interpret as a follicle-highlighting marker
3485.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of the colonic lesion shows moderate positivity confined largely to the closely packed nodules, which are sharply demarcated from negative fibrous septa. The colonic mucosa and a band of subepithelial lymphoid tissue are negative. The antibody is not specified; the follicle-restricted pattern is compatible with a germinal-center marker such as CD10 or BCL6. Together with the H&E architecture, findings support follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are fewer and separated by abundant interfollicular tissue, and BCL2 is negative in reactive germinal centers.
MCL is CD10 and BCL6 negative with cyclin D1 positivity, so germinal-center markers would not outline its nodules.
MZL cells between and within follicles are negative for germinal-center markers, and the subepithelial marginal-zone band would be the neoplastic compartment.

3421.recognize_zh: 近拍臨床照片：皮膚上多發紅色至紫紅色丘疹及小斑塊，部分融合、表面帶鱗屑，右側可見深紫色瘀斑樣病灶；在 AML 背景下提示白血病皮膚浸潤，但外觀非特異，需切片確診。
features: Close-up clinical photograph of skin with multiple erythematous to magenta papules and small plaques
Lesions partly coalescent in a band-like distribution with fine surface scale
Darker violaceous, purpuric-appearing macules toward the right side of the field
A discrete isolated erythematous papule with central punctum at upper left
No ulceration or large nodules visible; histology cannot be assessed
3421.describe_en: Close-up clinical photograph shows multiple erythematous to magenta papules and small plaques, partly coalescent with fine scale, accompanied by darker violaceous purpuric-appearing macules. No ulcerated nodules are identified. Although clinically nonspecific, these lesions in a patient with acute myeloid leukemia are suggestive of leukemia cutis (cutaneous myeloid sarcoma), and skin biopsy is required to demonstrate a dermal infiltrate of myeloid blasts.

ddx.vs: Sweet syndrome shows dense mature neutrophilic dermal infiltrates with papillary edema, whereas leukemia cutis shows interstitial blasts or monocytoid cells on biopsy.
Purpura from thrombocytopenia is flat and non-blanching without papules or scale, and biopsy shows only extravasated red cells.
Vasculitis shows palpable purpura with fibrinoid necrosis of small vessels histologically.
These are separated by immunohistochemistry (CD3/CD4 T-cell markers or CD123/TCF4/CD56) rather than by clinical appearance.

3293.recognize_zh: 兩顆大型單核細胞，核呈圓到腎形、染色質細網狀，細胞質中等量淡藍色、邊緣呈毛絮狀的細長突起，是血中反應性組織球；需與毛細胞（hairy cell）鑑別。
features: Two large mononuclear cells with moderate N:C ratio
Round to reniform nuclei with finely reticular, evenly dispersed chromatin
Small indistinct nucleolus possible in the right cell; no prominent nucleoli
Pale blue, agranular cytoplasm with frayed, wispy peripheral projections
No phagocytosed material; background red cell aggregates with crenation
3293.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two large mononuclear cells with round to reniform nuclei, finely reticular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The moderately abundant cytoplasm is pale blue and agranular, with frayed, wispy projections at the periphery. No ingested cells or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with circulating reactive histiocytes; because of the ragged cytoplasmic borders, hairy cell leukemia should be excluded by flow cytometry if clinically suspected.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells are smaller with oval or bean-shaped nuclei and fine circumferential hair-like projections, and show CD20/CD11c/CD25/CD103 positivity on flow cytometry.
Monocytes have more convoluted nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles.
Villous lymphocytes are smaller with clumped chromatin and short polar villi rather than a large cell with abundant cytoplasm.
Blasts have a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin with distinct nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm.

3165.recognize_zh: 大型母細胞，染色質細緻、N:C比高，一側有一圈淡藍色胞質，胞膜外緣正出芽形成一串帶顆粒的血小板樣碎片（cytoplasmic budding），這是巨核母細胞的線索。
features: Large blast with high N:C ratio and round to oval nucleus
Finely granular chromatin with small pale areas; nucleoli indistinct
Scant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with a clear rim
Cytoplasmic budding with a chain of small granular platelet-like fragments detaching from one side of the cell
Background red cells with a few platelet-sized granular fragments
3165.describe_en: High-power smear shows a large blast with a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant pale gray-blue cytoplasm. At one pole the cytoplasm forms blebs from which a chain of small granular platelet-like fragments appears to bud off. No Auer rods are identified. The cytoplasmic budding is suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation, consistent with acute megakaryoblastic leukemia; confirmation with CD41, CD61 and CD42b by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry is required.

ddx.dx: Blast with platelet satellitism or overlapping platelets
ddx.vs: Overlapping platelets lie on top of or adjacent to an intact cell membrane rather than emerging as budding cytoplasmic blebs, and CD61 immunostaining resolves true lineage.
Lymphoblasts may show blebs but lack granular platelet-like fragments and are TdT positive and CD41/CD61 negative.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and folded nuclei and are NSE positive with CD14/CD64 expression.

exam.answer_en: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia — blast with high N:C ratio and cytoplasmic budding shedding platelet-like fragments
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指母細胞邊緣一串帶顆粒的出芽碎片，問「這個特徵暗示哪一系」；答 megakaryoblast，但形態只是線索，需免疫表型確認。
確認：CD41（GPIIb）、CD61（GPIIIa）、CD42b；megakaryoblast MPO 陰性，常 CD34/CD45 可弱或陰性。
骨髓常因纖維化 dry tap，需靠骨髓切片 IHC（CD61）評估。
遺傳關聯：Down syndrome 相關髓系增生帶 GATA1 突變；非 DS 兒童有 RBM15::MRTFA（t(1;22)）或 CBFA2T3::GLIS2；成人常見於 MDS/MPN 進展或治療相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把疊在母細胞上的血小板當成出芽；真正 budding 是從胞膜延伸出的胞質泡，血小板只是覆蓋於完整胞膜上，CD61 可釐清。

quiz.q: 母細胞邊緣出芽形成血小板樣碎片，提示哪一種 AML？用哪些標記確認？
quiz.a: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia；CD41、CD61、CD42b

2781.recognize_zh: 高倍下左側與上方是密集深染的小淋巴球（套區），右側是較大、核呈泡狀並有核仁的中心母細胞與中心細胞，兩區分界清楚，形成生發中心與套區的分區結構，符合骨髓反應性淋巴濾泡。
features: Zone of small, dark, round to slightly irregular lymphocytes (mantle zone)
Adjacent zone of larger centroblasts with vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli
Intermediate centrocytes with irregular nuclear contours admixed
Moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in germinal center cells
Artifactual cleft across the field; no sheets of uniform atypical cells
2781.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a lymphoid follicle with a distinct interface between a mantle of small, dark, round lymphocytes and a germinal center composed of larger centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli admixed with centrocytes. A tissue retraction cleft crosses the field. The zonation and mixed cellular composition favor a reactive follicle. Findings are consistent with a reactive marrow germinal center.

ddx.vs: Lymphomatous follicles lack sharp mantle-germinal center zonation and show BCL2 positivity in the follicle center cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma is a monotonous population of small to intermediate cyclin D1-positive cells without true centroblast-rich germinal centers.
DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells without a surrounding small-lymphocyte mantle.

2717.recognize_zh: 視野中央有兩顆細胞質豐富、淡藍色、核偏位的淋巴球，另有一顆細胞質帶淡粉紅色細顆粒的淋巴球，周圍是分葉與帶狀嗜中性球；淋巴球細胞質量多是 LGL 的線索，但此倍率顆粒不易看清。
features: Several medium-to-large lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Nuclei round to oval with condensed chromatin, nucleoli not seen
One lymphoid cell with faintly pink, finely granular cytoplasm; discrete azurophilic granules not clearly resolved
Admixed segmented and band neutrophils for comparison
Crush/smear artifact at lower left; red cells normochromic
2717.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows several lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and mature condensed chromatin, clustered with segmented and band neutrophils. One lymphoid cell has faintly granular pinkish cytoplasm, but discrete azurophilic granules are not well resolved at this magnification. No blasts or atypical nucleolated cells are identified. The appearance is compatible with increased large granular lymphocytes in NK-cell lymphocytosis; confirmation requires an absolute LGL count and flow cytometric immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are pleomorphic with deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and generally lack azurophilic granules.
Cannot be separated morphologically; requires flow cytometry (CD3, CD8, CD57, CD16/CD56) and TCR clonality testing.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm rather than round condensed nuclei.

2461.recognize_zh: 大型巨核細胞的核是一團過度分葉、擠在一起的核塊，周圍胞質內另外散在幾個與主核分離的小圓核片，這種核葉分離的異常形態屬於發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular purple cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated, clumped central nucleus with overlapping lobes
Several small, round, detached nuclear fragments in the peripheral cytoplasm
Chromatin moderately condensed; no obvious emperipolesis
Adjacent bone marrow particle/stroma and small lymphoid cells
2461.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobulated, clumped nucleus accompanied by several small round nuclear fragments separated from the main nuclear mass. Adjacent stroma and small lymphoid cells are present. These abnormal nuclear configurations represent megakaryocytic dysplasia. In a myeloid neoplasm workup, such forms support MDS or MDS/MPN when frequent, whereas large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes with connected lobes are more typical of classic MPN such as essential thrombocythemia.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large with deeply lobulated staghorn nuclei whose lobes remain connected, without detached nuclear fragments.
PMF megakaryocytes show hyperchromatic, cloud-like, abnormally folded nuclei and tight clustering on biopsy.
Osteoclasts have numerous separate uniform nuclei and non-granular or coarsely granular cytoplasm without a central hyperlobulated nucleus.
B12/folate deficiency can produce hypersegmented megakaryocyte nuclei with nuclear fragments, but shows megaloblastic erythroid and giant granulocytic changes.

2397.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆小型單核細胞，細胞質幾乎看不到，核圓、染色質細緻均勻而非成熟淋巴球的粗塊狀，符合小型淋巴芽細胞；但單一細胞與小淋巴球外觀接近，需流式確認。
features: Single small cell, slightly larger than a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with barely visible cytoplasmic rim
Round nucleus with fine, evenly distributed chromatin lacking coarse clumping
No visible nucleolus at this magnification; no granules
Background normochromic red cells with few platelets
2397.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single small mononuclear cell with a very high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm, and a round nucleus with fine, evenly distributed chromatin without the coarse clumping of a mature lymphocyte. Nucleoli are not discernible at this magnification, and no granules are present. The background red cells are unremarkable. The morphology is compatible with a small (L1-type) lymphoblast, but a single cell cannot be reliably separated from a mature lymphocyte; flow cytometry for TdT, CD34, and lineage markers is required.

ddx.vs: Mature lymphocytes have dense, coarse, block-like chromatin and a thin crescent of cytoplasm, and lack TdT/CD34 expression.
Myeloblasts are larger with more cytoplasm, open chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and are MPO positive.
Normoblasts have very condensed pyknotic chromatin and gray-pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm rather than fine chromatin with a blue rim.

2141.recognize_zh: 低中倍稀薄抹片中散布數個大型、胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞與單核球樣細胞，另有核分葉不良、顆粒稀少的嗜中性球與晚期紅血球前驅細胞；可提示芽細胞增加與顆粒球發育不良，但倍率低，細節有限。
features: Scattered large blasts with round nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm
Hypogranular neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation (lower center)
Occasional late erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes
Hemodilute field with abundant red cells; resolution limits assessment of dysplasia
2141.describe_en: Hemodilute smear at low-to-medium power shows scattered large blasts with round nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, monocytoid cells with folded nuclei, occasional late erythroid precursors, and small lymphocytes. A neutrophil with hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation is present. The magnification and hemodilution limit reliable assessment of multilineage dysplasia and blast percentage. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic features and should be correlated with a cellular aspirate and genetic studies for classification as AML with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Requires ≥20% monocytic lineage cells confirmed by NSE or flow cytometry (CD14, CD64).
CMML has <20% blasts plus promonocytes, which must be established on a full differential count.
Separated from AML solely by blast percentage below 20%.

2077.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成片大型、明顯多形性的腫瘤細胞，核大且不規則，部分為多葉或多核，染色質粗、核仁明顯，並可見異常分裂像，屬於大 B 細胞淋巴瘤中多形性較高的一型。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells with nuclei several times the size of small lymphocytes
Irregular, multilobated and occasionally multinucleated nuclei with coarse chromatin and prominent nucleoli
Moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Mitotic figures and apoptotic debris present (including a fragmented apoptotic cell at left)
Scattered smaller cells with round nuclei in the background
2077.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse proliferation of large, markedly pleomorphic lymphoid cells. Nuclei are irregular, some multilobated or multinucleated, with coarse chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and the cells have moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily seen. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with pleomorphic/anaplastic morphology, but immunohistochemistry is required to exclude anaplastic large cell lymphoma, Hodgkin lymphoma and non-hematolymphoid malignancy.

ddx.vs: ALCL has hallmark horseshoe-shaped nuclei with uniform strong CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers, whereas DLBCL expresses CD20 and PAX5.
cHL has scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background with CD30/CD15 positivity and weak PAX5, rather than sheets of CD20+ large cells.
Cohesive growth and expression of cytokeratins or melanocytic markers with CD45 negativity favor a non-lymphoid tumor.

1949.recognize_zh: 這是一張 PCR-SSCP 電泳膠片的投影片，不是型態學影像：Skin 與 LN 樣本和部分未標示的泳道出現分離清楚的條帶（代表單株性族群），Jurkat 細胞株為單株陽性對照，PBMC 為多株性模糊條帶的陰性對照。
features: Slide titled 'Analysis of Angioimmunoblastic Lymphadenopathy by PCR-SSCP' showing a polyacrylamide gel
Lanes labeled Skin (two lanes), LN (two lanes), several unlabeled sample lanes, Jurkat, and PBMC
Skin lanes show multiple discrete, reproducible bands in duplicate
LN lanes show fainter discrete bands; unlabeled lanes also show distinct banding patterns
Jurkat (monoclonal T-cell line control) shows sharp distinct bands; PBMC (polyclonal control) shows a diffuse smear with fewer discrete bands
1949.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure showing single-strand conformation polymorphism analysis of PCR-amplified antigen receptor gene rearrangements (target gene not stated) in angioimmunoblastic lymphadenopathy. Lanes from skin and lymph node samples, run in duplicate, show discrete bands that are reproducible between duplicates, indicating a clonal lymphoid population, whereas polyclonal peripheral blood mononuclear cells give a diffuse smear and the Jurkat T-cell line serves as a monoclonal control. Bands at comparable positions in skin and lymph node would support involvement by the same clone, but the exact band correspondence cannot be confirmed at this image resolution. Such data historically supported reclassification of angioimmunoblastic lymphadenopathy as a clonal T-cell lymphoma (angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma).

1885.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面呈均勻、暗紅牛肉色（beefy red），看不到灰白色白髓小結節或局部腫塊，提示為紅髓瀰漫性浸潤的脾腫大，符合毛狀細胞白血病的大體外觀。
features: Gross cut surface of an enlarged spleen with specimen label for scale
Homogeneous dark red ('beefy') parenchyma
No discernible white pulp nodules (miliary pattern absent)
No discrete masses, infarcts or fibrotic areas evident
Glistening cut surface without necrosis
1885.describe_en: Gross photograph shows the cut surface of an enlarged spleen with a uniformly dark red, beefy appearance. There are no visible white pulp nodules, discrete tumor masses or infarcts. This diffuse red pulp pattern indicates a process expanding the red pulp rather than the follicles. Findings are consistent with splenomegaly due to hairy cell leukemia, which requires histologic and immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma / CLL / follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: White-pulp-based lymphomas produce a miliary pattern of numerous small gray-white nodules on the cut surface rather than a homogeneous red surface.
These also cause homogeneous red splenomegaly, so distinction requires histology showing trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes rather than hairy cells.
DLBCL typically forms large discrete tan-white masses, often with necrosis, rather than a diffuse red cut surface.

1821.recognize_zh: 同一視野中可見黑色箭頭的芽細胞（核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少量藍色），以及紅色與藍色箭頭所指的異常嗜中性球：核葉排列異常、呈多個分離小葉，且細胞質顆粒偏少，這種芽細胞增加合併顆粒球發育不良的組合，指向伴多系發育不良的 AML。
features: Black arrow: blast with round nucleus, fine chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Red arrow: dysplastic neutrophil with abnormally clumped, irregularly segmented nucleus and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm
Blue arrow: neutrophil with multiple small, separated nuclear lobes (abnormal hypersegmentation/nuclear fragmentation) and pale cytoplasm
Additional immature cells with fine chromatin and moderate blue cytoplasm (upper right, left edge)
Adjacent normally granulated neutrophil for comparison
1821.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts (black arrow) with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm. Dysgranulopoiesis is present, including a hypogranular neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation (red arrow) and a neutrophil with multiple small separated nuclear lobes (blue arrow), in contrast to an adjacent normally granulated neutrophil. Dysplasia in the erythroid and megakaryocytic lineages cannot be assessed in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes (formerly AML with multilineage dysplasia), provided blasts are at least 20% and dysplasia involves at least 50% of cells in two or more lineages.

ddx.vs: Shows identical dysplasia but blasts are below 20% of marrow nucleated cells.
May show multilineage dysplasia, but NPM1 mutation takes precedence and the case is classified by the genetic lesion.
Lacks significant dysplasia in at least 50% of cells of two lineages and lacks MDS-defining cytogenetic abnormalities or history.

Megaloblastic change produces large hypersegmented neutrophils with normal granules and no blast excess, and reverses with B12/folate; therapy-related myeloid neoplasms require a history of cytotoxic therapy.

1629.recognize_zh: 一片細胞質較多、淡粉紅色的中型細胞，核卵圓至略有凹陷，染色質細緻；左下角為深染小淋巴球，右上角有梭形纖維細胞，屬淋巴結中淡染的組織球/樹突細胞或單核樣 B 細胞區域。
features: Sheet of intermediate-sized cells with moderate to abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Oval to indented or bean-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Small dark lymphocytes at the lower left border
Spindle cells with elongated nuclei at the upper right (trabecula/capsule)
No mitotic activity or significant nuclear atypia
1629.describe_en: Section of lymph node at high power shows a sheet of intermediate-sized cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to indented nuclei with fine chromatin, bordered by small dark lymphocytes at the lower left and spindle stromal cells at the upper right. There is no significant atypia or mitotic activity. The lineage of the pale cells (histiocytes/interdigitating dendritic cells versus monocytoid B cells) cannot be determined morphologically in this field and would require immunostains. Findings are consistent with a normal/reactive nodal compartment.

ddx.vs: Sinus histiocytes lie within dilated sinuses and are CD68/CD163 positive, whereas sheet-like pale cells outside sinuses favor dendritic cells or monocytoid B cells.
NMZL shows extensive sheets of monocytoid cells effacing the node with light-chain restriction, which cannot be established from this small field.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests of cells with larger atypical nuclei and prominent nucleoli and is keratin positive.

93.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被大型多形性細胞成片取代，插圖可見腎形核的標誌細胞（hallmark cell）；免疫染色 CD30 強陽性、ALK 陰性、T 細胞標記（CD3/CD4/CD8）與 CD45 幾乎全失（null phenotype），p63 核強陽性，FISH 見 TBL1XR1/TP63 融合訊號。
features: Diffuse cohesive sheets of large pleomorphic cells effacing the node, extending to capsule and perinodal fat
Abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm; vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and frequent mitoses
Hallmark cells with eccentric kidney/horseshoe-shaped nuclei and paranuclear eosinophilic region (inset)
IHC: CD30 strong uniform membranous/Golgi positivity; ALK negative
IHC: loss of CD45, CD3, CD4 and CD8 in tumor cells (null phenotype); CD20 negative; strong nuclear p63
Interphase FISH: two yellow TBL1XR1/TP63 fusion signals (arrows) plus separate red and green signals, indicating TP63 rearrangement
93.describe_en: Lymph node sections show near-total effacement by diffuse, cohesive sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells that extend into the capsule and perinodal adipose tissue. At high power, the cells have abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, pleomorphic vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli, and brisk mitotic activity; hallmark cells with horseshoe-shaped nuclei are present. Immunohistochemistry shows strong, uniform CD30 expression with ALK negativity; the neoplastic cells are negative for CD20, CD3, CD4 and CD8 and largely negative for CD45 (only scattered background cells staining), while p63 shows strong diffuse nuclear positivity. Interphase FISH with a TBL1XR1/TP63 dual-fusion probe demonstrates two fusion signals, confirming a TBL1XR1-TP63 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma with TP63 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Shares hallmark cells and uniform CD30, but ALK IHC is positive (usually nuclear and cytoplasmic with NPM1-ALK) and patients are typically younger; ALK is negative here.
CD30-positive Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered within a mixed inflammatory background with CD15 and PAX5 (weak) expression, rather than cohesive CD30-positive sheets lacking PAX5.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: CD30 is typically heterogeneous and weaker with retained T-cell antigens, whereas ALCL shows uniform strong CD30 with frequent loss of pan-T-cell markers and hallmark cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma (e.g., squamous cell) or embryonal carcinoma
ddx.vs: Cohesive sheets with CD45 loss and p63 positivity can mimic carcinoma, so keratin (negative in ALCL), EMA, CD30 pattern, and cytotoxic markers or TCR clonality are needed to resolve it.

93.stain: H&E; IHC panel incl. CD30, ALK, p63; FISH TBL1XR1/TP63
captions: H&E: low-power nodal effacement by sheets of large cells extending into perinodal fat; high power shows pleomorphic large cells with a hallmark cell (inset)
IHC panel: CD45, CD20, CD3, CD4, CD8 negative in tumor cells; CD30 strong diffuse positive; ALK negative; p63 strong nuclear positive
Interphase FISH with TBL1XR1 (green)/TP63 (red) probes showing two fusion signals (arrows) indicating TP63 rearrangement

exam.answer_en: ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma with TP63 rearrangement — CD30+ hallmark cells, null T phenotype, p63+, TBL1XR1::TP63 fusion on FISH
pearls_zh: 考法：FISH 圖考官會指兩個黃色融合訊號問意義——TBL1XR1/TP63 dual-fusion 陽性即 TP63 重排；插圖則考 hallmark cell（馬蹄形核）。
ALK− ALCL 分子分層：DUSP22 重排約 30%、預後相對好；TP63 重排少見（約數 %）、預後差；兩者皆無者為 triple-negative。
Null phenotype：T 細胞標記與 CD45 可全失，需靠 CD30 強均勻陽性、cytotoxic 標記、TCR clonality 才能判定 T 系。
治療：CD30+ PTCL 包含 ALCL，一線 brentuximab vedotin + CHP（ECHELON-2）；ALK− 預後比 ALK+ 差。
p63 IHC 陽性可作 TP63 重排的篩檢線索，但不具特異性，仍需 FISH 確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 大型黏聚成片、T 標記全失易誤認為轉移性癌或古典何杰金：做 keratin 排除癌、看 CD15/PAX5 弱陽性與混合背景排除 cHL，ALK 陰性再排除 ALK+ ALCL。

quiz.q: ALK− ALCL 的 FISH 顯示 TBL1XR1/TP63 兩個融合訊號，代表什麼、預後如何？
quiz.a: TP63 重排；預後不良

65245.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與切片幾乎被大量顆粒稀少、核圓偏心的骨髓細胞（myelocyte）佔滿，成熟分葉中性球很少，呈「停滯在 myelocyte 階段」的樣貌；MPO 瀰漫陽性、p53 多數核陽性，但 CD34 陽性芽細胞只是散在少數，末梢血則可見芽細胞與異常顆粒球。
features: PB (A): scattered blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm plus dysplastic hypogranular myelocytes/granulocytes; thrombocytopenia
Aspirate (B): sheets of intermediate-sized myelocytes with round to oval eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, and hypogranular pale-blue to pink cytoplasm; few mature neutrophils
Biopsy H&E (C): hypercellular marrow packed with monotonous myeloid cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, scattered erythroid precursors
MPO (D): strong diffuse cytoplasmic positivity in the myelocyte population
p53 (E): strong nuclear staining in a large proportion (~80%) of cells
CD34 (F): only scattered positive blasts and vessels
65245.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts and left-shifted, dysplastic hypogranular granulocytes with thrombocytopenia. The bone marrow aspirate and biopsy are markedly hypercellular and effaced by sheets of dysplastic myelocytes with round eccentric nuclei and hypogranular cytoplasm, with a paucity of maturing band and segmented neutrophils (maturation arrest at the myelocyte stage). Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse MPO positivity, strong nuclear p53 in a large majority of cells, and only a minor population of CD34-positive blasts. With peripheral blood blasts exceeding 20% and the molecular findings (STAG2, SRSF2, ASXL1, RUNX1 mutations, no TP53 mutation), the findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplasia-related, with dysplastic myelocyte arrest and wild-type p53 overexpression.

ddx.vs: CML shows a full spectrum of maturation with myelocyte and segmented neutrophil peaks plus basophilia, rather than arrest at the myelocyte stage with dysplasia, and is BCR::ABL1-positive.
aCML has dysgranulopoiesis with left shift but fewer than 20% blasts and retained maturation to dysplastic neutrophils, often with SETBP1/ASXL1 mutations.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation or promyelocyte-rich AML (APL)
ddx.vs: APL cells are hypergranular promyelocytes with Auer rods and bilobed nuclei and are CD34/HLA-DR-negative with PML::RARA, unlike these hypogranular myelocytes.
Strong p53 in ~80% of cells mimics TP53 mutation, but sequencing showed wild-type TP53, so p53 IHC must be correlated with molecular testing.

65245.stain: May-Grünwald-Giemsa, H&E, IHC: MPO, p53, CD34

1309.recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一群中型腫瘤細胞，細胞質深藍色、邊緣清楚，並含許多清楚的圓形脂肪空泡，核圓、染色質細緻並有數個小核仁；深藍細胞質加上空泡是柏奇氏淋巴瘤（Burkitt lymphoma）的典型形態。
features: Cluster of medium-sized, monomorphic lymphoid cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with crisp borders
Numerous sharply punched-out clear cytoplasmic (lipid) vacuoles
Round to oval nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and several small nucleoli
Background with smudged cell debris and scattered red cells
1309.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of ascitic fluid shows a cluster of monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, and multiple small nucleoli. The cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharp borders containing numerous punched-out clear lipid vacuoles. Smudged cell debris is present in the background. Findings are consistent with involvement by Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+ mature B cells with light chain restriction) and demonstration of MYC rearrangement are recommended.

ddx.vs: Cells are larger and more pleomorphic with more variable cytoplasm, with less uniform vacuolation, a Ki-67 below ~95%, and often BCL2 expression.
Lymphoblasts have fine blastic chromatin with scant, less basophilic cytoplasm and are TdT positive and surface immunoglobulin negative.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: May be morphologically similar but shows BCL2 protein expression and BCL2 rearrangement by FISH.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with vacuolated blasts
ddx.vs: Myeloid or monocytic blasts are MPO or nonspecific esterase positive and lack mature B-cell markers.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt lymphoma in ascitic fluid — medium-sized cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：指胞質空泡問成分（脂質，Oil Red O 陽性）；深藍胞質加上空泡是 Burkitt 經典細胞學。
Flow：成熟 B 細胞 CD19/CD20+、CD10+、表面輕鏈限制、TdT−；Ki-67 近 100%。
確診需證明 MYC 重組（t(8;14) 最常見），並以 FISH 排除 BCL2 重組。
腹腔大腫塊合併腹水常見於散發型；腫瘤負荷高，治療前需預防腫瘤溶解症候群。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML 空泡芽細胞或 B-ALL（舊 FAB L3）；AML 為 MPO+、CD34/CD117 表型，B-ALL 為 TdT+ 前驅細胞，Burkitt 是 TdT−、sIg+ 成熟 B 細胞。

quiz.q: 這些腫瘤細胞胞質空泡的成分為何？
quiz.a: 脂質（lipid，Oil Red O 陽性）

4061.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片中，真皮有沿著毛囊皮脂腺與汗腺、血管分布的密集深藍色淋巴樣細胞浸潤，形成條帶狀從表皮下延伸至深層真皮，周圍膠原相對保留；需高倍與免疫染色確認為 T-PLL 皮膚浸潤。
features: Dense band-like to nodular basophilic lymphoid infiltrate in the dermis
Periadnexal distribution around a pilosebaceous unit (clear vacuolated sebaceous lobules) and eccrine coils
Perivascular extension into the deep dermis
Intervening reticular dermal collagen relatively spared
Overlying epidermis present at the edge; cytologic detail not assessable at this power
4061.describe_en: Low-power skin biopsy shows a dense, deeply basophilic lymphoid infiltrate in the dermis with a striking periadnexal and perivascular distribution, surrounding a pilosebaceous unit and eccrine glands and extending into the deep dermis. The intervening reticular collagen is relatively spared, and the epidermis at the edge of the section is not obviously involved at this magnification. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this power. In the context of known T-prolymphocytic leukemia, the pattern is consistent with leukemia cutis, pending immunohistochemical confirmation.

ddx.vs: B-cell infiltrates are CD20+ and often nodular with germinal-center or marginal-zone features, whereas T-PLL is CD3+ and TCL1+.
Lupus shows a polymorphous superficial and deep perivascular/periadnexal infiltrate with interface change and dermal mucin rather than monotonous atypical lymphocytes.
Folliculotropic MF shows atypical lymphocytes infiltrating follicular epithelium, often with follicular mucinosis, without leukemic peripheral blood counts.

1437.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E）左圖為細胞密度增加的骨髓，右圖高倍可見大量圓核、深染的紅血球系前驅細胞成群，間質散佈棕色含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）顆粒；環狀鐵粒母細胞本身需鐵染色才能確認。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with reduced fat spaces between a bony trabecula
Erythroid hyperplasia: numerous precursors with round, dark, condensed nuclei in clusters
Coarse golden-brown hemosiderin pigment deposits in the interstitium and macrophages
A megakaryocyte present at the left of the high-power panel
Granulocytic precursors relatively less conspicuous than erythroid elements
Ring sideroblasts are not assessable on H&E
1437.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trabecular bone and reduced fat. At high power there is erythroid predominance, with clusters of precursors bearing round, hyperchromatic nuclei, together with coarse brown hemosiderin deposits and occasional megakaryocytes. No increase in blasts is evident on this field. Ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated on H&E sections; an iron stain on the aspirate and SF3B1 mutation testing are required. Findings are suggestive of erythroid hyperplasia with increased storage iron, in keeping with the provided diagnosis of MDS with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired non-clonal sideroblastic anemia (e.g., alcohol, copper deficiency, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; exclusion requires clinical history, copper/zinc levels, and absence of clonal markers such as SF3B1 mutation.
Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open chromatin in erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes, rather than ring sideroblasts on iron stain.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity has platelet count >=450 x10^9/L with large atypical megakaryocytes resembling ET/PMF, which are not evident here.

62685.recognize_zh: 低倍 Ki-67 染色下，淋巴結中緊密排列的濾泡內增生指數偏低到中等、分布較均勻，沒有反應性生發中心那種高 Ki-67 且具極性（dark/light zone）的分區；配合 BCL2 陽性的濾泡，支持低惡性度濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Lymph node with numerous closely packed, irregular follicles highlighted by nuclear Ki-67 staining
Moderate, relatively evenly distributed Ki-67 positivity within follicles without zonal polarization
Follicular proliferation index appears lower than expected for reactive germinal centers
Interfollicular areas show sparse Ki-67-positive nuclei
Precise proliferation percentage cannot be counted at this magnification
62685.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node immunostained for Ki-67 shows numerous closely packed follicles with irregular contours. Within the follicles, Ki-67-positive nuclei are present at a moderate density and are distributed fairly evenly, without the high proliferation and polarized dark-zone/light-zone pattern expected in reactive germinal centers. Interfollicular regions show only scattered positive cells. Exact quantification is not possible at this power, but the pattern is consistent with a low-grade nodal follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show very high Ki-67 (often >90%) with polarization toward the dark zone, whereas low-grade FL follicles have lower, non-polarized proliferation.
Grade 3 FL shows numerous centroblasts on H&E and often a high Ki-67 index (>30–40%), which requires high-power counting to separate.
MZL has low proliferation outside colonized follicles and lacks CD10/BCL6 expression in the neoplastic cells.

60701.recognize_zh: 組合圖：A、B 為抹片上的中至大型組織球，核呈凹陷、摺疊或腎形，細胞質豐富淡藍並有泡狀突起，背景有嗜酸性球；C1–C3 為免疫染色，腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫強陽性（應為 CD1a、langerin 及 BRAF V600E 等）。核摺疊加嗜酸性球背景是蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）的線索。
features: Panel A: cytologic preparation with numerous medium to large histiocytes admixed with eosinophils and occasional small lymphocytes
Panels B1–B3: histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm, cytoplasmic blebs and fine projections, and eccentric nuclei
Nuclei oval to reniform with folds, indentations or grooves, fine chromatin and small nucleoli; occasional binucleate forms
Panels C1–C3: tissue sections with sheets of lesional cells showing strong membranous/cytoplasmic immunoreactivity (antibodies not labeled)
No marked nuclear pleomorphism or atypical mitoses seen in the cytology panels
60701.describe_en: This composite figure shows cytologic preparations (A, B1–B3) and immunohistochemical stains on tissue sections (C1–C3). The smears contain numerous medium to large histiocytic cells with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm bearing blebs and fine projections, and oval to reniform nuclei with folds, indentations, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli, accompanied by scattered eosinophils. The tissue sections show sheets of lesional cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the image. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation requires CD1a and langerin (CD207) positivity, and BRAF V600E status may be established by VE1 immunohistochemistry or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: RDD histiocytes are larger with round vesicular nuclei and prominent emperipolesis, are S100+ but CD1a- and langerin-negative, and lack prominent nuclear grooves.
ECD shows foamy lipid-laden CD68+/CD163+ histiocytes with Touton giant cells and fibrosis, and is CD1a- and langerin-negative despite frequent BRAF V600E.
LC sarcoma shares CD1a/langerin expression but shows overtly malignant cytology with marked pleomorphism and high mitotic activity.
Reactive macrophages lack nuclear grooves, have phagocytic vacuoles, and contain only scattered CD1a+ cells rather than sheets.

exam.answer_en: Langerhans cell histiocytosis — histiocytes with folded/grooved reniform nuclei and eosinophils, with diffuse IHC positivity on sections
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核有摺痕或縱溝（coffee-bean）的組織球與旁邊的嗜酸性球，問診斷與確認染色；答 LCH，需 CD1a 與 langerin（CD207）陽性，S100 亦常陽性。
分子：BRAF V600E 見於約半數 LCH，可用 VE1 IHC 或分子檢測；BRAF 野生型者常有 MAP2K1 突變，屬 MAPK 路徑驅動的骨髓來源腫瘤。
電顯特徵為 Birbeck granules（網球拍狀），現多以 langerin 染色取代。
臨床：肝、脾、骨髓為 risk organs，侵犯時預後較差；常見溶骨性顱骨病灶、中樞性尿崩症；多系統疾病常用 vinblastine/prednisone，難治者可考慮 BRAF 或 MEK inhibitor。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Rosai-Dorfman disease 混淆；RDD 組織球更大、核圓泡狀、emperipolesis 明顯且 CD1a／langerin 陰性，LCH 則核有縱溝摺痕、伴嗜酸性球並 CD1a／langerin 陽性。

quiz.q: 確認 LCH 需要哪兩個 IHC 標記？約半數病例帶有什麼突變？
quiz.a: CD1a 與 langerin（CD207）；BRAF V600E

60189.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆顆粒球：細胞質淡灰、幾乎沒有顆粒（hypogranular），核只分成兩葉且染色質粗塊狀凝集（假性 Pelger-Huët 異常）；這種雙葉低顆粒嗜中性球是骨髓發育不良（MDS）的典型形態線索。
features: Neutrophil with bilobed nucleus (pseudo-Pelger-Huët morphology), lobes appearing nearly separate
Coarsely clumped, dense chromatin in both lobes
Abundant pale grey, agranular to markedly hypogranular cytoplasm
Cell slightly larger than a typical mature neutrophil
Adjacent platelet; red cells normochromic with mild anisocytosis; no blasts in this field
60189.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a dysplastic neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus composed of coarsely clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly) and abundant pale, markedly hypogranular cytoplasm. The surrounding red cells are largely normochromic with mild anisocytosis, and a single platelet is present adjacent to the cell. No circulating blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with granulocytic dysplasia and, together with pancytopenia and circulating blasts, support myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR-related anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset with hypogranularity.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g., mycophenolate, taxanes, valproate) or HIV
ddx.vs: Drug- and infection-related dysplasia resolves with removal of the cause and lacks clonal cytogenetic abnormalities or increased blasts.
Monocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles and fine granules and a folded nucleus with lacy chromatin rather than two dense, clumped lobes.

exam.answer_en: Myelodysplastic syndrome (excess blasts) — dysplastic hypogranular neutrophil with bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huët nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指雙葉、染色質粗塊、胞質無顆粒的中性球，問名稱與意義；答 pseudo-Pelger-Huët 合併 hypogranularity，屬顆粒球系發育不良。
MDS 發育不良判定：單一系列 ≥10% 細胞呈發育不良；此張為周邊血單顆細胞，需配合骨髓 blast 百分比、環形鐵粒母細胞與染色體分析。
Blast 分類：WHO 2016 MDS-EB-2 為骨髓 10–19% 或周邊血 5–19% 或有 Auer rods（WHO 5th 改稱 MDS-IB2）；ICC 2022 則將 10–19% 歸為 MDS/AML。
Pseudo-Pelger 細胞與 TP53 突變／17p 缺失相關；高風險 MDS 以 IPSS-R 或 IPSS-M 分層，治療含 hypomethylating agents 與 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 混淆；遺傳性（LBR 基因）幾乎所有中性球均一雙葉、顆粒正常且無血球低下，pseudo-Pelger 只見於部分細胞並伴 hypogranularity，也要排除藥物（如 mycophenolate）引起。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球的兩個發育不良特徵為何？如何與遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 區分？
quiz.a: 雙葉 pseudo-Pelger 核與 hypogranular 胞質；遺傳性者幾乎全部中性球受影響、顆粒正常且無血球低下
